title: Online Reputation Management and Community Forum Specialist
description:
[Online Reputation Management and Community Forum Specialist (Part Time)]



TYPE OF WORK: Part Time

WAGE / SALARY: $8.00 to $9.00 per hour, depending on verified experience

HOURS PER WEEK: 20 to start

LOCATION: Remote (Philippines)



ABOUT US

We are a US based brand selling automotive covers and accessories. We sell through our own website and through Amazon and eBay.



POSITION OVERVIEW

We're looking for an experienced Online Reputation Management specialist to help strengthen our brand's presence across online communities and improve branded search results.



The primary focus of this role is monitoring and participating in relevant forums, identifying reputation risks, and helping legitimate positive or neutral content outrank negative search results over time.



This isn't primarily a customer-service or review-response position. Candidates should have direct experience with online communities, branded search results, content promotion, and ethical reputation-suppression strategies.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Community Forum Management

- Find relevant forums and online communities where customers discuss our brand, products, competitors, or industry.

- Monitor discussions for brand mentions, complaints, misinformation, product questions, and reputation risks.

- Participate through useful, natural, and non-promotional contributions.

- Draft thoughtful responses that don't sound defensive, scripted, or overly promotional.

- Identify forum discussions that rank for branded searches and recommend an appropriate response strategy.

- Track discussion URLs, dates, topics, responses, engagement, and search visibility.

- Escalate legal threats, safety complaints, refund disputes, coordinated attacks, or potentially defamatory content.



Branded Search and Reputation Suppression

- Monitor priority searches involving the brand name, reviews, complaints, scams, customer service, and relevant product terms.

- Identify negative URLs, their ranking positions, content types, authority, sentiment, and likelihood of being displaced.

- Help develop ethical suppression strategies using legitimate owned, earned, and third-party assets.

- Optimize company profiles, social profiles, business listings, articles, videos, interviews, and other brand-related assets.

- Coordinate the creation and promotion of useful branded content that can occupy additional first-page search positions.

- Monitor ranking changes and recommend adjustments based on actual performance.

- Distinguish between results that may be corrected, removed, responded to, deindexed, or outranked.



Content and Reputation Assets

- Develop content briefs for branded articles, FAQs, company profiles, interviews, case studies, customer stories, and expert content.

- Support legitimate third-party placements, contributor opportunities, interviews, partnerships, and company profiles.

- Improve the credibility of reputation assets through accurate company information, identifiable authorship, firsthand experience, original media, and expert commentary.

- Coordinate with SEO, content, customer service, and leadership when public responses or new assets require approval.



Monitoring and Reporting

- Track page-one and page-two results for priority branded searches.

- Monitor new forum discussions, articles, reviews, and brand mentions.

- Maintain a weekly tracker covering negative URL positions, positive and neutral assets on pages one and two, new brand mentions, discussions requiring action, assets created or optimized, ranking changes, open risks, and recommended next steps.



MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS

- At least two years of hands-on experience in online reputation management, community management, branded SEO, or search-result suppression.

- Direct experience monitoring and participating in established online forums or communities.

- Experience evaluating branded search results and tracking the positions of negative, positive, and neutral URLs.

- Strong written English and the ability to adapt to the tone and rules of different communities.

- Basic working knowledge of SEO, search intent, content optimization, links, authority, and indexing.

- Ability to recognize when a public response could make a situation worse and should be escalated.

- Strong research, documentation, organization, and reporting skills.

- Ability to provide specific examples of past work and clearly explain your individual contribution.



NICE-TO-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience managing ORM for an e-commerce or consumer brand.

- Experience improving branded search results through content, profiles, videos, digital PR, or legitimate third-party placements.

- Experience securing interviews, articles, contributor opportunities, citations, or editorial mentions.

- Familiarity with Google Business Profile, Trustpilot, BBB, social platforms, video platforms, and industry-specific forums.

- Experience using Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, rank-tracking platforms, or brand-monitoring tools.

- Knowledge of on-page SEO, internal linking, digital PR, entity optimization, and content distribution.

- Experience working with customer-service teams on complaint escalation and resolution.



PROHIBITED TACTICS

We're only interested in legitimate, sustainable reputation-management practices. The following tactics aren't permitted:

- Fake customer accounts or fabricated personal identities

- Fake reviews, testimonials, or customer experiences

- Review gating or incentives offered only for positive reviews

- Mass forum posting, automated comments, or spam links

- Harassment, intimidation, or coordinated reporting campaigns

- Misrepresenting an affiliation with the company

- Publishing false allegations about competitors

- Promising guaranteed removals or guaranteed ranking results



Candidates should be comfortable disclosing a company affiliation when required by a platform or when the relationship would materially affect how readers interpret a recommendation.



PERFORMANCE MEASURES

- Movement of priority negative URLs in branded search results

- Growth of legitimate positive and neutral assets on page one

- Quality and relevance of community participation

- Reputation risks identified before they escalate

- Accuracy and completeness of weekly reporting

- Quality of content, profile, and placement recommendations

- Compliance with company and community guidelines



Search-result suppression isn't guaranteed and may require several months, depending on the authority of the negative result and the competitiveness of the branded search.



WORK ARRANGEMENT

- Remote, part-time contractor position

- 20 hours per week to start, Monday to Friday, 4 hours a day. Hours can increase up to 40 based on performance and workload

- Your 4 hours fall within 7:00 AM to 3:30 PM US Pacific Time (10:00 PM to 6:30 AM Philippine Time). The exact block is set with your manager once you start

- Paid through Wise, on schedule

- Weekly progress reporting is required

- Some daily monitoring of brand mentions and community discussions may be needed

- During the initial training period, public responses and activity in new communities need approval before they go out



A NOTE ON APPLYING

If you have not done something, just say so in your answers. "I have not done that" costs you nothing here. What does count against you is describing work you did not personally do.



The role starts at 20 hours and can grow to 40, with the rate reviewed as the scope grows.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph or
 
 NOT apply to 



Put COVERLAND at the start of your application, either in the subject line or as the first line of your message. Then answer all five questions below. Applications that skip questions, or answer in general terms without specific examples, will not be reviewed.



1. Brand and Project Scope

Describe one brand for which you personally handled online reputation management. Include:

- The industry or business type

- The month and year you started and finished

- Your exact responsibilities

- The number of negative results appearing within the first two pages of Google when you started

- Whether you worked independently or as part of a team

You may omit or anonymize the brand name if required by a confidentiality agreement.



2. Search-Result Movement

Choose one negative URL from that project and provide:

- The type of website on which it appeared

- Its approximate starting Google position

- Its approximate ending position

- The amount of time required

- The specific tactics you personally implemented

- How you tracked and verified the ranking movement

Do not claim that a result was suppressed if it only moved temporarily or disappeared because of a search-location change.



3. Community Forum Experience

Describe one forum or online-community situation you personally managed. Include the type of community, what you posted or recommended, whether you disclosed the brand relationship, and the outcome.



4. Strategy Scenario

A negative forum discussion ranks fourth when someone searches for a company's brand name. The discussion is several years old, but the forum has strong authority and the thread still receives occasional comments.

Explain how you would evaluate the result and what you would prioritize during the first 30, 60, and 90 days. Identify anything you would avoid doing and explain why.



5. Tools and Reporting

List the SEO, monitoring, community, and reporting tools you've used, and what you would include in a weekly ORM report. If available, attach a redacted example of a report or ranking tracker you personally prepared.



Please attach your resume.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a two-hour assessment. It is paid, whether or not you move forward.

title: Business Loan Sales Consultant / Closer — Warm Leads — AU Day Shift
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Have you sold business loans, mortgages, asset finance or insurance? Bring your closing experience to Ezy Pzy Finance and help Australian business owners access funding.

We also welcome proven sales professionals from other industries who can demonstrate consistent target achievement and experience closing business over the phone.

You’ll receive warm enquiries, product training, weekly coaching and the opportunity to earn commission on both new and repeat clients.





YOUR EARNING OPPORTUNITY



•During probation: AUD $500/week + commissions + bonuses (approx. ₱97,500/month fixed base). After 8 weeks probation: AUD $650/week including PhilCare allowance + commissions (approx. ₱126,750/month fixed pay).

• Our agents currently average AUD $5,200/month (₱234,000/month) in total earnings including commissions and monthly bonuses.

• Earn between AUD $100 - $800 (approximately ₱4,500–₱36,000) commission per deal..

• Repeat business stays with you: when a client you funded returns for more funding, you handle their next deal and earn commission again.

• Earn additional monthly performance bonuses based on KPI’s achieved.

After your two-month probation, benefits include the base salary increase, an HMO allowance, paid annual and sick leave, and access to higher bonus tiers.





WHO WE ARE



Ezy Pzy Finance is a fast growing Australian business finance company connecting business owners with a panel of non-bank lenders.

We’re growing our remote sales team and looking for consultants who combine strong closing skills with clear communication and disciplined follow-up.

Learn more: 





WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Call Australian business owners who have already expressed interest in funding.

• Understand their business, funding needs and timing.

• Qualify enquiries and guide clients through the application process.

• Explain available options clearly, handle objections and move deals towards settlement.

• Keep your pipeline organised and follow up consistently.

• Build relationships that generate repeat business.



Warm leads are provided. There is no cold prospecting or list building, but the role involves regular outbound calls and persistent follow-up.





WHO SHOULD APPLY



You have at least two years of phone-based sales experience and have personally been responsible for closing sales and achieving targets.



We particularly welcome sales experience in:



• Business lending or merchant cash advance campaigns.

• Australian or US mortgage and asset finance.

• Insurance, debt solutions or other financial products.



Successful closers from other industries are also encouraged to apply. Show us what you sold, your targets, your results and your role in winning the business.



You should be able to:



• Build trust and communicate confidently in spoken English.

• Run a discovery conversation and ask useful follow-up questions.

• Explain products clearly and handle objections professionally.

• Own your pipeline, maintain accurate records and follow through.

• Learn new products and apply coaching.



Finance processing, customer service or appointment-setting experience is useful, but you must also demonstrate personal closing experience.





TRAINING AND SUPPORT



Your first four weeks include structured product and sales training, with an initial focus on smaller loan facilities up to approximately A$30,000.

You’ll progress to larger deals as you meet quality and settlement milestones, supported by weekly one-to-one sales coaching.





SCHEDULE AND SETUP



• Monday–Friday, 6:30am–4:30pm Philippine time.

• One-hour lunch break; 45 working hours/week.

• Fully remote, with evenings free.

• Reliable computer, internet connection and backup internet/power arrangements required.





HOW TO APPLY



Incomplete applications will not be considered. Complete applications get a response within 48 hours.

Provide ALL 5 of the following:

A short video (3–5 minutes, Loom / Google Drive / unlisted YouTube link) in two parts:



Part 1 — introduce yourself, your sales experience, and the results/KPIs you achieved (numbers, not adjectives).



Part 2 — a 2-minute mock opening of a discovery call: pretend you’ve just dialled an Australian business owner from Ezy Pzy Finance — do your opening, build rapport, and start qualifying them for funding.



- Link to your resume.

- Screenshots of your DISC assessment and IQ test results (tests available at 
/testcontent).

- Screenshot of your internet speed test, provider, and PC/laptop specs.

- Your backup internet and power solutions.

- Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a Zoom interview, including a live discovery-call role-play.





If you’re a top performing sales professional and have the self drive to earn big commissions and grow in a company that is focused on long term success, then submit your application and we’ll see if we’re a good fit to work together.

title: Electrical and HVAC Customer Service Representative
description:
Oahu Electric and Air is a growing electrical and HVAC contracting company serving homeowners across Oahu, Hawaii. We're looking for a dependable, personable Customer Service Representative to join our team remotely from the Philippines. This role is the voice of our company for many of our clients — you'll be scheduling appointments, answering calls, and helping homeowners get the electrical and HVAC service they need.



What You'll Do

- Answer inbound calls and respond to customer inquiries professionally and warmly

- Schedule and coordinate service appointments with our field technicians

- Follow up with customers on quotes, appointment confirmations, and service reminders

- Enter and maintain accurate customer records in our field service software (ServiceTitan)

- Handle customer concerns with patience and a solutions-first attitude

- Support the office team with light administrative tasks as needed



What We're Looking For

- Excellent spoken and written English communication skills

- Prior customer service, call center, or virtual assistant experience (HVAC/electrical/home services industry a plus, but not required)

- Experience with ServiceTitan is a big plus

- Comfortable using scheduling or CRM software (we'll train you if you haven't used ServiceTitan before)

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet home workspace

- Available to work one of the following shifts (Hawaii time): 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM or 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM

- A friendly, "Aloha spirit" approach to helping people — patience and warmth go a long way with our clients



How to Apply

Please submit your resume along with a short voice recording (2–3 minutes) introducing yourself. In your recording, please include:

1. Your name and a bit of background — where you're based and your relevant work experience

2. Why you're a good fit for this role — what customer service or admin experience you bring, and what you enjoy about helping customers

3. A sample customer interaction — pretend you're answering the phone as our CSR and greeting a customer who wants to schedule an appointment (this lets us hear your natural phone voice and tone)

4. Your availability — which of the two shift options works best for you

5. Something about yourself — a personal note so we get a sense of your personality, not just your qualifications



This helps us evaluate your spoken English, tone, and phone presence, since that's a huge part of this job.



Mahalo for your interest — we look forward to hearing from you!

title: Phone onboarding agent for UK customers. Neutral, near-native English accent essential. Full time, UK hours.
description:

Script: "Hi, is that Sarah? It's James from VintedResells. You just picked up the supplier list, so I'm calling to get you set up properly. Have you got two minutes? Perfect. First thing, the list is in your
 now, and the suppliers at the top are the ones I'd message tonight. Have you sold on Vinted before, or is this your first go?"

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Job Title: Business Development Representative (SDR) for a Tech company, CRM focused.



Time Zone: United States, Eastern Standard Time (EST)



Position Type: Remote Full-Time (8 hours per day, 40 hours per week): 9:00AM - 6:00PM EST.



Journey is seeking full-time sales professionals and candidates who are experienced in working with American tech companies, working with CRMs for senior living, home care, with significant sales experience in cold calling.



Compensation:

Journey offers a highly competitive pay structure designed to reward engagement, performance, consistency, and results.

Successful BDRs have the opportunity to earn substantial commissions and performance bonuses by generating qualified opportunities. Detailed commission and incentive information will be provided during the interview process.



This role is ideal for motivated sales professionals who want to be rewarded directly for the value they create and the business opportunities they generate.



Position Overview:

Journey is seeking energetic, relationship-driven professionals to join our team as Business Development Representatives (BDRs).

The BDR serves as the first point of contact for prospective customers and plays a critical role in generating qualified sales opportunities for the organization. This role focuses on prospecting, outreach, lead qualification, relationship building, and appointment setting. BDRs work closely with Journey's leadership team to identify organizations that may benefit from Journey's CRM and schedule qualified discovery meetings.



Successful candidates will possess strong communication skills, professionalism, persistence, and a genuine interest in helping organizations improve their sales, marketing, and customer engagement operations.



Key Responsibilities:

Lead Generation & Prospecting

Identify prospective senior living and home care organizations

Research target accounts and decision makers

Build and maintain prospect lists

Conduct outbound prospecting through phone,
, LinkedIn, referrals, and networking

Generate qualified opportunities for the sales team



Lead Qualification

Conduct initial discovery conversations

Identify customer needs, challenges, and goals

Qualify prospects based on established criteria

Gather relevant business information

Determine next-step opportunities

Appointment Setting

Schedule qualified meetings and product demonstrations

Coordinate calendars with Journey’s leadership

Ensure prospects are properly prepared for meetings

Maintain communication prior to scheduled appointments



CRM Management

Maintain accurate CRM records

Document outreach activities

Update lead and opportunity information

Track prospect engagement and follow-up activities



Relationship Building

Establish trust and credibility with prospects

Maintain professional and consistent communication

Build relationships with executive directors, administrators, marketers, sales leaders, owners, and operators



Required Skills & Qualifications:

Candidates must possess strong communication skills and demonstrate the ability to build relationships and generate business opportunities.



Required qualifications:

Minimum 3–4 years of sales experience

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Strong interpersonal and relationship-building abilities

Professional phone presence

Comfortable speaking with executive-level decision makers

Strong organizational and time management skills

Self-motivated and results-oriented

Ability to work independently in a remote environment

Reliable internet access and remote work capabilities

Experience using CRM systems or similar business software



Nice to Have Skills & Experience:

The following skills and experiences would be beneficial:

Sales experience in software and Tech companies

SaaS sales experience

CRM software experience

Lead generation experience

Appointment setting experience



Interested candidates should submit a resume, LinkedIn page if available and a voice recording introducing themselves.



About Journey:

Journey is a Tech Company: A purpose-built CRM and growth platform designed specifically for senior living and home care providers. Built by industry professionals with decades of experience in serving senior living and home care organizations, Journey helps operators streamline sales, improve occupancy, strengthen customer engagement, and gain greater visibility into performance. We believe technology should simplify operations, improve outcomes, and support the people delivering care every day.

title: Amazon Listing & Catalog Operations Specialist (3+ Yrs, Flat Files)
description:
TYPE OF WORK: Full Time

WAGE / SALARY: $5.00 to $7.00/hr. Your starting rate is set by your verified experience and your paid skills test result.

HOURS PER WEEK: 40

LOCATION: Remote



Read this first

This is a senior specialist role, not a general VA role. We require at least 3 years of hands on seller side experience.



If your Amazon experience is customer service, product research, sourcing, PPC, or online courses only, please do not apply. We verify experience and you will not be shortlisted.



If you have personally built parent and child variation families, fixed a suppressed listing, and debugged a flat file upload error, please keep reading. We are hiring one person for the long term.



About the work

We run an established Amazon store with a large, variation heavy catalog. Our listings are our storefront, so catalog accuracy is the job itself. You will own daily listing operations: creating new products, building variation families, keeping data clean across hundreds of SKUs, and making sure every image and attribute is correct.



This is detail work with real consequences. One wrong UPC or a broken variation theme can cost us sales for days. We want someone who finds that kind of precision satisfying rather than tedious.



What you will actually do

- Create and maintain Amazon listings, including parent and child variation families

- Build and upload flat files and bulk templates, and debug upload errors and rejections

- Fix suppressed, stranded, and incomplete listings, and find the root cause instead of only the symptom

- Manage product images: naming conventions, main and alt image mapping, Amazon image requirements

- Clean and restructure product data in Excel and Google Sheets before it reaches Seller Central

- Run catalog audits using Category Listing Report and inventory reports, and flag inconsistencies before we notice them

- Document your process so it can be repeated



Hard requirements (all four)

1. At least 3 years of hands on Amazon Seller Central or Vendor Central experience on the seller side. Buyer side or CS only experience does not count.

2. You have personally created and maintained product listings, including variations. Product research or sourcing alone does not count.

3. Strong Excel and Google Sheets. VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP, text functions for SKU building, removing duplicates, and handling CSV files without losing leading zeros.

4. Reliable internet and backup power, plus consistent attendance. You work independently with minimal supervision.



We also need written English clear enough to explain a listing problem without a call, and the honesty to say "I don't know" instead of guessing.



Nice to have

- Flat file experience across multiple categories

- Shopify or other marketplace catalog experience

- Basic image editing (crop, background, resize to Amazon spec)

- Experience writing or following SOPs



Pay and how we set it

- $5.50 to $7.00/hr, 40 hours per week. Your starting rate depends on verified experience and your skills test result.

- First 2 weeks are a paid probation at your agreed rate. Not a free trial.

- Raises are tied to written performance criteria and reviewed at 3 months. No vague promises.

- Paid on time, every time, through Wise. We have a documented payroll process.

- Long term position. We are hiring someone to grow with the catalog.



Our hiring process

1. Application with screening answers (see below).

2. Experience verification. We will ask for your resume and for specifics about listings you have built.

3. A 30 minute video interview. Your microphone is required so we can hear you clearly. Turning your camera on is optional. You will share your screen for part of it. We work through a short live session together in Excel or Google Sheets, using a real flat file with messy source data in it. There is nothing to prepare and nothing to submit beforehand. If the skill is genuinely yours, this is the easiest part of the process.

4. Offer, then your paid 2 week probation.



We are open about this process because it works in both directions. If your experience is overstated, the live session will be uncomfortable. If you are the real thing, it is the fastest way we know to see it. There is no unpaid take home task and no week of waiting for a result.



How to apply

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph messaging only. Please do not
.



Put the word AMAZON on the first line of your message, then answer these four questions briefly. Applications that skip the questions are not reviewed, because these answers are the only way we can tell you apart from a hundred other applicants.



1. Roughly how many SKUs have you personally managed, and in which categories?

2. Have you built and uploaded flat files? If yes, name one thing that commonly breaks an upload and how you fixed it.

3. What is a variation theme, in your

own words? Give one example of a variation family you personally built.

4. Name one listing error or suppression you have resolved (an error code, a compliance issue, a missing attribute) and describe the fix.



Please attach your resume. Strong candidates often get held up simply because we cannot verify anything without one.

Short and specific answers are better than long polished ones. Four honest sentences will get you further here than a page of AI written text.

title: Amazon FBA Sourcing Assistant — Wholesale, Online Arbitrage & Private Label (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
About us:

We are a growing Amazon FBA business (US marketplace), currently formalizing our US company structure. We sell in the home & kitchen category. We're expanding into wholesale and online arbitrage sourcing, while also continuing some private label work. Looking for a long-term team member, not a one-off gig.



What you'll do:

- Research and verify wholesale and online arbitrage (OA) leads using Keepa as your core tool, plus SellerAmp SAS for profitability checks (SmartScout experience is a strong plus).

- Check profitability on every lead: target ROI 20%+, net profit $3+/unit, sales velocity 50+/month (exact targets may be adjusted together).

- Check every lead for restrictions before recommending it: brand gating, IP complaints, Amazon as the seller, hazmat/oversize issues.

- Help monitor competitor pricing and Buy Box share on our active listings, and work with a repricing tool (rules/strategy will be set together with us) to stay competitive.

- Occasionally support private label product research: identifying trending opportunities, evaluating demand/competition, and locating suppliers on Alibaba/1688 for quotes.

- Deliver a clean, organized lead/report sheet on a regular schedule (product, ASIN, supplier, cost, ROI, restrictions, notes).

- Flag risks clearly and honestly — never hide a restriction or a weak number to make a lead look better than it is.



What you need:

- 1+ year of experience in Amazon FBA product research (wholesale, OA, and/or private label).

- Strong, hands-on knowledge of Keepa (rank/price/sales history) — this one is a must-have for us.

- Working knowledge of SellerAmp SAS or a similar profitability calculator, and at least one restriction-checking tool (RevSeller, Seller Assistant App, or similar browser extension).

- Big plus if you also know SmartScout (supplier/brand discovery, product analytics) — not required, but it moves your application to the top.

- Familiarity with a repricing tool (Aura, BQool, Seller Snap, or Amazon's own Automate Pricing) and how Buy Box competition works on wholesale listings — a strong plus, not required day one.

- Bonus if you also know: Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Tactical Arbitrage, or InventoryLab.

- Strong Google Sheets/Excel skills (filters, formulas, organizing data cleanly).

- Basic understanding of Alibaba/1688 sourcing for private label items.

- Reliable internet, available full-time (40 hrs/week), consistent output on a regular schedule.

- High attention to detail — accuracy matters more than speed. Strong written English for reports.



How to apply:

Start your application with your favorite color, then answer: (1) How many wholesale/OA leads per week can you realistically verify, with full restriction checks? (2) What's your process to confirm a product is NOT gated and has no IP complaints before recommending it? (3) How comfortable are you with Keepa and SmartScout specifically — rate yourself 1-5 on each and explain why. (4) Have you worked with a repricing tool before? Which one? (5) Do you also have experience with private label product research (trend/demand analysis, Alibaba sourcing)? (6) One example (anonymized) of a product you found and the numbers behind it.

title: Website Creation Role
description:
Experienced WordPress & Elementor Specialist

Website Development,
 Marketing, HubSpot & AI Workflows



Location: Remote



Schedule: 36-40 hours a week and required working hours in EST time



Engagement type: Independent contractor



About the Role

We are looking for an experienced, efficient, and detail-oriented WordPress and Elementor specialist to build, maintain, and improve websites across our pet, hospitality, and wellness-event businesses.



Website development and maintenance will be your primary responsibility. Hands-on
 marketing experience is also required. HubSpot experience is strongly preferred, practical AI experience is highly desirable, and graphic design or photo-editing skills are valuable bonuses.



This is a structured, hands-on role. You will receive clear business priorities, project briefs, deadlines, feedback, and ongoing direction. We need someone with the technical experience to turn that direction into completed, tested work without requiring step-by-step instruction on the fundamentals.



We value speed, accuracy, and consistent follow-through. You should work at a productive pace, communicate proactively, take feedback well, and be willing to learn unfamiliar tools and processes.



You do not need to know every platform we use. However, you should bring strong core skills and demonstrate that you can learn efficiently and apply what you learn.



Projects will be prioritized according to business needs and available capacity. We are not expecting one person to act as an entire development, design, SEO, and marketing department simultaneously.



How We Work: Efficiency, Structure & Accountability



WORK EFFICIENTLY AND MEET AGREED DEADLINES



Provide realistic task estimates, follow assigned priorities, and use your working time effectively.



- Use reusable templates, established processes, and approved AI tools to reduce unnecessary manual work.

- Speed matters, but deliverables must still be accurate, polished, and tested.



FOLLOW THE AGREED SCHEDULE AND STAY RESPONSIVE



Scheduled work time must be dedicated to company responsibilities.



- Remain reachable through our agreed communication channels, attend scheduled meetings, and follow established availability and response expectations.



Keep progress visible.



- Maintain an updated task board and provide a brief daily summary of completed work, current tasks, and blockers.

- Flag missing information, unclear instructions, or potential delays early rather than waiting until a deadline is missed.



TAKE DIRECTION AND APPLY FEEDBACK



Follow project briefs, brand guidelines, and approved processes.



- Ask focused questions when needed, apply corrections consistently, and use feedback to improve future work.



Show initiative within clear boundaries.



- We welcome practical suggestions and better ways of working.

- Routine, approved tasks should move forward without repeated reminders.

- Changes to agreed priorities, significant scope changes, new expenses, major changes to live systems, and deletion of important data require approval.



Core Responsibilities



1. Website Development and Design

- Build, redesign, and improve websites using WordPress and Elementor/Elementor Pro.

- Projects may include full websites, homepages, service pages, location pages, campaign landing pages, and inquiry or registration pages.

- Create responsive layouts that work well on desktop, tablet, and mobile. Use reusable templates, global styles, and organized page structures to keep websites consistent and easy to maintain.

- Configure navigation, headers, footers, forms, and integrations. Make basic HTML and CSS adjustments when needed.

Pay close attention to typography, spacing, imagery, readability, navigation, and clear calls to action. We are looking for thoughtful design—not simply placing content into a template.

2. Website Maintenance, Troubleshooting & Performance

- Keep websites functional, current, and reliable.

- Manage WordPress, theme, and plugin updates using appropriate backups, staging, and rollback procedures. Test important functions after making changes.

- Investigate and resolve broken layouts, failed forms, plugin conflicts, slow pages, broken links, and integration issues. - Optimize images and review unnecessary plugins or scripts where appropriate.

- Carry out routine checks so problems are identified before they affect customers or inquiries.

- Maintain organized records of hosting, domains, plugins, licenses, and renewal dates. Company accounts and digital assets must remain under company ownership, with access managed through approved systems.

3.
 Marketing & Follow-Up Automation

- Practical
 marketing experience is required.

- Create branded, mobile-friendly newsletters, promotional campaigns, and
 templates. Prepare or refine copy, select the appropriate audience, and submit campaigns for approval.

- Build and maintain straightforward welcome, inquiry follow-up, nurture, and re-engagement sequences.

- Organize audiences by brand, interest, inquiry type, or customer stage. Connect website forms to the correct contact lists and follow-up workflows.

- Test links, personalization, triggers, notifications, and routing before launch. Review clicks, qualified inquiries, conversions, unsubscribes, and delivery issues.

- Use approved contact lists, respect consent and unsubscribe preferences, and keep each brand’s audiences appropriately separated.

- You do not need advanced expertise in every
 marketing discipline, but you should already know how to execute routine campaigns and basic automations.

4. HubSpot, Forms & CRM Integrations

- Hands-on HubSpot experience is strongly preferred.

- Depending on the features available in our account, responsibilities may include connecting WordPress/Elementor forms, mapping contact fields, organizing contacts, preparing campaigns, setting up lead notifications, and maintaining basic follow-up workflows.

- Check the entire inquiry process:

A visitor submits a form → the information reaches the correct system → the appropriate team member is notified → the intended follow-up occurs.

- When something fails, identify where the process broke down and verify the fix from start to finish.

Experience with another established CRM or
 marketing platform is welcome. Direct HubSpot implementation experience will strengthen your application.

5. SEO, Analytics & Conversion Improvements

- Apply practical on-page and technical SEO fundamentals, including page titles, headings, internal links, image alt text, URL structure, redirects, and indexing checks.

- Use tools such as Google Analytics and Google Search Console to review performance and identify potential issues. Help configure or troubleshoot basic form-submission and conversion tracking.

- Review websites from the customer’s perspective: Is the service clear? Is the next step obvious? Does the page establish trust? Is the form easy to complete?

- Recommend improvements based on available evidence, distinguishing between what the data shows and what still needs to be tested.

6. AI-Assisted Workflows

- Strong practical AI experience is highly desirable.

- We are interested in how you use AI to improve productivity and quality—not simply which tools you have tried.

- Relevant uses may include technical troubleshooting, code assistance, content organization,
 variations, image preparation, testing checklists, documentation, and repetitive tasks.

- Tools may include ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, or other approved platforms. No particular combination is required.

- You remain responsible for the finished work. Review content for accuracy and brand fit, test code before deployment, and protect company and customer information.

- Be prepared to explain how you used AI, what you changed or rejected, and how you verified the result.

7. Project Coordination & Documentation

- Organize your work around the company’s priority list, provide realistic estimates, and follow through on agreed deadlines.

- Document important website settings, integrations, form destinations, automation workflows, and significant changes so another team member can understand and maintain the systems.

- Escalate urgent issues promptly within the agreed working-hours and response arrangements. Communicate problems with enough detail for the team to make a decision, including a proposed next step where possible.



Essential Qualifications

• Substantial hands-on WordPress and Elementor experience, typically three or more years, supported by a strong portfolio. Demonstrated capability matters more than years alone.

• Experience maintaining websites after launch, strong responsive-design skills, basic HTML/CSS, and confidence troubleshooting plugins, forms, hosting, and domain-related issues.

• Hands-on experience creating
 campaigns and basic automated sequences in at least one established platform.

• A practical understanding of website performance, SEO fundamentals, analytics, and lead-generation processes.

• Clear written communication, the ability to prepare or refine customer-facing content, and a record of delivering accurate work within agreed timelines.



You should be comfortable researching unfamiliar problems, testing solutions safely, following instructions, and recognizing when approval or specialist help is needed.



A willingness to learn is important, but it should build on existing competence in the core responsibilities. This is not an entry-level position.



Strongly Preferred Experience



- HubSpot implementation: You have personally configured or managed forms, contacts, campaigns, integrations, or follow-up processes—not merely viewed information in the platform.

- Practical AI workflows: You regularly use AI in your work and can demonstrate how you check its output.

- Multiple-brand or multiple-website management: You can stay organized, preserve brand differences, and follow an agreed priority order across projects.



Additional Bonus Skills



- Graphic design and photo editing are valuable additions, particularly experience with Photoshop, Lightroom, Canva, or Figma.

- Related tasks may include preparing website banners, improving images, removing backgrounds, resizing assets, and maintaining consistent visual presentation. Images must accurately represent our animals, properties, and services.

Experience with Zapier, Make, webhooks, basic JavaScript, booking-system integrations, local SEO, or Google Tag Manager is also welcome.

- Strong execution in the core responsibilities is more important than superficial familiarity with every tool listed.



What Success Looks Like



- First 30 days: Understand our brands, priorities, and systems. Review priority websites and inquiry processes, identify urgent issues, establish realistic task estimates, and complete agreed initial improvements.

- Days 31–60: Deliver agreed website and campaign milestones, verify important forms and integrations, and establish reliable maintenance, testing, and documentation routines.

- Days 61–90: Deliver the agreed workload at a consistent, productive pace. Complete routine website and
 work with minimal technical instruction, apply feedback reliably, and suggest practical improvements supported by evidence.

Performance will be assessed through work quality, turnaround time relative to task complexity, reliability, communication, testing, and follow-through.



We value efficient delivery—not rushed work that creates avoidable errors or repeated rework. Lead-generation and conversion results will also be considered alongside traffic, campaign activity, and other factors outside your control.



How to Apply

Please include the following:



1. An Updated Résumé and Brief Introduction

- Include your relevant employment or freelance experience, dates, main responsibilities, and the tools you have used professionally.

- In your introduction, highlight your strongest skills and explain your personal experience with WordPress/Elementor, website maintenance,
 marketing, and CRM projects.

1. Three Relevant Website Examples

- For each example, explain exactly what you personally did, which tools you used, and whether you maintained the website after launch.

- Clearly distinguish your contribution from work completed by other team members. Include improvements or results where you can substantiate them.

1. One
 Campaign or Automation Example

- Describe the platform, the campaign or workflow, your personal contribution, and how you tested or evaluated the work.

- Include your specific HubSpot experience, where applicable.

1. Your Availability and Expected Compensation

- Include your time zone, available working hours, expected compensation and currency, and earliest start date.

1. A Practical AI Example, Where Applicable

- A brief example of an AI-assisted workflow is welcome but not required.

- Explain the task, how you used AI, what you changed or rejected, and how you checked the result. Screenshots or a short walkthrough are welcome.



We welcome honest explanations of both your strengths and the areas you are still developing. Professional reference contact details are not required with your initial application.



Selection Process



1. Interview and Portfolio Walkthrough

2. Shortlisted candidates may be invited to discuss their experience and walk us through their work.

3. We may ask about a project you delivered under a tight deadline, how you kept your manager or client informed, and a technical skill you recently learned.

4. We are interested in your actual contribution, problem-solving approach, work pace, and ability to explain your decisions.

5. Paid Practical Assessment

6. Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a small, paid, time-boxed practical assessment in a test environment. The scope, time limit, and payment will be agreed beforehand.

7. The assessment will evaluate your ability to interpret a clear brief, estimate the work, improve an Elementor page, check mobile usability, test functionality, and explain your decisions.

8. We will assess both pace and quality. We may also discuss an
 or HubSpot workflow relevant to your experience.



Approved AI tools are welcome during the assessment. Be prepared to explain how you used them and verified the output.



Professional References (Optional)

If possible please provide 1-2 professional references, preferably former managers, supervisors, or clients who directly oversaw their work. We are particularly interested in feedback on work quality, efficiency, meeting deadlines, communication, reliability, and receptiveness to feedback. We will obtain your permission before contacting references and will not contact your current employer without your explicit consent.



We are looking for someone who brings proven skills, follows clear direction, works efficiently, communicates reliably, and takes pride in delivering complete, dependable work.

title: Real Estate Sales Manager / Lead Manager
description:
We are a growing U.S.-based real estate investment company looking for a Sales Manager / Lead Manager who can take ownership of our incoming leads and turn opportunities into deals.



This is not a passive management position. We need someone who is hungry, proactive, sales-driven, and knows how to get results.



Your job is simple: make sure no lead gets missed and every opportunity is worked to its full potential.



What You'll Be Doing

📞 Lead Management & Follow-Up

Monitor all incoming leads and make sure every lead is contacted promptly

Follow up consistently with leads through calls, SMS, and other communication channels

Make sure no lead gets lost, forgotten, or left without follow-up

Manage leads through the CRM and keep pipeline stages and notes updated

Identify hot opportunities and prioritize them appropriately

Track lead activity and follow-up performance



💰 Sales & Acquisitions

Build rapport and understand the seller's situation, motivation, timeline, and price expectations

Run property comparables and analyze potential deals

Determine an appropriate offer based on the property and deal criteria

Present offers to sellers

Negotiate when necessary and work toward getting contracts signed

Follow up with sellers who are not ready to make a decision immediately

Work closely with the team to move qualified opportunities toward closing



📊 Sales Management & Accountability

Monitor lead response and follow-up activity

Track KPIs and sales performance

Identify gaps in our lead management process

Recommend improvements to increase conversion

Help establish and maintain a strong follow-up system

Take ownership of the sales pipeline and results



🛠️ Administrative Support



You will also assist with sales-related administrative tasks, including:



Preparing and organizing data needed for SMS campaigns

Cleaning and organizing lead lists

Managing spreadsheets and lead databases

Pulling and organizing information needed for marketing campaigns

Assisting with CRM data management

Supporting the team with other sales and lead-generation tasks when needed



Who We're Looking For



We are looking for a sales beast and natural leader who knows how to turn conversations into opportunities and opportunities into deals.



You should be:



🔥 Highly motivated and results-driven

📞 Confident and persuasive on the phone

🧠 Strong at sales, negotiation, and objection handling

🎯 Comfortable working with quotas and KPIs

🚀 Proactive—you don't wait around for someone to tell you what to do

👊 Thick-skinned and able to handle rejection, criticism, and constructive feedback

🏆 Competitive and motivated by achieving goals

📋 Organized and able to manage multiple leads simultaneously

💡 Resourceful and able to figure things out independently

🤝 A team player who can eventually take on a leadership role



Experience Required:

Previous experience in U.S. real estate sales, acquisitions, or lead management

Experience working with real estate investors is strongly preferred

Experience with wholesaling and/or novation deals is a major plus

Experience running comps and analyzing real estate deals

Experience negotiating with sellers

Experience using a CRM such as GoHighLevel and SMS Marketing platform Smarter Contact

Experience with SMS marketing, lead lists, or real estate marketing is a plus



What Success Looks Like:



The person in this role should help us:



Respond faster → Follow up better → Miss fewer opportunities → Make more offers → Sign more contracts → Close more deals.



We don't want someone who simply manages a CRM.



We want someone who owns the pipeline and takes responsibility for results.



Compensation:

Competitive base pay based on experience

Performance-based incentives/bonuses

Long-term opportunity for the right person

Opportunity to grow into a larger sales leadership role



How to Apply



Please send:



A link to your resume

A summary of your experience in real estate sales/acquisitions

Your experience with wholesaling and/or novation

The CRM systems you have used

A brief example of a deal you helped close or a sales goal you achieved



Please include the word "DEAL MAKER" in your application so we know you read the entire post.



We are building a serious team that gets results.



If you're the type of person who sees a lead and thinks "How do I turn this into a deal?" rather than waiting for someone else to handle it, we want to hear from you.

Full 8-hour graveyard shift required

Full-time remote role

Training provided

Growth opportunity into a higher leadership role

title: Productivity Assistant / Paid Accountability Partner
description:
This is an atypical role and not a traditional virtual assistant position.



I’m an entrepreneur looking for someone to help me stay focused, follow my schedule, and consistently execute throughout the workday.



I generally know what I need to work on and will create a schedule and goals for the day. My problem is staying disciplined to that plan. I can get distracted, switch tasks, spend too much time on lower-priority things, or convince myself to change the plan.



I’m looking for someone who can provide external accountability and essentially act as my remote productivity manager.



What the job looks like:



We’ll generally be in a 
 call/room together during my workday.



You are not expected to actively work for me the entire time. During the periods when I’m working independently, you are welcome to work another remote job, study, freelance, work on your own business/projects, etc.



You just need to be generally available 8 AM - 6 PM EST on weekdays.



Your main responsibilities will be:



* Start the day with a short planning/check-in session with me. Probably around 8:30 AM EST.

* Check in with me approximately every 60–90 minutes to see if I have stuck to the schedule, and completed what was on my schedule block.

* Keep a simple record of my goals and actual results.

* Push me back toward the original plan when I unnecessarily change tasks.



So maybe in the morning, a quick 10 minute call, review my schedule for the day. 5 minutes every hour or so, make sure I'm on track. And another review at the end of day. Like a manager. So it should really total maybe an hour each day, but split across the day.



For example:

If it's on my calendar that I'm supposed to make sales calls until 12:00, and at 10:30 I suddenly d
 I’d rather work on a different project, I want you to ask me why. If there isn’t a legitimate reason to change the plan, I want you to be comfortable saying something like: “That’s not what you committed to doing. Write the idea down for later and finish the work block first.”



You should have:



* Reliable internet

* Good conversational English

* 

* Strong punctuality and reliability

* Confidence speaking up when someone isn’t following through



This could be especially good for someone who already spends a lot of time at their computer—for example:



* A freelancer

* A student

* A remote worker with significant downtime

* Someone building their own business

* Someone studying or learning online



I’d like to start with a paid trial period for one week, so we can figure out what schedule and accountability system works best for both of us.



Please answer these questions:



1. What do you currently do for work/study, and what would you normally be doing while we’re sitting in 
 (or similar)?

2. Does the idea of being someone's manager appeal to you? Why? 

3. If I was supposed to make sales calls for two hours but told you after 30 minutes that I wanted to work on something else instead, what would you say to me?

4. Are you comfortable with long periods where we’re both quietly doing our own work?

5. What hours are you normally awake and available in EST time?

6. Any experience with managers in the past or having managed someone yourself?



Looking forward to seeing responses! Let me know any questions as well. Thank you.

title: Real Estate Data Manager (YOU MUST SPEAK FLUENT ENGLISH)
description:
* YOU MUST SPEAK FLUENT ENGLISH *

We're a US-based virtual real estate company looking for a detail-oriented Data Manager to run our daily lead pipeline. Every morning you'll pull fresh distress lists from county sources, scrub the data, run skip tracing and phone verification, then import clean, dial-ready leads into our CRM before our acquisitions team starts calling.



The work is consistent, structured, and rewards accuracy. If you're the kind of person who notices a misspelled column header and fixes it without being asked — keep reading.



This is a long-term role. We want someone who will own this pipeline for years, not weeks.





Schedule

- Hours: 40 hours per week

- Days: Monday through Friday

- Time zone: 9am-6pm (CST)

- Deadline: All daily lists must be live in our CRM daily.



Pay

- $4–6 USD/hour depending on experience

- Paid bi-weekly via Payoneer or PayPal

- Performance bonus for clean data quality and on-time delivery

- Raise review at 90 days



What You'll Do Every Day:

1. Pull distress lists from county government portals: probate, auction, tax delinquent, pre-foreclosure, and auction.

2. Scrub the data in Google Sheets — dedupe by APN, standardize addresses to USPS format, remove vacant land, cross-check against our CRM.

3. Organize each list into our standard 14-column upload format

4. Run the cleaned list through BatchLeads for skip tracing

5. Verify every phone number through Trestle (activity score, line type, connection status)

6. Reorder phones so the highest-scored number lands in Phone 1

7. Import the final file into FreedomSoft with the correct campaign tag and pipeline stage

8. Log every step in our Master Tracker (raw count, scrubbed count, hit rate, etc.)



A full Standard Operating Procedure with screenshots and a worked example will be provided. You will not be figuring this out from scratch.



Tools You'll Use:

- Google Sheets (heavy daily use — formulas, filters, dedupe, VLOOKUP)

- FreedomSoft (our CRM — we'll train you)

- XLeads (skip tracing)

- Trestle (phone verification)

- County government websites (varies by list type)

- Slack (daily check-ins and questions)



What We Need From You:

- Strong Google Sheets skills — you should be comfortable with formulas, filters, dedupe, and conditional formatting

- Sharp attention to detail — bad data costs us real money

- Comfortable navigating unfamiliar government websites and exporting CSVs

- Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet workspace

- Good written English for daily Slack updates

- Available Mon–Fri without exception (this is a daily pipeline — one missed day backs up the whole team)

- Able to start As Soon As Possible



Bonus Points If You Have:

- Prior US real estate experience

- Experience with FreedomSoft, BatchLeads, PropStream, or any real estate CRM

- Background in data entry, list management, or data cleaning roles

- Skip tracing experience (Xleads, Skip Genie, IDI, TLO, etc.)

- Familiarity with US county records systems



What Makes This Role Different:

- Structured, repeatable work. This is not a "wear many hats" VA role. You'll do the same workflow every day and get faster at it every week.

- Clear ownership. You own the pipeline. Your numbers (hit rate, dead phone rate, on-time delivery) are visible to the team every Friday.

- Long-term growth. As we scale, you'll have the chance to train other VAs on this workflow and move into a team lead role.

You won't be making cold calls. This is back-office data work. We have a separate Acquisitions Team for outreach.



How to Apply

1. Include the word PIPELINE at the top of your application. Applications without this word will be deleted unread.

2. Briefly describe one time you cleaned a messy data set: what was wrong with it, how you fixed it, and how long it took.

3. Tell me what daily hours you would work in Philippine time.

4. Tell me your minimum acceptable hourly rate in USD.

5. Confirm you have a stable internet and a quiet workspace.



We will respond to the strongest applicants within 3 business days.



Thank you for reading the full post. We're looking forward to building a long-term team with the right person.

title: SENIOR EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT / AI BUSINESS OPERATIONS MANAGER
description:
SENIOR EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT / AI BUSINESS OPERATIONS MANAGER



Full-Time | Long-Term | Remote | Flexible Schedule - Available for US Times  | FAST HIRING



We are looking for someone who can become a **founder's right hand**.



This is not a traditional VA position where you are given a list of tasks and told exactly what to do.



We want someone who can look at the business, identify what needs attention, take ownership, solve problems, improve systems, and use AI and automation to make the company more efficient.



**If you are highly proactive, technically curious, business-minded, and enjoy figuring things out, keep reading.**



---



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



Executive & Business Operations



* Work directly with the founder on day-to-day priorities

* Manage follow-ups, research, projects, and action items

* Keep important things from falling through the cracks

* Research companies, markets, competitors, prospects, and opportunities

* Support business development and lead generation

* Manage and improve CRM processes

* Create SOPs and documentation

* Identify inefficient processes and recommend improvements

* Take ownership of projects from idea through completion

* Coordinate with other team members, contractors, and partners

* Help the founder turn ideas into organized execution



### AI & Automation



We want someone who sees repetitive work and asks:



**"Why are we doing this manually?"**



You may work with:



* ChatGPT / Claude

* n8n

* Make

* Zapier

* GoHighLevel

* HubSpot

* Airtable

* Google Workspace

* APIs

* Webhooks

* AI agents

* CRM automations

* Other tools you discover that can solve a problem



You do **not** need to be a software engineer.



However, you should have some experience **actually configuring, building, testing, or improving workflows and systems**.



Using ChatGPT to write
s does not count as automation experience.



---



# THE TYPE OF PERSON WE WANT



You are likely a strong fit if:



* You've supported a founder, CEO, entrepreneur, or business owner

* You are naturally proactive

* You can work independently without constant supervision

* You are comfortable figuring out unfamiliar tools

* You enjoy solving problems

* You understand business, not just administrative tasks

* You have real experience with CRM, automation, AI, or business systems

* You can communicate clearly in English

* You can move between executive support, operations, research, sales/BD, and technology

* You want a **long-term position where your responsibility grows over time**



The ideal person can eventually hear:



> "We're having a problem with X."



…and respond with:



> "I'll look into it and come back with a solution."



---



# THIS IS NOT THE RIGHT ROLE IF...



Your experience is primarily:



* Data entry

* Calendar management only

* Customer service only

* Social media posting

* Basic administrative assistance

* Copy/pasting information

* Using ChatGPT for simple writing

* Following instructions without questioning inefficient processes



You don't have to know everything.



**We care more about how you think, how quickly you learn, and what you've actually built than how impressive your resume sounds.**



---



# YOUR APPLICATION — THIS IS IMPORTANT



**Do NOT send us a long cover letter.**



Instead, we want a **3–5 minute video introduction.**



Use Loom, Google Drive, YouTube unlisted, or another video-sharing service.



You can record your screen, your phone, or your webcam.



**No fancy production is necessary.**



We want to see and hear how you think.



### In your video, answer these 5 questions:



**1. Give us the 60-second version of your background.**



What businesses/founders have you supported and what were you responsible for?



**2. Show us ONE real automation, workflow, or system you personally built or configured.**



If possible, screen-share it.



Explain:



* What problem were you solving?

* What tools did you use?

* What triggered the workflow?

* What happened automatically?

* What did YOU personally build or configure?



If you haven't built an automation, **just say so.**



We value honesty.



**3. Imagine the founder tells you:**



> "We're getting leads, but we're losing opportunities because nobody consistently follows up."



What would you do?



Walk us through your thinking from investigation → solution → implementation.



**4. Tell us about a time you noticed a problem or inefficient process and fixed it without being given step-by-step instructions.**



What happened?



What did you do?



What was the result?



**5. Why does this particular type of role interest you?**



We want someone who genuinely wants to become a long-term right hand to a founder, not someone looking for another short-term VA position.



---



# COMPENSATION



**$900–$1,500 USD/month depending on demonstrated experience and ability.**



We are willing to pay more for someone who can genuinely operate at a higher level.



---



# SCHEDULE



* Full-time

* 40 hours/week

* Remote

* Flexible working schedule (Available for meetings with founder and team during requested US Hours)

* Regular overlap with U.S. hours when needed

* Must be available for important meetings, collaboration, and time-sensitive priorities

* Schedule can otherwise be structured flexibly around the business

* Long-term position



We are looking for someone who can work independently and manage their time well.



---



# HIRING PROCESS



We are intentionally keeping this process **short**.



### STEP 1



**Submit your video application**



### STEP 2



**Short interview with Leadara Staffing**



### STEP 3



**Interview with the founder/client**



### STEP 4



**Hire**



That's it.



We are **actively hiring and move quickly when we find the right person.**



We are not interested in putting great candidates through weeks of unnecessary interviews.



If you demonstrate the right combination of:



**Executive Support + Business Operations + AI/Automation + Initiative**



we want to move quickly.



---



# TO APPLY



Please send:



**1. Resume**



**2. Availability / earliest start date**



**3. Your 3–5 minute video**



### Put your VIDEO LINK at the very top of your application.



Your video is more important to us than a long cover letter.



We want to meet the person who can become the founder's **right hand, problem solver, and systems-minded operator** for the long term.

title: Tier-1 Support Specialist (B2B Tech Startup)
description:
Remote (Philippines) | Full-time | US business hours (EST or CST)

Reports to: Head of Tier-1 Support

Compensation: Base $1300/mo USD + Bonus applied as well



READ THIS FIRST: A self-recorded Loom video is required to apply.

No Loom, no review. Details at the bottom.



You are the first person a customer talks to, across
, live chat,

Slack Connect, inbound texts, and the occasional quick call. Your job is

to answer fast, solve most of it yourself, and hand off the rest so

cleanly that the customer never has to repeat themselves.





ABOUT PROJECT BLUE



Project Blue lets businesses send blue-bubble iMessages and SMS straight

from their CRM. No A2P registration delays, dedicated lines, intelligent

SMS fallback, HD media, and voice memos. Built for HighLevel and

integrated with HubSpot, Close, and others. We serve sales teams,

coaching groups, agencies, and high-ticket sales operations who need a

channel that actually gets replies.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



Own the front line of the queue

- Monitor the Plain queue across every active channel:
, chat, and

  Slack Connect.

- Acknowledge every inbound ticket, even when the actual fix will take

  longer.

- Hit first-response targets consistently: under 5 minutes on chat and

  Slack Connect, under 1 hour on
.



Route CRM messages into Plain

- Watch inbound text messages in the CRM for support-related requests.

- Convert them into Plain tickets so all support activity is tracked in

  one place.

- Log the original channel and customer details on every ticket you

  create.



Resolve Tier-1 issues end to end

- Solve common and FAQ-type issues using the knowledge base and help

  center.

- Walk customers through basic configuration, settings, and standard

  workflows.

- Resolve 70%+ of all tickets without escalating to a CSM.

- If it isn't solved in 15 minutes, escalate. Don't keep grinding on it

  solo.



Escalate cleanly to CSMs

- Hand off with full context: what the customer asked, what you tried,

  where it stands now.

- Tag the ticket with the account owner (CSM name) before escalating.

- Escalate billing questions, churn signals, and expansion interest

  immediately. Don't attempt those yourself.



Run Slack Connect

- Monitor and respond across all Slack Connect channels.

- For larger CSM-managed accounts, surface the message and route it to

  the CSM.

- Never leave a Slack Connect channel unacknowledged for more than 30

  minutes during work hours.



Hop on support calls when it's faster

- Jump on a quick call when a live walkthrough will resolve something

  faster than a thread.

- This is support, not account management. You're not owning the

  relationship like a CSM does.



Handle port-in and port-out requests

- Be the first point of contact for all number porting, inbound and

  outbound.

- Port-in: collect account number, PIN, current carrier, and numbers to

  port. Confirm eligibility, then submit or coordinate submission with

  the relevant internal team.

- Port-out: verify the request comes from an authorized contact, confirm

  the customer understands the service implications, then process or

  route accordingly.

- Set clear timeline expectations up front. Porting is rarely instant.

  Communicate status proactively.

- Loop in the CSM before proceeding on large accounts or anything with

  churn implications.

- Log every porting request in Plain with numbers, carrier details, and

  current status. Never let one sit more than 24 hours without an update.



Keep numbers compliant

- Handle First Orion and Hiya registrations for new and existing numbers

  provisioned to accounts, so customer traffic doesn't get flagged as

  spam.



Tag everything, without exception

- Tag every ticket by category, severity, and feature area. 100%

  compliance.

- Accurate tagging is how the whole team spots product gaps and

  recurring pain points, so this isn't busywork.



Improve the docs as you go

- Resolve something the docs don't cover? Write it up.

- Maintain and update existing help center articles as the product

  changes.

- Record a Loom when a visual explanation beats a wall of text.

- Share messaging best practices with customers where it helps them get

  more out of the product.





HOW WE MEASURE THE ROLE



First response, chat & Slack Connect .......... under 5 minutes

First response,
 ......................... under 1 hour

Slack Connect acknowledgment (work hours) ..... under 30 minutes

Tickets resolved without CSM escalation ....... 70%+

Solo troubleshooting before escalating ........ 15 minutes max

Ticket tagging compliance ..................... 100%

Max idle time on an open porting ticket ....... 24 hours





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Comfortable in CRMs: HighLevel, HubSpot, Close, or similar.

- Experience with a modern support platform. We run on Plain.

- Familiar with project management tools like Linear.

- Technically curious and AI-native. You reach for automation instead of

  doing the same manual thing twice.

- Clear, warm written communication under time pressure.

- Strong spoken and written English. You'll be on calls with US

  customers.

- Good judgment on when to solve and when to escalate.

- Genuinely organized. Tagging, logging, and follow-ups don't slip.

- Happy to get on a call and walk someone through it.



A real part of this job is improving it. A lot of our support workflows

can be automated or streamlined, and we want someone who spots those

opportunities and builds the fix rather than absorbing the busywork.





NICE TO HAVE



- Telecom or number-porting experience (LOAs, carrier coordination, port

  rejections).

- Familiarity with A2P 10DLC, First Orion, Hiya, or caller-reputation and

  spam-labeling work.

- Running support through Slack Connect with B2B accounts.

- Writing help center articles or recording Loom walkthroughs.





THE DETAILS



Location .......... Remote (Philippines)

Hours ............. US business hours, EST or CST

Reports to ........ Head of Tier-1 Support

Employment type ... Full-time

Compensation ...... [TBD]

Core tools ........ Plain, Slack, Linear, HighLevel / HubSpot





=====================================================================

  THE LOOM VIDEO IS NOT OPTIONAL

=====================================================================



We do not review applications without a self-recorded Loom video.

Not "we prefer one." Not "it helps." We will not open your resume.



If you send a resume with no Loom, your application is closed without

a reply. If you send a link to a video someone else recorded, or a

pre-made showreel, or an AI-generated presenter, same outcome.



Why: this role is customer-facing. You will be on live chat, Slack

Connect, and calls with US businesses, often while they're already

frustrated. The fastest way for us to see how you communicate is to

watch you communicate. It's also how we filter out mass-applicants and

find the people who actually read the posting.



Record it yourself, on camera, in one take. Unpolished is fine.

We're not judging your lighting.





HOW TO APPLY



Send all three of the following to 
 missing any of the three will not be reviewed.



1) Your resume.



2) A short written note about a time you took a messy, repetitive

   support process and made it better. That's the part of this role we

   care most about.



3) A 2-3 minute Loom video, recorded by you, with your camera on,

   covering:

   - Who you are.

   - Your relevant support experience.

   - How you'd handle a customer who is frustrated and escalating over

     a delayed number port. Talk us through what you'd actually say.



   Paste the Loom link directly in your
 body. Make sure the link

   is publicly viewable. We won't chase you for access.

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Position Details

Position: Administrative Assistant

Company: Residential Roofing Company

Location: Remote — Philippines

Company Location: Atlanta, Georgia, USA

Schedule: Full-time, during agreed U.S. business hours

About Us

We are a growing U.S.-based residential roofing company in Atlanta, Georgia, and we're looking for a reliable, organized, and proactive Administrative Assistant to join our team.



As our company continues to grow, we need someone who can help keep our daily operations organized and make sure important tasks, information, and follow-ups don't fall through the cracks.



This is an important role. We're looking for someone who takes ownership, pays attention to details, communicates well, and can work independently.



The Role

As our Administrative Assistant, you will provide day-to-day administrative support to our management and operations team.



You'll help keep information organized, coordinate schedules, manage documents, follow up on tasks, and support different areas of the business.



We want someone who doesn't simply complete tasks—we want someone who takes responsibility for getting things done correctly and on time.



Responsibilities

Manage
s, messages, documents, and administrative requests

Schedule and coordinate appointments and meetings

Enter and maintain accurate information in spreadsheets and CRM systems

Help create and maintain company procedures and checklists



Assist with special projects as the company grows



Identify opportunities to improve organization and efficiency



What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:



Highly organized



Detail-oriented



Reliable and dependable



Proactive and self-motivated



Excellent at following up



Comfortable working independently

CRM systems

The Person We're Looking For

The right candidate doesn't wait around for someone to tell them what to do.



If you finish your assigned work, you should be asking:

You should be able to:

title: Operations & Administrative Assistant | 100% Remote | US-Based Company | $240 Biweekly
description:

Schedule: 6 days per week, 8 hours per day

Bonus Leave Benefit: Earn 2 hours of paid vacation leave for every hour worked on the mandatory sixth day.



About Bee Man Dan



Bee Man Dan is a growing company based in Houston, Texas, specializing in humane bee and wasp removal.



We help homeowners and businesses safely resolve bee-related problems through our no-pest
 approach, thermal imaging technology, and live bee extraction services.



We are looking for a reliable, organized, and proactive Operations & Administrative Assistant to join our remote team in the Philippines.



You'll work closely with our Operations Manager and help keep our customer service, daily operations, administrative tasks, and financial records organized.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys helping customers, solving problems, and keeping things running smoothly behind the scenes.



We value reliability, initiative, clear communication, and a willingness to learn.



What You'll Be Doing



Your responsibilities will cover four main areas.



1. Customer Service & Phone Support

Answer incoming customer calls professionally and assist with service inquiries.

Help coordinate customer appointments and scheduling.

Make outbound calls for customer follow-ups and community outreach.

Provide phone coverage during assigned shifts, including weekend coverage when our dedicated phone-support team member is on a rest day.

Ensure customer inquiries and important follow-ups are handled promptly.
