Assist the Operations Manager with daily administrative and operational tasks.

Manage and maintain our ClickUp workspace, including tasks, lists, and records.

Keep company information accurate, organized, and up to date.

Help ensure important tasks and operational activities run smoothly.

Support improvements to our internal organization and processes.



3. Executive Assistance

Assist our CEO with
 and calendar management.

Help coordinate meetings, appointments, and schedules.

Organize correspondence and important follow-up items.

Provide general executive and administrative support as needed.



4. Bookkeeping & Financial Administration

Maintain day-to-day bookkeeping records using Xero.

Assist with recordkeeping and reconciliation tasks.

Help organize financial documents and maintain accurate records.



You don't need experience in the bee removal industry. We'll help you learn about our services and company-specific processes.



Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who is dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable communicating with customers and team members.



Required Qualifications



Clear and professional spoken and written English.

Previous experience in customer service, virtual assistance, administration, or a related role.

Comfortable answering customer calls and communicating over the phone.

Strong organizational and time management skills.

Experience managing tasks,
, and calendars.

Comfortable using computers, online tools, and Google Workspace.

Able to work independently and handle multiple responsibilities.

Reliable internet connection and a quiet environment suitable for customer calls.

Available to work six days per week during the agreed Houston-time schedule.



Preferred Skills — An Advantage, But Not Required



Previous BPO or US customer service experience.

Experience administering ClickUp or similar project management software.

Familiarity with Xero, QuickBooks, or other bookkeeping tools.

Executive assistant experience.

Previous experience working remotely for a US-based company.



We welcome applicants with transferable skills who are confident in their ability to learn new systems.



Compensation, Work Schedule & Leave Benefits



We believe in being transparent about compensation and working arrangements.



Compensation



$240 USD, paid every two weeks.



Work Arrangement



100% remote — work from home in the Philippines.

Six working days per week.

Eight hours per working day.

Total scheduled working hours: 48 hours per week.

Working hours follow Houston, Texas (Central Time).

Exact daily shift and weekly rest day will be confirmed during the hiring process.



Sixth-Day Vacation Leave Benefit



The sixth working day is a mandatory part of this role.



Instead of additional cash overtime pay, hours worked on the sixth day earn paid vacation leave at a rate of 2 hours of leave for every 1 hour worked.



For example:



Work 2 hours on the sixth day → Earn 4 hours of paid vacation leave.

Work 4 hours on the sixth day → Earn 8 hours of paid vacation leave.

Work the full 8-hour sixth day → Earn 16 hours of paid vacation leave.

mber without jargon

title: B2B Sales Representative (Full-Cycle, Enterprise Accounts)
description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MedPro Disposal is the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company, serving 35,000+ healthcare providers across 48 states for the past 15 years. On that foundation, we launched MP1 Solutions to pioneer the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined healthcare compliance for decades. MP1 Solutions extends MedPro Disposal's operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading — with a technology-forward approach that's making this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that, backed by 15 years of MedPro Disposal's operational credibility — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:



We're hiring a full-cycle Enterprise Sales Representative to own a high-volume outbound pipeline from first touch to close — and then keep owning that book of accounts after the deal closes. This isn't a hand-off model: you prospect it, qualify it, close it, and grow it. You'll work a defined territory of B2B accounts (non-acute healthcare strongly preferred), carry an individual quota, and partner closely with Marketing, Operations, and Compliance to keep every account you land running smoothly.



Key Responsibilities:



• Own a full-cycle, high-volume outbound sales pipeline — prospecting and generating net-new demand within a defined book of B2B accounts (non-acute healthcare preferred; multi-location or multinational commercial accounts also considered)

• Execute structured outbound campaigns — cold calling,
/sequence outreach, LinkedIn and social prospecting, and referral or win-back calling — to build and continuously refill a self-sourced pipeline

• Run full-cycle deal ownership: qualify opportunities, present tailored proposals, negotiate terms, and close net-new business without handing off to a separate closer

• Own the end-to-end relationship for your book of accounts post-close — resolving service needs and identifying upsell, cross-sell, and renewal opportunities

• Carry and consistently deliver against an individual sales quota, with disciplined tracking of prospecting activity, pipeline creation, and quota attainment

• Run a structured, discovery-driven sales process — identifying decision-makers and gatekeepers, uncovering pain points, positioning MedPro/MP1's value proposition, and driving every conversation to a clear next step or close

• Maintain rigorous CRM hygiene (Salesforce or equivalent), accurate pipeline staging, and forecast reporting

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Operations, and Compliance for smooth account setup/onboarding, and participate in ongoing sales enablement — coaching, call reviews, and objection-handling refinement



Required Qualifications



• 5+ years of full-cycle B2B sales experience with a background in proactive prospecting and outbound sales, and a demonstrated, verifiable track record of consistent quota attainment across an end-to-end, close-your-own-book sales cycle

• High-volume, B2B non-acute healthcare sales experience strongly preferred; candidates without direct healthcare background must show comparable experience selling into other regulated, multi-location, or multinational commercial accounts, plus demonstrated experience owning a book of accounts end-to-end (not a pure hunter-only or farmer-only profile)

• CRM proficiency (Salesforce or equivalent), comfort with sales engagement/sequencing tools (e.g., Outreach, Salesloft), and metrics-driven pipeline management

• Bachelor's degree preferred; relevant experience considered in lieu of a degree



Preferred Qualifications:



• Experience selling into healthcare, dental, or other regulated/compliance-driven verticals, or a clearly transferable regulated-services sales background

• Experience selling against an entrenched incumbent competitor (competitive displacement sales)

• Prior experience on an offshore/PH-based team supporting a US sales organization



Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:30 PM CST (aligned to US Enterprise Sales team hours)

Work Arrangement: Full-time, remote (Philippines)

description:
Appointment Setter — B2B USA



Remote · Cold Calls · Commercial Roofing and Solar · US Market



ABOUT THE COMPANY

NJ Solar Systems is building a structured B2B commercial roofing and solar outbound operation in the United States. Our process is: prioritized lead → decision-maker contact → qualification → booked meeting or inspection → documented next action in the CRM.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We need a strong Appointment Setter who speaks English confidently, can navigate gatekeepers, reach business owners and executives, and book qualified meetings. You must be able to listen, ask precise questions, and secure a real next step.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Make outbound B2B cold calls to selected US companies.

• Navigate gatekeepers and reach Owner / President / CFO / COO / Facilities Manager.

• Explain the reason for the call clearly and briefly, without pressure or unsupported promises.

• Identify roof condition, leaks, timing, interest in solar, utility-cost level, and readiness for a next step.

• Book qualified meetings or inspections and confirm the appointment.

• Record disposition, notes, follow-up, and next action accurately in the CRM.

• Work through the assigned cadence and return to promising contacts.



WHAT MATTERS TO US

• Spoken English at B2–C2 level.

• Experience in cold calling, appointment setting, lead qualification, or sales; US-client experience is an advantage.

• Ability to handle rejection, gatekeepers, and the objection “just send an
” calmly.

• Strong CRM discipline and ownership of the next step.

• Stable internet, computer, quality headset, and backup connection.

• Availability for an agreed shift overlapping US Eastern Time business hours.

• Willingness to have work calls recorded for QA and coaching.



HOW RESULTS ARE MEASURED

• Number of call attempts and consistency against the activity plan.

• Connect rate and percentage of conversations with the correct decision-maker.

• Number of meaningful conversations.

• Qualified meetings per 100 calls and show rate.

• Accuracy of CRM data, dispositions, and next actions.



WHAT WE OFFER

• Remote work in a US B2B market.

• Scripts, objection map, training, and call reviews.

• A paid trial period before the final hiring decision.

• Fixed compensation plus performance bonuses; exact terms are agreed before the paid trial.

• Growth in responsibility: calling and qualification → gatekeeper / decision-maker / appointment → follow-up and CRM → full cycle.



SELECTION PROCESS

• Application form and English voice recording.

• Short screening interview.

• Practical role-play: gatekeeper, decision-maker, and objection handling.

• Paid trial period with transparent KPIs.

• Final decision based on call quality, discipline, and results.



HOW TO APPLY

REQUIRED: Complete the application form and attach a 2–3 minute English voice recording. Explain your B2B experience, the largest contract or opportunity you worked on and your role, your biggest failure, its cause, and what you would do differently now. At the end, enter the code phrase PIPELINE-NJ:

title: Automotive Estimator
description:
AUTOMOTIVE OPERATIONS & DISPATCH COORDINATOR

-We’re hiring a high-performing, detail-obsessed Operations Coordinator to help us run and grow a mobile automotive shop in Austin, Texas — a premium mobile tire and oil change business serving performance car owners and select fleets in the Austin metro area.

-This is a hybrid customer-facing and backend operations role. You’ll be responsible for making sure the daily work gets done accurately, efficiently, and on time — coordinating jobs, processing approvals, managing tech schedules, tracking AR, and keeping our customers in the loop.

-You’ll also assist with light marketing coordination (e.g., newsletter support, gathering photos from the team) — just a few hours weekly.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Fleet & Retail Ops Coordination

-Own the estimate-to-approval-to-route workflow:

-Create and submit estimates

-Follow up for approval

-Ensure parts are sourced

-Finalize tech routes for the following day

-Track all jobs in progress and flag issues proactively

-Ensure routes are realistic and efficient; confirm techs are prepped and ready

-Communicate clearly with customers and fleet managers about job timing, status, and follow-ups

-Submit and close out fleet approvals in Element, LeasePlan, and AutoIntegrate

-Ensure invoices match approvals; follow up on outstanding invoices and missing payments



2. Scheduling & Productivity Tracking

-Maintain the daily technician schedule, making updates as needed

-Monitor tech productivity; flag idle time, reschedules, or delays

-Track time logs and coordinate with bookkeeper for payroll



3. Customer Communication

-Respond to incoming texts, WhatsApp messages, and system inquiries in a timely, professional manner

-Follow up with clients as needed to resolve open issues or gather job-related info

-Escalate concerns appropriately and promptly



4. Admin & Reporting

-Submit a detailed Daily Recap covering completed work, pending tasks, blockers, and KPIs

-Keep Trello and other tools up-to-date with accurate job and task statuses

-Track inventory needs and coordinate ordering of parts, oil, and supplies

-Monitor A/R and follow up on past-due fleet invoices



5. Marketing & Content Support

-Publish our monthly newsletter in MailChimp with content from marketing team

-Coordinate publishing of content to Instagram /
 / Google My Business

-Other light admin support as needed for the marketing team

-What Success Looks Like

-All work orders, estimates, approvals, and tech routes are handled with zero dropped balls

-You identify blockers or problems before they become fires

-Communication is clear, timely, and professional — with both customers and internal team

-The business runs like a machine — nothing gets missed or delayed

-You take full ownership of your responsibilities and require very little follow-up



Who You Are

-A natural systems thinker who thrives on clarity, organization, and ownership

-Extremely proactive — you don’t wait to be told what to do

-Excellent at written and verbal English communication

-Comfortable in the automotive world and eager to learn the details

-Sharp and reliable — you retain info, spot gaps, and follow through



Experience & Skills Required

-3+ years of experience in a remote automotive: coordinator, dispatcher, operations role

-Demonstrated responsibility for keeping things moving without handholding

-Excellent written and spoken English

-Experience with dispatch, route planning, or technician scheduling

-Familiar with tools like Slack, Google Docs, Trello (or similar), CRM/invoicing platforms

-Experience working with U.S.-based field service, auto, or fleet companies

-Bonus: Familiarity with AutoIntegrate, Housecall Pro, Element, or LeasePlan platforms



Required Software Experience

-Slack

-WhatsApp

-Trello (or similar)

-Google Workspace

-CRM / invoicing tools (Housecall Pro, AutoIntegrate)


 (plus)

-Computer - at least i5 or equivalent with 8gb RAM

-Internet Speed - At least 50 MBPS Download speed

-Dual monitor setup is required to ensure efficiency in managing multiple applications simultaneously.



Location: Remote (Philippines)

Schedule: Part-time, US hours



Schedule

-Monday–Friday: 8:00 AM–7:00 PM CST

-Saturday: 10:00 AM–4:00 PM CST

-Sunday: 12:00 PM–4:00 PM CST

Note: Flexibility is required, as the shift schedule may change. The schedule consists of 7 shifts across 2 weeks.

title: Bookkeeper – MYOB Australian Experience Required
description:
Australian-Experienced MYOB Bookkeeper (Philippines) – Immediate Start



Remote | Philippines | Part-Time Ongoing | Immediate Start

PHP 300–400/hour depending on experience — higher rate considered for an exceptional candidate



We are a growing Australian digital media business looking for an experienced Philippines-based Xero Bookkeeper to take responsibility for the day-to-day bookkeeping of our Australian company.



This is not an entry-level position.



You must have previous hands-on bookkeeping experience for Australian businesses, strong MYOB experience, and practical knowledge of Australian GST and BAS preparation.



Immediate Priority



Our bookkeeping is currently several months behind, so the first priority is to bring our Xero accounts fully up to date.



We need someone who can start immediately and dedicate additional hours during the initial catch-up period.



Once the catch-up is complete, this will become an ongoing part-time role, expected to be approximately 10–15 hours per week, with the potential to grow.



About the Business



We are an Australian digital media and content business operating multiple YouTube channels, websites, Amazon influencer/affiliate businesses and international brand partnerships.



We operate through an Australian GST-registered company and use Xero.



Our income and expenses include:



* Australian and international brand partnerships

* Amazon and affiliate income

* AUD and USD payments

* International payment platforms

* Australian and overseas contractors and suppliers

* Normal Australian business expenses



Because of this, experience with multi-currency and online/international businesses would be particularly useful.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



* Bringing our existing MYOB bookkeeping fully up to date

* Ongoing bookkeeping in MYOB

* Bank and credit-card reconciliations

* Correctly categorising income and expenses

* Correct Australian GST coding

* Preparing accurate accounts and records for BAS reporting

* Reconciling AUD and foreign-currency transactions

* Recording and reconciling international brand and affiliate income

* Contractor and supplier transactions

* Receipts, invoices and supporting documentation

* Reviewing unreconciled or unusual transactions

* Identifying missing documentation and requesting what you need

* Month-end reconciliations

* Maintaining accurate, current accounts

* Liaising with our Australian accountant/BAS agent when required



REQUIRED Experience



Please apply only if you have:



* Previous professional bookkeeping experience for Australian businesses

* Strong, recent hands-on Xero experience

* Practical Australian GST experience

* Experience preparing bookkeeping/accounts for BAS

* Bank and credit-card reconciliation experience

* Experience reviewing and correcting existing bookkeeping

* Good understanding of accounting/bookkeeping principles

* Excellent attention to detail

* Good written and spoken English

* Ability to work independently and take ownership of the accounts



Applicants without Australian bookkeeping + MYOB + GST/BAS experience will not be considered.



Highly Regarded



The following are advantageous but not mandatory:



* Xero Advisor Certification

* Accounting or bookkeeping qualification

* Bachelor of Accounting/Accountancy or similar

* Experience working with Australian accountants or BAS agents

* Multi-currency bookkeeping

* AUD/USD transactions

* Wise, PayPal or Stripe reconciliation

* Amazon or affiliate income

* E-commerce, digital media or online-business experience



What We Want



We are looking for someone who understands the accounts rather than simply entering transactions.



If something does not reconcile, investigate it.



If something appears to have been coded incorrectly, flag it.



If information or documentation is missing, ask for it.



If you are uncertain about the GST treatment of a transaction, do not guess.



We want someone reliable who can take ownership of the bookkeeping and keep it current going forward.



For the right person, this is intended to be a stable, long-term role.



Pay



PHP 300–400 per hour depending on experience and qualifications.



We will consider a higher rate for an exceptional candidate with extensive Australian Xero, GST and bookkeeping experience.



Additional hours will be available initially while the bookkeeping is brought up to date.



How to Apply



Start your application with:



XERO AUSTRALIA



Please send your CV/resume and answer these 7 questions:



1. How many years have you worked as a bookkeeper for Australian businesses?

2. How many years of professional Xero experience do you have, and are you currently Xero certified?

3. What accounting or bookkeeping qualifications do you hold?

4. Briefly describe your practical experience with Australian GST and preparing accounts/records for BAS.

5. Have you handled AUD/USD, Wise, PayPal, Amazon, affiliate or other international transactions in Xero? Please briefly explain.

6. Have you taken over an Australian Xero file where the bookkeeping was several months behind? If yes, briefly explain what you did.

7. When can you start, how many hours can you dedicate to the initial catch-up over the next two weeks, and what is your expected hourly rate in PHP?



Please answer each question directly.



Generic applications that do not demonstrate Australian Xero and GST/BAS experience will not progress to interview.

title: Tax Operations Associate
description:
DiLucci CPA Firm - Tax Operations Associate



Compensation: $6/hour (USD)

Schedule: Full-Time: 40+ hours per week (9am - 6pm US CST)

During tax season, additional hours and weekend availability will be required as needed to meet client and firm deadlines.

Location: Remote - Philippines



Role Overview

If you enjoy creating efficient systems, keeping projects moving, and ensuring every tax engagement is delivered accurately and on time, our Tax Operations Associate role is for you.



We want to be very transparent - we are the place people go to grow, not to relax. We work more, we work on harder returns, and we enjoy it. If you're not ready to work evenings and weekends during tax season, and to also focus on quality/learning throughout the year, you will hate it here.



DiLucci CPA Firm has been serving business owners and real estate investors since 2005. For nearly two decades, we've built a reputation for doing tax differently—by going deeper than compliance, telling clients the truth, and using the tax code strategically to protect and grow their wealth. Our mission is simple: help clients keep more of what they earn while giving them clarity, confidence, and a long-term plan. We value enjoying what we do (what we call Fun Tax Energy), moving with speed, and operating independently with a focus on the outcome.



As our Tax Operations Associate, you will support the day-to-day operations of the tax team by staying client focused on follow up regarding tax and accounting open items. You'll play a key role in creating operational excellence while allowing our tax professionals to focus on delivering exceptional client service.



This is a fast-paced, detail-oriented role for someone who enjoys ownership, problem-solving, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



Key Responsibilities

1. Open Items Follow Up

- Review open-item requests prepared by the tax or accounting team.

- Confirm that requested documents or information are actually missing before contacting the client.

- Contact clients regarding outstanding documents, unanswered questions, signatures, approvals, and other required action items.

- Follow up consistently until each item is resolved.

- Track every request, response, follow-up date, and current status in the firm’s systems.

- Escalate unresponsive clients or time-sensitive issues before they affect deadlines.

- Avoid requesting documents or information that the client has already provided.

2. Client Communication

- Serve as the primary point of contact for clients regarding outstanding items.

- Clearly explain what is needed, why it is needed, and when it is due.

- Send concise, professional, and easy-to-understand follow-up messages.

- Respond promptly to client questions related to document requests and next steps.

- Maintain a helpful but persistent approach when multiple follow-ups are required.

- Ensure clients always understand their remaining responsibilities.

3. Document Review and Organization

- Review submitted documents to confirm that the requested item was received.

- Identify incomplete, unreadable, incorrect, or missing documents.

- Upload, categorize, and organize files in the appropriate client folder or system.

- Update open-item lists immediately when documents or responses are received.

- Confirm that resolved items are properly closed before work is returned to the tax or accounting team.

4. Internal Coordination

- Communicate with tax preparers, reviewers, bookkeepers, and other team members regarding unresolved items.

- Ask internal team members for clarification when a request is unclear or appears duplicative.

- Provide clear status updates on clients with outstanding items.

- Notify the appropriate team member when all requested information has been received.

- Escalate technical tax or accounting questions rather than attempting to answer them independently.

5. Deadline Management

- Monitor due dates associated with open requests.

- Prioritize follow-ups based on filing deadlines, internal deadlines, and engagement urgency.

- Follow up before outstanding items become urgent.

- Maintain accurate tracking so the team has visibility into delayed or unresponsive clients.

- Ensure no engagement is delayed without documented follow-up and escalation.



Role Expectations

- Open-item requests are accurate and do not duplicate information already provided.

- Clients receive timely, clear, and professional follow-up.

- Outstanding items are followed through to completion rather than simply requested once.

- Client responses and documents are accurately tracked and organized.

- Unresponsive clients are escalated early.

- The tax and accounting teams can quickly see what is missing and what has been received.

- No engagement falls behind because an open item was forgotten or not followed up on.



Requirements

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Accounting, Tax, Bookkeeping, Finance, or a related field

- Required: Previous experience supporting U.S. tax preparation or tax operations in a CPA firm or tax practice

- Strong understanding of the U.S. tax return preparation process for both individual and business tax engagements

- Familiarity with the following U.S. tax forms is strongly preferred:

1. Individual Tax Forms

Form 1040 – U.S. Individual Income Tax Return

Schedule A – Itemized Deductions

Schedule B – Interest and Ordinary Dividends

Schedule C – Profit or Loss from Business

Schedule D – Capital Gains and Losses

Schedule E – Supplemental Income and Loss

Form 4562 – Depreciation and Amortization

Form 4797 – Sales of Business Property

Form 8582 – Passive Activity Loss Limitations

title: Experienced Video Editor – Long-Form YouTube – Remote PH
description:
Ongoing Remote Role | Consistent Work | Paid Per Project



MrYouWho is an established global tech-review network with 280K+ YouTube subscribers and 16 channels across YouTube, Amazon and social media.



We’re looking for an experienced long-form YouTube video editor for regular ongoing work.



You’ll be editing 10–15 minute tech and product-review videos from clean, scripted teleprompter footage. B-roll is supplied and our editing process and style are already established.



This is not an entry-level position, and we’re not looking for someone whose main experience is Shorts, Reels or TikTok.



Before applying, watch MrYouWho on YouTube. That’s the style and standard you’ll be expected to match.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



* Edit 10–15 minute long-form YouTube product reviews

* Work from clean, scripted teleprompter/talking-head footage

* Integrate supplied B-roll throughout the video

* Add text, overlays, graphics and music where appropriate

* Clean up cuts, pacing and audio

* Follow our established editing style and workflow

* Deliver completed edits within 24 hours of receiving the footage

* Complete reasonable revisions when required

* Occasionally create vertical clips from completed videos



Our footage is clean and the format is repeatable. Once familiar with our workflow, an experienced editor should generally be able to complete a standard video in approximately 5–6 hours or less.



YOU MUST HAVE



* Proven experience editing long-form YouTube videos

* Experience editing talking-head/voiceover content with B-roll

* A portfolio showing relevant long-form work

* Strong English comprehension

* Experience with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or CapCut Desktop

* A capable editing computer

* Fast, stable internet for large video files

* Excellent attention to detail

* Ability to follow scripts and established processes

* Ability to work independently

* Reliable communication

* Ability to meet 24-hour turnaround times



PAYMENT & WORKLOAD



This is an ongoing, per-project position.



You will be paid an agreed rate for each completed and approved video rather than an hourly wage.



We have consistent ongoing video production, so there is regular work available for editors who demonstrate the required quality, speed and reliability.



Standard videos are generally 10–15 minutes finished length, with clean scripted footage and B-roll supplied.



Rates will be agreed based on your experience, portfolio and demonstrated ability to work efficiently within our production system.



Editors who consistently deliver excellent work can receive more projects and higher rates over time.



This is intended to develop into a long-term working relationship, not occasional one-off freelance work.



HOW TO APPLY



Keep your answers short and answer each question directly.



1. Send 2–3 links to long-form YouTube videos you personally edited. Talking-head/voiceover videos using B-roll are preferred.

2. What editing software do you use?

3. What are your computer specifications? Include CPU, RAM and GPU.

4. What is your approximate internet download/upload speed?

5. If you receive clean scripted footage and supplied B-roll, approximately how long would you expect to take to complete a polished 10–15 minute product-review video?

6. What would you charge per completed 10–15 minute video of this type?

7. Can you reliably deliver a completed video within 24 hours of receiving the footage? Yes/No

8. Approximately how many videos of this type could you reliably complete each week?



At the very end of your application, write:



REVIEWS



Applications without relevant long-form YouTube editing examples will not be considered.

title: Driver Recruiter
description:
GH Logistics is expanding its recruitment team and is seeking a proactive, confident, and highly independent Driver Recruiter to support our CDL driver recruitment efforts across our trucking operations.



We are looking for someone who is comfortable making high volume outbound calls, engaging driver prospects, qualifying candidates, and maintaining an active recruitment pipeline. This is a phone first and high activity position that requires strong English communication, persistence, organization, and the ability to work independently without constant supervision.



A major focus of this position will be calling CDL driver prospects, following up with potential candidates, and submitting qualified drivers to our Recruitment Lead for further processing.



Role Overview

You will support GH Logistics' driver recruitment efforts by working through daily lead lists, contacting prospective CDL drivers, assessing their qualifications, and maintaining consistent follow-up throughout the recruitment process.



You will be expected to take ownership of assigned leads from initial contact through qualified submission, document recruitment activities accurately, and coordinate with the Recruitment Lead and other departments to move qualified candidates forward.



This is a fast-paced, results-driven role where consistency, call volume, communication, and follow-through are essential. You should be comfortable spending a significant portion of your shift making outbound calls, handling rejection professionally, and maintaining productivity without constant reminders.



You will report directly to our Recruiting Lead, Destiny Conley, and collaborate with the recruitment, onboarding, and fleet operations teams.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Work through assigned daily lead lists and proactively contact prospective CDL drivers through outbound cold calls.

• Qualify driver prospects based on license class, driving experience, availability, interest, and other recruitment requirements.

• Maintain consistent follow up with warm leads, interested drivers, and candidates requiring additional information.

• Manage assigned recruitment leads from initial contact through qualified submission.

• Accurately document all calls, candidate information, statuses, notes, and next steps in the company's CRM.

• Maintain an organized recruitment pipeline and ensure no qualified leads are overlooked.

• Submit qualified driver profiles with complete and accurate information to the Recruiting Lead.

• Coordinate candidate handoffs with the onboarding and fleet operations teams.

• Work toward daily call volume targets, driver connection goals, and weekly qualified submission targets.

• Review inbound leads and pending follow-ups to prioritize daily recruitment activities.

• Provide end-of-day recruitment updates, including calls made, driver connections, qualified submissions, and pipeline status.

• Take ownership of recruitment activities and proactively identify opportunities to improve lead engagement and candidate conversion.



What Success Looks Like

• Consistently completing 60 - 80 outbound calls per day.

• Achieving approximately 15 - 20 driver connections daily.

• Generating 5 - 10 qualified driver submissions per week.

• Maintaining accurate and complete CRM records with no undocumented calls.

• Following up with warm leads within the same day.

• Keeping the recruitment pipeline active, organized, and updated.

• Submitting qualified drivers with complete information for the next stage of recruitment.

• Maintaining consistent communication with the Recruiting Lead.

• Demonstrating persistence, professionalism, and productivity throughout the shift.

• Independently managing assigned leads and recruitment activities without constant supervision.



Performance is reviewed weekly by the Recruiting Lead, with an emphasis on consistent activity, call volume, documentation, and recruitment results.



Who We’re Looking For

• Previous experience recruiting CDL drivers or candidates for the US trucking industry is strongly preferred.

• Confident making high volume outbound calls, qualifying driver prospects, handling objections, and maintaining consistent follow ups.

• Clear, confident, and professional spoken English with the ability to engage effectively with US-based drivers.

• Able to manage leads, track candidate progress, maintain accurate records, and organize recruitment activities efficiently.

• Highly independent, persistent, and accountable, with the ability to meet daily call targets and weekly recruitment goals without constant supervision.

• Reliable, punctual, and organized, with a stable internet connection and a quiet, professional calling environment.

• Typing speed at least 50 words per minute



What You'll Get

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Paid biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Stable & long-term position. This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.

• Direct access to US executive leadership. You're not buried in a call center reporting to a middle manager. You work directly with our operations team.



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full Time Remote Role| Direct Hire to US Company

• Current Shift Availability: Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Central Time

• Zoom presence (with camera open) required

• Time tracking software used for accountability and performance support



If you are someone who confidently picks up the phone, enjoys connecting with people, can independently work through a recruitment pipeline, and understands the persistence required to recruit CDL drivers, we want to hear from you.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Creative QA who can review and quality-check storyboards and animation projects before they move to the next stage who can start ASAP during October-November. The ideal candidate understands both design and animation workflows. Someone who can design storyboards and also has experience with motion graphics/animation is highly preferred, as they can better understand the process from the initial design all the way through animation. Being able to animate is not a hard requirement, but you should understand how animation works, how storyboard designs translate into motion, and what to look for when reviewing work. Key Responsibilities

Design Review: Identify issues with layout, composition, typography, visual hierarchy, assets, and consistency.



Process Check: Make sure designs are properly prepared and make sense from a design- to-animation workflow.

Project-Based: Engagement occurs on a per-project basis with clear delivery milestones.



Flexible Remote Work: Work from your own space while coordinating with an international team.





Required Skills & Qualifications

Strong storyboarding/design skills.

Experience reviewing or working with motion graphics is a strong advantage.



Motion graphics/animation experience is preferred but not required.

description:
GENERAL PURPOSE OF JOB

Wheeler Home Concepts is a premium real estate photography and marketing company serving Delaware and the surrounding areas. We specialize in high-quality photography, video, and digital media, for Realtors and businesses. Our reputation is built on excellence, creativity, and top-tier service.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, highly organized, and skilled in creative software tools. This role will grow to the option for a full-time role, or can stay part-time if the candidate prefers.



Must provide a link to a portfolio of your work with your application. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.



ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.



Photography & Media Support

• MLS Real Estate Videos: Create cinematic style horizontal property videos for real estate..

• Photobooth Display Videos: Design and update photobooth overlays and templates, as needed.

• Reels Editing: Create short-form video content (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) using Premier Pro, Final Cut, or DaVinci Resolve.

• Long-form video editing: Interviews, podcasts, etc.

• AI Video Generation/Prompting: Use AI video generation tools to help bring creative and unique ideas to life to add to our video content.

• Assist with Writing and Maintaining Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs): Document processes and workflows to improve efficiency.

• Organization: Maintain organized records and files of images, projects, and updates in our system.



ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS

• We hire for attitude and train for skill, but experience in general administrative tasks is helpful

• Must be able to work flexible hours; Ability to work with a sense of urgency when focusing on a task

• Communicate professionally in English, both verbally and in writing; comfortably interface with clients

• Ability to maintain a positive rapport with co-workers, Realtors, and clients a must

• Carry out duties in compliance with all state and federal regulations, codes and guidelines; Comply with all company policies and procedures

• Ability to perform repetitive tasks while maintaining speed of work and attention to detail without loss to production



Required Skills & Experience

• 2+ years of demonstrated experience with:

• Premier Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro (Reels/Video Editing)

• Adobe After Effects or similar motion graphics software

• Microsoft Office (Word, Excel)

• Must have a reliable computer capable of running the required applications and 4K60 video.

• Must have fast, reliable internet for remote collaboration.

• Good to excellent English skills (spoken & written) for communication, documentation, and team collaboration.

• Must be able to work 8am-Noon Monday-Saturday, Eastern Standard Time (4 hrs). There is potential for this to become a full-time job for the right candidate.



This is primarily a video editing role. Below are detailed descriptions of the skills required for this role.



--- Must-Have Skills (Absolute Needs) ---



Extreme File Organization & Project Archiving: Exceptional discipline in project folder structures, asset naming conventions, and systematic backup workflows. All raw footage, project files, assets, and final exports must be archived so any project can be re-opened instantly for client revisions.



Versatile Multi-Style Editing (Podcasts & Talking Heads): High versatility across formats—from fast-paced 9:16 short-form reels to multi-camera long-form podcast edits (multi-cam switching, speaker reframing, pacing, and audio balancing).



Multi-Project Daily Capacity & Rapid Execution: Proven ability to manage, prioritize, and deliver multiple video edits per day under tight real estate deadlines using proxy workflows, templates, keyboard shortcuts, and batch exporting. Real Estate jobs are typically delivered within 24-48hrs.



Proactive Content Ideation & Simple Concepts: Ability to spot trending social media formats, identify viral hooks, and pitch simple, easy-to-execute content ideas that real estate agents can quickly film on camera.



Non-Linear Editing (NLE) Suite Mastery (Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve): Expert proficiency in at least one professional desktop NLE—Adobe Premiere Pro, Apple Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve—with a clean, standardized timeline and bin structure.



Manual Color Correction & Grading: Strong technical ability to manually color correct and grade footage using vectorscopes, waveform monitors, and primary/secondary color controls (e.g., Lumetri Color, DaVinci Color Page) to deliver accurate skin tones and true-to-life interior colors without relying on automated filters.



Complex Motion Captions & Typography: Mastery in creating dynamic, animated, and highly legible text overlays (word-by-word highlights, callouts, brand fonts) designed to retain viewer attention on talking-head clips.

Social Export & Encoding Standards: Thorough knowledge of optimal platform export settings (H.264/HEVC, optimal bitrates, frame rates, color spaces) to ensure fast rendering and crystal-clear playback across all major platforms.



Speed Ramping, Motion Tracking & Masking: Advanced technical proficiency in speed ramping (smooth velocity curves for walkthroughs and transitions), motion tracking (attaching captions, callouts, or graphics to moving subjects), and masking (custom reveals, subject isolation, and targeted color adjustments).



Professional Sound Design & Multi-Track Audio Mixing: Expert ability to clean up low-quality audio, remove room echoes/reverb, balance multi-mic podcast setups, level agent vocals against background tracks, and layer subtle sound effects (swooshes, impacts, risers, ambient fills) to make videos feel polished and high-energy.



Advanced AI Prompting & Standout Creative Generation: Proven ability to craft highly specific, sophisticated text, image, and video prompts across generative AI platforms (e.g., video diffusion, generative fill, expansion tools) to create unique, high-end visual effects, cinematic property extensions, and signature styles that stand out from standard AI templates.



--- Nice-to-Have Skills (Preferred Extras) ---



CapCut Desktop Proficiency: Ability to leverage CapCut Desktop for ultra-fast social edits, trending audio syncs, or rapid template builds when same-day turnaround is needed.



Motion Graphics (After Effects or Apple Motion): Experience creating or customizing lower thirds, animated property stats, transition overlays, or reusable graphics templates.



Real Estate Content Familiarity: Pre-existing understanding of property walkthrough flow, architectural framing, and real estate social media marketing trends.

title: Meta Ads Specialist - B2B Lead Gen
description:
ABOUT TOP PROVIDER



Top Provider helps businesses make confident buying decisions by matching them with vendors that fit their specific needs. We are a small, profitable, and growing team looking for a hands-on Meta Ads specialist to own paid social buyer acquisition.



This is a builder role. You will develop the strategy, create the campaigns and advertising assets, manage performance, and own the results. You should be able to operate independently, identify opportunities, and turn ideas into live tests without needing detailed instructions.



We use modern AI tools to work faster and expect you to do the same.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN



Meta Ads Strategy and Execution



Own Meta advertising from end to end, including account structure, campaign creation, audiences, budgets, bidding, optimization, and scaling.



Develop a distinct advertising strategy for each business category based on its buyers, pain points, value proposition, economics, and conversion behavior.



Apply current Meta best practices across broad targeting, Advantage+ features, retargeting, lookalike audiences, campaign structure, attribution, and testing.



Creative Development



Own the creative process, including researching buyer pain points, developing advertising angles, writing copy, and producing or coordinating static and video assets.



Use AI and creative tools to develop and iterate on advertising concepts quickly.



Maintain a consistent pipeline of new concepts, hooks, formats, and variations.



Evaluate creative performance and turn the results into clear direction for the next round of testing.



Performance Management



Manage budgets and optimize toward qualified leads, cost per lead, revenue, and return on ad spend.



Monitor performance, identify problems early, and make informed decisions about where to scale, reduce spend, or change direction.



Understand the difference between generating inexpensive leads and generating leads that create real business value.



Measurement and Reporting



Own weekly and monthly reporting for Meta Ads.



Track spend, leads, CPL, conversion rates, lead quality, revenue, and ROI.



Work with Meta Pixel, Conversions API, Events Manager, UTMs, and offline conversion data to maintain reliable measurement.



Translate campaign data into clear recommendations and next steps.



Landing Pages and Conversion



Recommend landing page, form, offer, and funnel improvements based on campaign performance.



Collaborate with the team on landing page development and conversion-rate testing.



Evaluate the full buyer journey rather than treating the ad platform as a standalone system.



Growth and Category Strategy



Research the markets and buyer profiles for the categories you support.



Recommend new audiences, offers, campaign types, creative angles, and growth opportunities.



Build a repeatable approach that can be applied across multiple B2B categories while recognizing that each category may require a different strategy.



WHO YOU ARE



You are a hands-on Meta advertiser who can independently turn a business objective into a campaign strategy and execute it.



You take ownership of outcomes rather than waiting for a list of tasks.



You are strong with both creative strategy and performance analysis.



You are comfortable forming a point of view, explaining your reasoning, and changing direction when the data supports it.



You understand that effective Meta advertising requires frequent creative development, disciplined testing, and reliable conversion data.



You are direct, practical, adaptable, and comfortable working on a small team where priorities can change quickly.



REQUIREMENTS



* Able to work effectively as part of a remote team

* 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Meta Ads campaigns

* Experience owning campaign strategy, execution, optimization, and reporting

* Strong knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, campaign objectives, bidding, budgets, audiences, placements, and account structure

* Experience developing advertising concepts, copy, creative briefs, and test plans

* Working knowledge of Meta Pixel, Conversions API, Events Manager, attribution, and offline conversions

* Strong analytical skills and the ability to pull, interpret, and act on your own performance data

* Experience managing meaningful advertising budgets across multiple campaigns

* Ability to communicate performance, problems, and recommendations clearly

* Fluency with AI tools for research, copywriting, creative development, and analysis



STRONGLY PREFERRED



* B2B lead-generation experience

* Experience optimizing toward qualified leads, revenue, or downstream sales outcomes rather than lead volume alone

* Experience marketing marketplaces, comparison services, professional services, HR solutions, financial services, or other considered-purchase categories

* Agency experience managing multiple clients, accounts, or business categories at once

* Experience developing both static and short-form video creative

* Experience working with landing pages, lead forms, and conversion-rate optimization



Candidates whose experience is limited to ecommerce should be prepared to explain how they would adapt their approach to B2B lead generation, longer buying cycles, variable lead quality, and offline revenue measurement.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



You independently develop and execute a clear Meta strategy for each assigned category. You maintain a strong creative testing pipeline, improve lead quality and acquisition efficiency, communicate performance clearly, and consistently bring forward informed recommendations for what Top Provider should test or scale next.

title: Business Development & Proposal Coordinator
description:
Engagement Type: Independent Contractor | Remote



We are seeking an experienced, highly organized, and resourceful independent contractor to provide Business Development & Proposal Coordination services. This engagement will focus heavily on identifying bid and contracting opportunities, preparing and submitting proposals, researching industry opportunities, generating prospective client leads, and maintaining our sales pipeline and CRM. The contractor must maintain substantial availability during our operational hours to support time-sensitive solicitations, communications, meetings, and submission deadlines, while independently managing the manner and method used to complete assigned deliverables.



Key Responsibilities

Monitor approximately 20–25 procurement, bid, and solicitation platforms for relevant RFPs, RFQs, IFBs, subcontracting opportunities, and other solicitations.



Conduct additional research to identify opportunities that may not appear on our standard bid platforms, including prime contractor and subcontracting opportunities.



Review solicitations to determine basic eligibility, scope, deadlines, requirements, and potential fit.



Maintain a centralized bid and opportunity tracker, including due dates, pre-bid meetings, questions deadlines, addenda, submission requirements, and status.



Prepare and complete RFP/RFQ/bid responses, including assembling company information, qualifications, certifications, forms, resumes, project experience, and supporting documentation.



Manage bid and proposal deadlines from preparation through final submission, ensuring all bids are accurate, complete, and submitted on time. Timely bid preparation and submission is a critical responsibility of this position.



Research upcoming industry conferences, conventions, seminars, networking events, procurement events, outreach events, and other business-development opportunities relevant to the company's markets and services.



Identify potential clients, prime contractors, subcontractors, developers, agencies, and strategic partners for business-development outreach.



Conduct lead generation and prospect research.



Maintain the company's CRM and sales pipeline, documenting prospects, contacts, outreach, follow-ups, opportunities, next steps, and outcomes.



Manage follow-up schedules so prospective clients and opportunities do not fall through the cracks.



Respond to inbound sales leads and inquiries and route opportunities appropriately.



Assist with outbound email and other business-development outreach.



Maintain organized records of proposals, solicitations, leads, contacts, and business-development activities.



Provide regular reports and deliverables on active bids, upcoming opportunities, leads, proposal status, and sales-pipeline activity.



Qualifications

Strong online research and analytical skills.



Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.



Strong command of the English language, including written and verbal communication.



Ability to manage numerous deadlines and opportunities simultaneously.



Must have experience with RFPs, RFQs, procurement, proposal coordination, business development, lead generation, or sales support.



Must have experience using CRM and sales pipeline management systems.



Comfortable researching government agencies, contractors, construction companies, and procurement websites.



Must have advanced-level Microsoft Excel skills.



Must be able to perform services independently and proactively identify and complete required deliverables rather than waiting for day-to-day direction.



Must be self-starting, self-motivated, and capable of independently determining the manner and method used to complete the work and achieve required results while using required company systems, CRM platforms, bid templates, Excel tracking sheets, and other designated tools and documentation.



Must be punctual, dependable, and highly deadline-driven for agreed meetings, communications, and submission requirements. The ability to prepare and submit bids within required timeframes is essential.



Must maintain substantial availability during the company's operational hours when necessary for bid deadlines, scheduled meetings, client or agency communications, and other time-sensitive deliverables.



Must demonstrate a high level of discretion and the ability to maintain strict confidentiality regarding company, client, proposal, and business-development information.



Must be willing to enter into an Independent Contractor Agreement and sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) as a condition of engagement.



Engagement is subject to completion of a background check and any required authorization for the processing of personal information.



Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following is highly desirable:



Construction | Public Works | Government Contracting | Labor Compliance | Prevailing Wage | Federal Contracting | Renewable Energy | Infrastructure | Professional Services | Government Procurement



What Success Looks Like

The right person will create an organized and consistent business-development process. Bid platforms are monitored routinely, qualified opportunities are identified early, proposal deadlines are tracked, submissions are organized, industry events are researched, leads are followed up on, and the CRM accurately reflects where every prospective client and opportunity stands.



This position requires someone who is proactive, persistent, organized, research-oriented, and deadline-driven. We are looking for someone who actively searches for the next opportunity and makes sure potential business is followed through from identification to submission or sales follow-up.

title: Labor Compliance Specialist/Auditor
description:
Position Overview



Veracity Compliance, Inc. is seeking a highly analytical, detail-oriented, and organized Labor Compliance Specialist / Auditor to support the review, auditing, and administration of labor compliance requirements for public works, federally funded, and other regulated construction projects. The ideal candidate must be able to follow instructions carefully, adhere to established workflows and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), maintain accurate and orderly documentation, and consistently complete detailed processes without skipping required steps.



This is not strictly an administrative compliance position. We are specifically seeking a candidate with a strong auditing and accounting background who is comfortable reviewing payroll records, reconciling financial information, identifying discrepancies, documenting findings, and conducting detailed compliance reviews.



The ideal candidate understands how financial records connect and has experience in auditing, accounting, Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), payroll, or financial reconciliation. Prior labor compliance or construction experience is highly preferred but may not be required for an exceptional accounting/audit candidate who can learn regulatory requirements quickly.



A CPA, CPA candidate, or candidate with formal accounting/auditing credentials is strongly preferred.



Key Responsibilities:



Labor Compliance & Auditing



Conduct detailed audits of contractor and subcontractor labor compliance documentation.

Review Certified Payroll Reports (CPRs) for accuracy, completeness, and compliance.

Compare payroll records against supporting documentation to identify inconsistencies or potential violations.

Audit employee classifications, wage rates, fringe benefits, hours worked, overtime, deductions, and payroll calculations.

Identify underpayments, overpayments, missing documentation, discrepancies, and other compliance deficiencies.

Review payroll registers, timecards, proof of payment, canceled checks, direct-deposit records, invoices, and other supporting financial documentation.

Calculate potential wage restitution and document the basis for audit findings.

Maintain detailed audit trails and supporting documentation.

Prepare clear audit findings, deficiency notices, and compliance correspondence.

Follow up with contractors and subcontractors regarding outstanding deficiencies and corrective actions.

Assist with internal and external compliance audits and investigations.

Accounting & Financial Review

Perform detailed reconciliations between payroll, accounting records, supporting documentation, and compliance submissions.

Review AP and AR documentation when relevant to compliance verification.

Trace transactions and payments through supporting accounting records.

Identify mathematical errors, duplicate transactions, inconsistencies, missing payments, and unsupported amounts.

Analyze spreadsheets and large volumes of financial information with a high degree of accuracy.

Verify calculations independently rather than relying solely on information provided by contractors.

Maintain organized records capable of supporting an audit, investigation, or agency review.

Public Works & Prevailing Wage Compliance



Depending on experience and assigned projects, responsibilities may include:



California prevailing wage compliance

Davis-Bacon / Davis-Bacon Related Acts

Certified payroll auditing

DIR requirements and eCPR

WH-347 payroll review

Prevailing wage determinations

Fringe benefit verification

Worker classification review

Overtime requirements

Apprenticeship requirements

DAS 140 and DAS 142 documentation

Apprenticeship ratios

Restitution calculations

Contractor and subcontractor compliance

Agency and client audit preparation

Labor compliance tracking systems and reporting



Training may be provided on specific labor compliance regulations and systems for candidates with exceptional accounting and auditing qualifications.



REQUIRED Qualifications



Candidates must have professional experience in auditing, accounting, or financial review, including experience with Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), payroll, reconciliations, or similar accounting functions.

title: Technical Case Study Content Producer (Graphic Design + Video)
description:
Built Mighty is a fast-growing WooCommerce and e-commerce agency that builds powerful, custom digital commerce solutions for ambitious brands. We combine deep technical expertise with strategic thinking to deliver results our clients love.



We're scaling our content output and need someone who can actually build it; design the page in Figma, cut the video, animate the graphic, and ship it across our site, LinkedIn, and YouTube.



Role Overview



This is a hands-on production role, not a writing role. You'll take a project win, a technical concept, or a client story and turn it into finished assets: designed website pages, branded graphics, motion pieces, and edited video.



Think of yourself as the person who owns everything between "here's the story" and "it's live and it looks great." You'll work directly with our developers, project managers, and leadership to help bring these stories to life.



Key Responsibilities



Design & Web Content



Design website pages, landing pages, and case study layouts in Figma, components, auto-layout, responsive breakpoints, and clean handoff to our dev team.

Build and maintain a reusable component and template library so we stop designing the same block twice.

Produce supporting graphics: diagrams, before/after visuals, data callouts, social cards, thumbnails.

Publish or assist in publishing finished pages in WordPress, keeping design intent intact.



Motion & Video



Create motion graphics - animated explainers, UI walkthroughs, kinetic type, logo stings, Lottie/After Effects assets for the site.

Edit short-form and long-form video: screen recordings, Zoom interviews, on-camera segments. Handle color, audio cleanup, captions, lower thirds, and B-roll.

Own video and YouTube production end to end: editing, thumbnails, titles, chapters, descriptions, and end screens. This is a new venture and we're starting from zero.

Cut and reformat every asset for LinkedIn/Socials - native video, carousels, vertical crops, silent-friendly captions.



Production Systems



Build repeatable templates, presets, and project structures so output scales without quality dropping.

Maintain an organized asset library - source files, exports, brand assets, stock, fonts.

Coordinate with project teams to gather screenshots, metrics, recordings, and approvals for each piece.



Distribution & Iteration



Ship content on a consistent cadence across our website, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

Track performance (views, watch time, engagement, traffic) and use it to sharpen the next round.



Qualifications



Experience: 3+ years producing design, motion, or video content - agency, in-house marketing, or freelance. Portfolio matters more than years.



Required skills:



Figma - strong working knowledge. Components, variants, auto-layout, styles/variables, and dev-ready handoff.

Video editing - Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, or similar. Clean cuts, good pacing, proper audio.

Motion graphics - After Effects or equivalent. You can animate a UI walkthrough or an explainer without it looking like a template.

Graphic design fundamentals - typography, hierarchy, layout, color. Your work looks intentional, not assembled.

Web production literacy - you understand responsive layouts, image optimization, file formats, and what's actually buildable versus what just looks good in a mockup.

Comfortable working independently, juggling multiple pieces, and hitting deadlines without being chased. Must be a good communicator.



Nice-to-haves:



WordPress page building (Gutenberg, Elementor, or custom themes).

Working HTML/CSS - enough to spec accurately or make small edits yourself.

YouTube channel growth: thumbnails, packaging, retention.

Experience with WooCommerce, e-commerce, or B2B technical content.

Basic copywriting - you'll be handed a script or draft, but being able to tighten it is a plus.

Illustrator, Photoshop, Descript, CapCut, or After Effects plugin ecosystems.



What Success Looks Like

A consistent, growing volume of finished assets shipping every month - web, LinkedIn, YouTube.

Website pages that ship faster because your Figma files are actually build-ready.

A YouTube channel with real watch time, not just uploads.

A visual system that makes Built Mighty look like the technical authority we are.



Why Join Built Mighty?

Own the visual and production side of our brand from the ground up.

Work with a talented, collaborative team that values results and work-life balance.

Competitive compensation, flexible hours, and room to grow as we scale.



To Apply



Send your resume, a short note, and your portfolio. We want to see:



A Figma file you designed (view access is fine). Website or landing page work preferred. We'll be looking at how it's built, not just how it looks.

2–3 videos you edited, ideally with some motion graphics work.

Any web pages you designed that went live, with links.



If you have a YouTube channel, LinkedIn presence, or side projects you're proud of, include those too.

title: Long Form Youtube Video Editor
description:

SALARY: $8.00 USD/hour — 40 hours/week (approx. $1,280 USD/month at full hours)



JOB TYPE: Full Time — Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM



About us



We're McMahon Dog Training — a dog training brand with 1.1 million followers across all platforms and 50 million views in the last month alone. We're growing fast, and we're looking for a long-form video editor to grow with us.



What you'll be doing



You'll be editing our long-form YouTube content. We're after high-budget editing quality,  the kind of work you see from the top channels in the dog training space. If you know Dog Trainers (on youtube) like Garret Wing / American Standard K9, Tom Davis, or McCann Dog Training, you already understand the standard we're aiming for. There are a lot of people doing this extremely well in our space, and we want an editor who can hold that level.



Skills we require:



- Adobe Premiere Pro — advanced, existing proficiency. This is not a role for someone learning the software.

- B-roll knowledge, including how b-roll is used from short-form/TikTok videos into a Youtube Long Form Video.

- Text on screen — clean, well-timed, readable

- Color grading

- Clean zooms, cuts, and on-screen effects

- Proven experience and a portfolio of real long-form work



The schedule



This is a full-time role: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, 40 hours per week. We ramp you in gradually, you'll start with fewer hours and build up to full 40-hour weeks over the first couple of weeks, so you have time to learn our style and workflow properly.



Who we're looking for



Beyond editing skill, the person who succeeds here:



- Takes direction well and is genuinely open to feedback and criticism

- Has strong communication skills and works collaboratively

- Is reliable — shows up on time and works efficiently

- Wants to stay and grow with one brand rather than hop between clients



Why this is a great opportunity



This is a long-term position with real career growth. As we continue to grow, so do the opportunities for the people on our team — including opportunities for added benefits down the line for editors who do great work and stick with us. We invest in our people.



HIRING PROCESS — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



Submit your application with your portfolio / samples of long-form work

Interview — a short 10 to 15 minute interview with us

Paid test edit — if the interview goes well, we'll pay you $10 to edit 2–3 minutes of one of our long-form videos



Two things that are non-negotiable:

1. The interview. We need to talk to the person we're working with. If you are not willing to do a 10–15 minute interview, please do not apply.

2. Hubstaff time tracking. If you're not comfortable with it, this isn't the right role for you.
