title: Accounting & Financial Operations Specialist
description:
About Apex Operations



Apex Operations is a growing marketing agency that helps contractors and home-service businesses generate leads, strengthen their brands, and scale their companies through websites, paid advertising, SEO, content, and business systems.



As the company grows, we are looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Accounting & Financial Operations Specialist to help us maintain accurate financial records, improve financial visibility, and give leadership a clearer understanding of where money is coming from, where it is going, and how the business is performing.



Position Overview



The Accounting & Financial Operations Specialist will be responsible for keeping our QuickBooks account accurate and up to date, categorizing income and expenses, reconciling accounts, tracking commissions, and producing regular financial and operational reports.



This person will also help separate and properly document personal versus business expenses, identify unnecessary or duplicate spending, monitor recurring subscriptions, and provide leadership with clear financial insights.



This is not strictly a data-entry bookkeeping role. We need someone who can maintain the numbers while also helping us understand what those numbers mean.



Primary Responsibilities

QuickBooks and Bookkeeping

Maintain accurate and current records in QuickBooks Online.

Categorize income, expenses, transfers, owner distributions, and reimbursements.

Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, payment processors, and other financial accounts.

Review transactions for missing information, incorrect classifications, or duplicate entries.

Maintain an organized chart of accounts that reflects the way Apex Operations operates.

Ensure revenue is properly recorded by client, service, or revenue category when applicable.

Keep supporting documentation, receipts, invoices, and financial records organized.

Coordinate with the company’s CPA or tax professional when necessary.

Business and Personal Expense Tracking

Help identify and separate business expenses from personal expenses.

Track owner contributions, reimbursements, distributions, and personal purchases made through business accounts.

Flag expenses that require clarification before categorizing them.

Create a clear process for documenting expenses and submitting receipts.

Help leadership understand how personal transactions affect the company’s books and financial reports.

Accounts Payable and Expense Management

Track bills, contractor payments, software subscriptions, vendor expenses, and other outgoing payments.

Maintain a schedule of recurring business expenses.

Identify duplicate subscriptions, unnecessary expenses, unexpected increases, and potential cost-saving opportunities.

Provide visibility into upcoming bills and cash obligations.

Verify that contractors, vendors, and tea
mbers are being paid accurately.

Commission and Compensation Tracking

Calculate and track commissions owed to sales representatives, appointment setters, account managers, or other tea
mbers.

Maintain accurate commission records based on collected revenue, payment terms, and company compensation agreements.

Prepare commission payout reports for leadership approval.

Track commissions that are earned, pending, paid, adjusted, or clawed back.

Reconcile commission payouts against client payments and company records.

Help develop a consistent and transparent commission tracking system.

Financial Reporting and Business Analytics

Prepare weekly and monthly financial reports for leadership.

Produce and explain reports such as:

Profit and loss statements

Cash flow summaries

Revenue by client

Revenue by service

Monthly recurring revenue

Accounts receivable

Accounts payable

Contractor and payroll expenses

Software and subscription expenses

Commission obligations

Client acquisition costs

Gross profit and net profit

Department or service-line profitability

Compare financial results against previous months, targets, or budgets.

Identify unusual spending, declining margins, missed payments, or financial risks.

Translate financial information into clear explanations and recommendations for leadership.

Help create dashboards or scorecards that make the company’s financial performance easy to understand.

Client Payment and Revenue Tracking

Track invoices, recurring payments, overdue balances, failed payments, refunds, and payment plans.

Confirm that client payments match contracts, invoices, and internal records.

Maintain accurate accounts receivable reports.

Flag overdue or failed payments for the appropriate tea
mber to follow up on.

Help leadership forecast expected cash collections.

Financial Processes and Controls

Develop and document standard operating procedures for bookkeeping, expenses, commissions, reimbursements, and financial reporting.

Improve the accuracy and consistency of financial information across the company.

Establish recurring weekly and monthly financial review processes.

Help reduce financial errors, missing documentation, and inconsistent reporting.

Protect confidential company, client, employee, and financial information.

Expected Reporting



The Accounting & Financial Operations Specialist should be prepared to deliver:



Weekly Reports

Current cash position

Payments received

Outstanding client balances

Upcoming bills and payouts

Commissions owed

Unusual or uncategorized transactions

Major financial issues requiring leadership attention

Monthly Reports

Profit and loss statement

Revenue breakdown

Expense breakdown

Cash flow summary

Gross and net profit

Commission payout report

Accounts receivable report

Recurring subscription report

Month-over-month performance comparison

Key financial observations and recommendations

Qualifications

Proven experience with bookkeeping, accounting operations, or financial reporting.

Strong experience with QuickBooks Online.

Experience reconciling bank accounts, credit cards, and payment processors.

Strong understanding of income statements, cash flow, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and expense categorization.

Experience calculating commissions, bonuses, or variable compensation.

Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

Ability to create clear reports, dashboards, and financial summaries.

Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

Ability to identify inconsistencies and ask the right questions.

Strong organizational and time-management skills.

Ability to manage confidential financial information responsibly.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to explain financial information in simple, practical language.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with a marketing agency, service business, contractor, or remote team.

Experience with Stripe and other recurring payment platforms.

Experience tracking revenue and profitability by client or service.

Experience working with commissioned sales teams.

Experience building financial dashboards and operational scorecards.

Familiarity with payroll, contractor payments, budgeting, and cash-flow forecasting.

Experience coordinating with CPAs, tax preparers, or outsourced accounting firms.

What Success Looks Like



The right person will create a financial system where:



QuickBooks is consistently accurate and up to date.

Leadership knows how much money the company has, owes, and expects to collect.

Personal and business transactions are clearly separated and documented.

Commission payouts are calculated accurately and on time.

Client payments and outstanding balances are easy to track.

Financial reports are delivered consistently.

Unnecessary expenses and financial issues are identified early.

Leadership can make decisions based on reliable financial information.

The company has a clear understanding of profitability by client, service, and business area.

Key Performance Indicators



Performance may be measured by:



Monthly reconciliations completed on time.

Percentage of transactions properly categorized.

Number of unresolved or uncategorized transactions.

Accuracy of commission calculations.

Accuracy and timeliness of financial reports.

Accounts receivable visibility and follow-up accuracy.

Reduction in duplicate or unnecessary expenses.

Accuracy of cash-flow projections.

Completion and maintenance of financial standard operating procedures.

Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is proactive, analytical, highly organized, and comfortable taking ownership of the company’s day-to-day financial records.



You do not simply enter numbers into QuickBooks. You investigate discrepancies, identify patterns, organize information, and help leadership understand what is happening financially throughout the business.



You should be comfortable telling leadership when something does not look correct, when documentation is missing, when spending is increasing, or when a process needs to be improved.



Application Requirements



Please submit:



A brief overview of your bookkeeping and financial operations experience.

Your experience with QuickBooks Online.

Examples of financial reports or dashboards you have managed.

Your experience calculating commissions or variable compensation.

Your availability and preferred working schedule.

Your expected hourly rate or monthly compensation.

References or testimonials from previous clients or employers.

A short explanation of how you would organize the finances of a growing marketing agency.

title: # Meta & Shopify Team Member
description:
# Meta & Shopify Assistant



**Company:** Blackline Car Care

**Department:** Ecommerce / Growth

**Reports To:** Head of Growth & Head of Shopify



## About the Role



Blackline Car Care is looking for a **Meta & Shopify Assistant** to support our fast-growing ecommerce team.



This is a hands-on execution role working directly with our Head of Growth and Head of Shopify. The position will primarily focus on **creating static ads for our Meta ad account, building custom landing pages for our offers, and managing products and content within Shopify.**



We move quickly, test constantly, and regularly launch new creative, offers, products, and landing pages. We are looking for someone who is creative, technically capable, organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable executing quickly.



## Core Responsibilities



### Meta Static Ad Creation



A major part of this role will be helping our Growth team consistently produce and test new static advertising creative.



* Create static image ads for our Meta ad account

* Turn creative concepts and direction from the Head of Growth into finished ads

* Develop multiple variations of winning concepts, hooks, headlines, layouts, and offers

* Create product-focused, offer-focused, testimonial, comparison, problem/solution, and other direct-response static ads

* Resize and adapt creative for different Meta placements

* Use existing product photography, UGC, reviews, brand assets, and other content to develop new advertisements

* Work within Blackline's brand guidelines while still creating ads designed to capture attention and drive conversions

* Assist with rapid creative testing by producing multiple iterations of concepts

* Organize static creative so the Growth team can easily identify, launch, and track different concepts

* Review performance with the Head of Growth to understand which creative is working and use those learnings to develop new iterations

* Use tools such as Photoshop, Canva, Figma, and AI creative tools to increase the speed and volume of creative production



### Shopify & Landing Pages



* Build custom Shopify landing pages for new products, bundles, promotions, and advertising offers

* Create campaign-specific landing pages designed specifically for paid Meta traffic

* Turn offer concepts from the Growth team into functional, conversion-focused landing pages

* Add new products, variants, bundles, images, descriptions, pricing, and other product information to Shopify

* Update existing product pages and collections

* Build and modify Shopify sections using Liquid, HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript when needed

* Assist with promotional changes, pricing updates, discount codes, bundles, upsells, and site merchandising

* QA landing pages across desktop and mobile before campaigns go live

* Help troubleshoot basic Shopify issues and make quick website updates

* Maintain consistency across product pages, landing pages, offers, and promotions



### Meta & Growth Support



* Assist the Head of Growth with launching and managing Meta campaigns

* Upload and organize new ads and creative assets

* Build campaigns, ad sets, and ads based on direction from the Head of Growth

* Ensure ads are connected to the correct products, offers, and landing pages

* Assist with implementing new offers and ensuring discounts, bundles, links, and tracking work correctly

* Help organize creative testing and keep track of ads, concepts, offers, and landing pages being tested

* Perform campaign QA including links, UTMs, naming conventions, creative, copy, and destination pages

* Pull basic performance data and assist with reporting when needed



## Ecommerce Team Support



* Work closely with Growth, Shopify, Creative, and Product teams to get campaigns and products launched quickly

* Assist with new product launches from initial Shopify setup through launch

* Make website updates based on feedback from the ecommerce team

* Help organize digital assets, product information, creative, and campaign materials

* Support major promotional events including Black Friday, Cyber Monday, seasonal campaigns, product launches, and flash sales

* Handle general ecommerce tasks that help the team operate more efficiently

* Identify small problems before they become larger ones and take ownership of getting them resolved



## What We're Looking For



* Experience creating **static advertising creative**, preferably for Meta

* Strong understanding of visual design and direct-response advertising

* Experience with **Canva, Photoshop, Figma, or similar design tools**

* Experience working inside **Shopify**

* Familiarity with **Meta Ads Manager**

* Experience building or modifying Shopify landing pages

* Working knowledge of Shopify Liquid, HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript is preferred

* Strong attention to detail

* Comfortable working with numbers and basic ecommerce performance metrics

* Ability to learn new software and tools quickly

* Strong organizational and communication skills

* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines at once

* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly

* Someone who takes ownership instead of waiting to be told every next step



## Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



* Direct-response ecommerce advertising

title: Real Estate Inside Sales Agent - Experience Required
description:
We are hiring an experienced Real Estate Inside Sales Agent to prospect, follow up with seller leads, and set qualified listing appointments for our agents.



This is not an entry-level sales position. Applicants must have previous experience speaking with U.S. residential real estate leads and setting appointments for a real estate team or brokerage. General sales, customer service, or call-center experience without residential real estate experience will not be considered.



The right person is confident on the phone, friendly without sounding scripted, and comfortable asking direct questions about a homeowner’s motivation and timeline. You should be organized, dependable, and able to manage both new leads and longer-term follow-up without letting opportunities slip through the cracks.



What You’ll Do



* Make outbound calls

* Build rapport with homeowners and determine their motivation, timeline, property details, and readiness to meet with an agent.

* Set qualified appointments for our field agents.

* Manage pipeline and follow up consistently with leads who are not ready to make an immediate decision.

* Maintain accurate notes, stages, tasks, and appointment information in our CRM.

* Complete daily calling and follow-up expectations.

* Meet monthly goals for qualified appointments while maintaining appointment quality.

* Communicate clearly with agents when handing off appointments and lead information.



### Required Experience



* Previous experience as an ISA, appointment setter, or lead-conversion specialist for a U.S. residential real estate team or brokerage.

* Experience speaking directly with U.S. buyer or seller leads by phone.

* Experience qualifying real estate leads and setting appointments for licensed agents.

* Experience working in a real estate CRM and maintaining accurate lead records.

* A strong understanding of real estate lead follow-up, long-term nurture, and common homeowner objections.

* Excellent spoken and written English. You must be easy to understand, able to follow fast-paced conversations, and comfortable speaking naturally with U.S. homeowners.

* Reliable attendance, excellent punctuality, and the ability to work consistently during the required U.S. business hours.

* A quiet, professional workspace with reliable internet and clear call quality.



General sales or call-center experience is helpful, but it does not replace the required residential real estate experience.



What Makes Someone Successful Here



* You sound warm and conversational rather than overly rehearsed.

* You listen carefully and ask relevant follow-up questions.

* You can handle objections without becoming pushy.

* You understand the difference between a lead agreeing to an appointment and a genuinely qualified appointment.

* You take ownership of your numbers, follow-up tasks, and CRM records.

* You are comfortable receiving feedback and reviewing calls to improve your performance.

* You are looking for a stable, long-term position with a team.



Compensation and Benefits



* $6.00 USD per hour

* Performance bonuses starting at $15 per met appointment

* Additional incentives when appointments result in closed transactions

* Ongoing training on our company’s systems, expectations, scripts, and processes

* Opportunities to take on greater responsibility based on performance



To apply, please send your resume with relevant experience as well as a 60–90 second voice message answering the following:



- How many years of real estate sales experience do you have?

- What types of leads are you most accustomed to calling?

- Which cities and states were your previous employers or clients based in?



Applications without prior U.S. residential real estate experience or the requested voice recording will not be considered.

title: Customer Service Representative – Fashion Dropship E-commerce (Remote)
description:
We are looking for a motivated, empathetic, and commercially minded Customer Service Representative to join our growing e-commerce team. We run fashion dropshipping stores targeting American women, with plans to expand to other countries in the future.



About the role



You will handle customer service for multiple Shopify fashion stores, together with our CS Manager, who will onboard you, answer your questions and coach you. As the stores grow and new stores are added, your volume and earnings will grow with them.



What you'll do



- Handle inquiries, complaints, refund requests, and order issues professionally across both stores.

- Answer every
 that's in the inbox when you start your shift before you end it.

- Guide customers toward fair resolutions in line with our policy. Always aim for the lowest refund amount that still resolves the issue, for example a partial refund or a discount to keep the item before a full refund. Protecting our chargeback rate comes first, though: if a full refund is what it takes to avoid a chargeback or dispute, that takes priority.

- Recognize when a customer may be heading toward a chargeback or dispute, and escalate early, not after it has already escalated.

- If you're unsure about policy, pricing, stock, or any specific situation, always ask before responding. We would much rather answer a quick question than fix a mistake afterward.

- Log every refund or discount commitment in the shared refund tracker the moment a customer agrees.

- Maintain a warm, personal, boutique tone in every message. Customers should always feel a real person helped them.

- Write in natural, professional American English. Never corporate, robotic, or copy-pasted.

- Communicate proactively. If you're unwell, unavailable, or a case is tricky, let us know in advance.



How you're paid



- €0.14 per ticket handled

- Expected volume: at least 50 tickets per shift, 7 days a week

- An experienced CS representative handles around 20–25 tickets per hour, so 50 tickets takes roughly 2–2.5 hours per day

- A ticket counts once you've replied to it or resolved it. Multiple replies to the same ticket on the same day count as one. Tickets you've escalated count once they're answered.

- Time tracking via Hubstaff during your shift. We expect you to work through your shift in one focused block, without long breaks in between.

- Paid twice a month



Speed never replaces quality. Your replies will be reviewed regularly for accuracy, policy compliance and tone. A fast reply that's wrong or generic doesn't count as a good reply.



What we're looking for



- Excellent written English with a natural, warm tone

- Empathetic but business-minded: you can calm a frustrated customer and reach a resolution without giving away more than necessary

- Comfortable using templates and SOPs as a guideline, not a script

- A habit of double-checking rather than guessing, and following up on your own commitments until they're resolved

- Experience with Shopify is required

- Fashion dropshipping experience gets top priority; general dropshipping experience is a strong plus

- Customer service experience is a plus

- Available to start immediately



What we offer



- A fixed rate per ticket, so your earnings grow directly with your speed and volume

- Daily shift starting around 11:30 AM Philippine time, 7 days a week

- Coaching and support from our CS Team Lead

- Room to take on CS for additional stores as we expand, with the rate reviewed as the stores grow

- You're welcome to use AI tools to draft replies faster, but every reply must be checked against our policy/FAQ doc and adjusted to sound personal. Sending an unverified AI reply is treated the same as guessing.



How to apply



Please send us:



- Your CV

- A short introduction about yourself

- A summary of your relevant work experience, especially customer service roles and any fashion e-commerce or dropshipping experience

- Your written answer to the scenario below, written exactly as you would send it to the customer





Practical assessment: refund negotiation



The customer's message:



"I'm not happy with this dress, it's just not what I expected. I want a refund."



This is her first message on the topic: no defect, no specific complaint, just general dissatisfaction. Write your first reply to this customer.

title: Credentialing, Licensing & Contracting Specialist
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Credentialing, Licensing & Contracting Specialist to take full ownership of our credentialing, licensing, payer enrollment, and regulatory compliance processes across multiple healthcare entities.

This is a mission-critical role. Maintaining active provider enrollments, licenses, and regulatory certifications directly impacts our ability to deliver patien t care and receive reimbursement. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and capable of managing multiple deadlines with minimal supervision.

If you have extensive experience with U.S. healthcare credentialing and enjoy building organized systems that prevent compliance issues before they happen, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

Provider Credentialing & Enrollment

• Manage initial credentialing and recredentialing for providers across multiple entities.

• Create, maintain, and complete quarterly attestations for CAQH profiles.

• Process Medicare/PECOS enrollments and revalidations.

• Complete Medi-Cal enrollments through PAVE and other state Medicaid programs.

• Submit and track commercial payer enrollments through Availity, Optum, Anthem, Blue Shield, Aetna, UnitedHealthcare, and other payer portals.

• Maintain accurate NPI/NPPES records and provider taxonomy information.

• Track credentialing applications from submission through approval.

• Provide weekly credentialing status reports.

Payer Contracting

• Initiate and track new payer contract requests.

• Request and maintain current fee schedules.

• Coordinate contract amendments and correspondence with payer representatives.

• Maintain an organized repository of executed agreements.

• Complete EDI, ERA, and EFT enrollments.

Licensing & Regulatory Compliance

• Manage CLIA certificate renewals, site updates, and laboratory director changes.

• Coordinate state medical license applications and renewals.

• Assist with Interstate Medical Licensure Compact (IMLC) applications when applicable.

• Process DEA registrations and controlled substance registrations.

• Maintain facility licenses and business licenses.

• Track malpractice certificates of insurance.

Compliance Management

• Own and maintain a comprehensive compliance calendar for all provider and facility expirations.

• Monitor licenses, DEA registrations, CLIA certificates, malpractice insurance, board certifications, and payer revalidations.

• Proactively escalate upcoming expirations at least 90 days in advance.

• Continuously improve credentialing and compliance workflows.

Qualifications

Required

• Minimum of 3 years of experience in U.S. healthcare provider credentialing, payer enrollment, or payer contracting.

• Hands-on experience with CAQH, PECOS, and Availity.

• Experience submitting credentialing applications to commercial insurance payers and government programs.

• Strong understanding of Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payer enrollment processes.

• Excellent written English communication skills.

• Exceptional organizational and time management skills.

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

• Availability to work Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time.

• Reliable home office with high-speed internet, backup internet, and backup power.

• HIPAA Certified or willing to obtain certification immediately upon hire.

Preferred

• Multi-state provider licensing experience.

• Experience with CLIA regulations or laboratory compliance.

• Exposure to payer fee schedule review or contract negotiation.

• Experience supporting multiple healthcare entities or organizations.

What We're Looking For

The successful candidate is:

• Detail-oriented and highly organized.

• Proactive and able to anticipate deadlines.

• Comfortable communicating with payer representatives and licensing boards

title: Proven Online Arbitrage Sourcers Needed (4+ Years) | Stable, Long-Term Remote Team | Sourcing Squad HQ
description:
PLEASE READ THE WHOLE POST. The details that d
 whether you're considered are spread throughout, including the application steps. Skip around and your application will be passed over.



Hello from Sourcing Squad HQ.



We're looking for serious Amazon product sourcers to join a remote team that has been working together for over two years and intends to keep going for twenty or more.



A LITTLE ABOUT US

There are seven of us on the team right now. Our sourcing supports two separate Amazon seller accounts, which means your role doesn't rise or fall with a single account. If one hits a rough patch, the work continues and so does your paycheck.



We'll be honest about our track record. We've hired 40 VAs and only 6 are still with us. Most of the people who didn't make it had exaggerated their experience, and our trial period shows that within the first 3-4 days. If you really know how to source, you'll do well and you'll enjoy working alongside others at your level. We consider ourselves one of the best sourcing teams in the space, and we keep our standards high.



OUR OWNERS

The company is owned by Ian and Thomas. Both are closely involved, fair with the team, and generous toward people who perform. They're building something meant to last.



We pay every other Monday, on time. In all our time in business we have never missed a payment.



THE KIND OF PERSON WE NEED

Someone who is a sourcer at heart. We don't want account managers, brand builders, or generalists. We want people who get excited about the next deal and treat finding a great lead as the best part of the job.



REQUIRED

- At least 4 years of hands-on Amazon product sourcing (online arbitrage) with deals found daily

- Valid references from past employers that we are able to contact and verify

- Working knowledge of Keepa and SellerAmp



EXPERIENCE THAT WON'T COUNT

Managing Amazon accounts, private label, wholesale, running a team, and general "Amazon VA" work aren't relevant to this role. Only time spent sourcing products counts toward your 4 years. If that's mostly not your background, please don't apply.



THE STANDARD

Each lead you send us must meet both of these:

- 50% ROI or higher

- $7 or more profit per unit

This is our starting point for every lead. If it worries you, this isn't the right job, and that's fine.



YOUR DAILY WORK

- Source profitable, approvable leads using Keepa and SellerAmp

- Log and deliver your leads in Google Sheets

- Identify problem listings: gated or restricted brands, Amazon on the listing, price history collapses, variation mismatches, IP-complaint brands

HOW YOU JOIN AND GROW

Step 1: A 14-day paid trial at $3 USD/hour, where we test your skills. If you meet our expectations and we offer you the next phase, you'll get a $50 USD bonus at the end of the trial.

Step 2: 90 days at $3.50-$4.00/hour while you get comfortable on the team.

Step 3: A long-term position with a potential pay increase, paid holidays, paid time off, and more.



BENEFITS

- $50 USD bonus after the trial when offered the next phase

- Pay every other Monday, on time

- Incentives on top of your hourly rate for great performance

- Your choice of at least 4 weekdays, and weekends are open too. Your days are set for the trial, then you can send in availability week to week.

- 40 hours per week is the one firm requirement

- Two seller accounts and a company built to last



WHAT WE VALUE

- Accuracy, honesty, and consistency, including telling us when you're unsure about a lead

- A long-term home rather than a short-term gig



HOW TO APPLY (applications missing any step are deleted unread)

Begin your message with the word SQUAD, then include:

ed to

 your video, plus anything else you couldn't submit with your initial application, to

title: Customer Support Associate (Off-Hours Coverage)
description:
APPLICATION LINK: 

NOTE: applicants who do not complete the application form above will not be considered.



ROLE OVERVIEW 

The Customer Support Associate (Off-Hours Coverage) role exists to make sure Coast customers are never left without support — including evenings and weekends. You'll be the primary point of contact during off-hours, resolving customer inquiries, troubleshooting product issues, and delivering a high-quality experience across
, chat, and phone.



Because ticket volume varies throughout the shift, this role also takes on meaningful project and operational work during quieter windows — from improving our help center content to supporting billing and internal operations. You'll develop a broad understanding of how Coast runs as a business, which makes this role an excellent foundation for advancement into Implementation, Customer Success, or other roles over time.



Working hours: This is an off-hours coverage role supporting U.S.-based customers on weekends and weekday evenings EST (exact times TBD). Please apply only if you are available and comfortable working these hours. 



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Responsibilities are prioritized in order of importance. Customer support is always the first priority; project work fills quieter windows.



1) Customer support 

- Respond to customer inquiries via
, chat, and phone in a timely, accurate, and empathetic manner during your shift.

- Troubleshoot product and account issues using knowledge base articles, SOPs, and good judgment; escalate complex cases when needed.

- Monitor and manage your ticket queue to meet SLAs for first response and resolution.

- Document all customer interactions, resolutions, and follow-ups in Salesforce and Intercom/Zendesk to maintain a clear history.

- Collaborate with the US-based Implementation and Customer Success teams on customer handoffs, flagging urgent issues for next-day follow-up when appropriate.



2) Systems & data support 

- Own customer data intake, cleanup, validation, and ongoing maintenance to ensure accuracy and readiness for implementation and reporting.

- Execute customer data imports and migrations (primarily via spreadsheets and templates), troubleshoot issues, and ensure clean handoffs to Implementation and Customer Success.

- Document work, decisions, and customer configurations in internal systems (Salesforce, Intercom/Zendesk, and project tools) to maintain clear visibility and continuity.

- Identify patterns and opportunities to improve data templates, processes, and internal documentation to increase speed and consistency across implementations.



3) General operational and administrative support 

- During quieter support windows, contribute to a rotating set of operational projects assigned by the team. Examples include:

- Help center and content: Review and revise help desk articles for accuracy and clarity; create short help videos and walkthroughs to support customer self-service; suggest FAQ updates based on ticket patterns.

- Billing support: Monitor accounts receivable aging and send structured payment reminder
s; track upcoming subscription renewals and send timely notices; triage the billing inbox during off-hours and respond to routine billing questions; support basic data entry in Stripe and Salesforce.

- General admin and research: Assist with internal operational tasks across teams — including HR admin support, basic research, and other cross-functional work as assigned.



WHAT THIS ROLE CAN LEAD TO 

This position is intentionally designed as a foundation for growth at Coast. As you develop deep product knowledge and cross-functional exposure, you'll be well-positioned to move into roles such as:

- Implementation Specialist — configuring Coast for new customers and supporting go-lives

- Customer Success Manager — owning customer relationships and driving retention

- Systems & Data Associate — managing customer data, imports, and workflow configuration



We promote from within and will actively support your development toward whichever path fits your strengths.



REQUIREMENTS

- At least 1 year of customer support experience, preferably in a SaaS or tech environment.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills — clear, friendly, and professional.

- Comfortable working independently during off-hours with minimal real-time oversight.

- Available and willing to work the shift hours listed above, including weekends and Philippine overnight hours.

- Comfortable working daily in our tech stack, including Coast, Google Workspace, Zoom/Meet, Salesforce, and support/project tools such as Zendesk, Intercom, and Avoma (or similar equivalents). Previous experience with these tools is a plus.

- Strong attention to detail and follow-through. 

- Organized, self-directed, and able to switch between support and project work within the same shift.

- Reliable high-speed internet connection and a professional, quiet workspace suitable for phone calls, video calls, and screen?sharing.

- Basic familiarity with billing concepts (invoices, subscriptions, payment reminders) is a plus, not required.



We are not able to support work visas at this time.



TRAINING, ONBOARDING, AND PROBATIONARY PERIOD 

We invest heavily in setting you up to succeed. Here's what your first 90 days look like:



Weeks 1–4: Core Training - You'll go through a structured four-week training program combining self-paced learning with live sessions and regular group check-ins with your cohort. By the end, you'll have a strong foundation in Coast's platform, our customer base, and how we work.



Weeks 5–12: Job Training - Training wheels come off gradually. You'll move into hands-on job training where you begin managing your own implementations under guidance — learning by doing with real customers and real stakes.



90-Day Probation Period - Your first 90 days serve as a mutual evaluation period. We want to make sure this is the right fit for you as much as for us, and we'll give you clear expectations, regular feedback, and the support you need to hit the ground running. Successful completion leads to a longer-term engagement with Coast.



WHAT WE OFFER YOU 

- The Startup Experience: Shaping Our Growth: Joining Coast at this pivotal stage puts you at the heart of our company’s and product’s evolution. The workplace is energetic, creative, and fast-moving, giving you the chance to help define processes and standards while collaborating directly with founders and teammates who value bold thinking and active input. Here, team members aren’t just part of the journey—they shape it, building and innovating with visible impact every single day.



- Team: We are a tight knit and very strong core team of ~40 people. We are a highly customer focused, honest, skilled, direct, solution oriented, creative, ambitious, and fun crew. Previously we’ve worked at big companies like Adobe, Amazon, Meta, and Microsoft and at both early and late stage for startups like 
, HotelTonight, UpKeep, Latch, and Fitbit. We solve tough customer problems together and continually help one another level up.



- Product: The market we are going after is massive and way underserved. Our customers love the product and use it for hours every day. What you will be building will directly impact their everyday life. We use Coast as our central nervous system just like our customers!



CONTRACT DETAILS 

- Engagement type: Independent contractor based in the Philippines; taxes and statutory contributions are the responsibility of the contractor. No health benefits included.

- Location: Fully remote

- Compensation: Base pay of $15,000 - $19,000 USD annually (40 hours per week), depending on experience. 

- Payment currency and method: USD via bank transfer, paid monthly.

- Working hours: TBD - evenings and weekends, U.S. Eastern time zone

- Start date: ASAP



----

ABOUT COAST 



Coast is a no-code maintenance and work order platform built specifically for the deskless workforce. Available on Android, iOS, and web, our software is designed for teams on the move—making it easy to stay connected and on top of daily operations, no matter where work happens.



By combining real-time chat with customizable maintenance workflows, Coast helps teams streamline communication, coordinate tasks, and get more done with less friction.



While Coast is flexible enough to support a wide variety of operational needs, our current focus is on solving critical maintenance challenges for organizations that rely on speed, clarity, and accountability.

mbers to share knowledge and elevate the team’s client communication standards.

title: Top Sourcers Here Earn $5-$9.50/Hour | Amazon Online Arbitrage, Full-Time
description:
TITLE: Top Sourcers Here Earn $5-$9.50/Hour | Amazon Online Arbitrage, Full-Time



READ THE WHOLE POST BEFORE YOU APPLY. The details that d
 whether you're considered are spread throughout, including the application steps. Skim it and you'll miss them, and your application will be passed over.



Sourcing Squad HQ pays its best sourcers $5-$9.50 per hour, plus performance incentives on top. Everyone starts with a paid trial at $3/hour and works up from there. Below is exactly how that works.



HOW THE PAY WORKS

1. Paid trial (14 days): $3 USD/hour while we test your real skills. If you meet our expectations and we offer you the next phase, you get a $50 USD bonus at the end of the trial.

2. Acclimation phase (90 days): $3.50-$4.00/hour while you settle into the team.

3. Long-term position: a potential pay increase, paid holidays, paid time off, and more.

4. Always: incentives for great performance on top of your hourly rate.



We pay every other Monday, on time. In more than two years, we have never missed a payment.



WHO WE ARE

Sourcing Squad HQ is a remote team of 7 that has been running for 2+ years and plans to be here for 20 or more. Our sourcing supports TWO separate Amazon seller accounts, so your job never depends on one account staying healthy. If one hits a rough patch, the team keeps working.



We consider ourselves one of the best sourcing teams in the space, and we're selective. We've hired 40 VAs and kept 6. Most of the ones who left overstated their experience, and our trial exposes that within the first 3-4 days. Real sourcers pass without trouble and end up on a team that matches their skill level.



The company is owned by Ian and Thomas, who are closely involved, fair, and generous toward people who perform. They're building something meant to last.



THE PERSON WE'RE LOOKING FOR

A sourcer at heart. Someone who lives for the next deal and treats finding a winning lead as the best part of the job.



REQUIREMENTS (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

- At least 4 years of hands-on Amazon product sourcing (online arbitrage), finding deals day in and day out

- Valid references from past employers that we can contact and verify

- Working knowledge of Keepa and SellerAmp



EXPERIENCE THAT DOES NOT COUNT

Managing Amazon accounts, private label, wholesale, running a team, and general "Amazon VA" work don't count toward the 4 years. Only years spent sourcing products count. If your background is mostly in those areas, please don't apply.



THE STANDARD

Every lead you submit must meet both of these:

- 50% ROI minimum

- $7 profit per unit minimum

That's the baseline, not a stretch goal. If those numbers scare you, this isn't the job for you, and that's completely fine.



WHAT YOUR DAYS LOOK LIKE

- Find profitable, approvable leads using Keepa and SellerAmp

- Log and deliver your leads in Google Sheets

- Catch the deal-killers: gated and restricted brands, Amazon on the listing, price history collapses, variation mismatches, IP-complaint brands

- Deliver 10 quality leads per shift (8 is the minimum for a full shift)



HOW WE TRACK TIME

Every VA on the team is tracked on Hubstaff, which takes a screenshot of your screen every 2 minutes. It keeps the time clock trustworthy for everyone. If you work with integrity, you'll never think about it. If you have bad intentions, please skip this posting.



YOUR SCHEDULE

Choose at least 4 weekdays to work. Weekends are open too. The only fixed requirement is 40 hours per week. Your days are set for the 14-day trial, and after that you can submit your availability week to week.



WHAT WE VALUE MOST

- Accuracy, honesty, and consistency, including telling us when you're unsure about a lead

- A long-term home, not a short-term gig



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip a step are deleted unread)

Start your message with the word SQUAD, then include:

1. A GOOD resume. It needs real thought, real detail, and accurate information, not a quick one produced by ChatGPT or Claude. Name your tools, categories, and results from your sourcing work, and be honest.

2. A 2-3 minute unscripted video (Loom or similar) about your 4+ years of Amazon product sourcing: tools, categories, and how many leads you delivered per day at your last job. The video must be
ed to 
 not sent through this platform.

3. The last product you rejected and exactly why

4. Two past employers or sellers we can contact for references (names and how to reach them)

5. Your availability for the 14-day trial: which 4+ weekdays you'd work (weekends are open too). After the trial, you can submit availability week to week.



SENDING YOUR VIDEO

 your video, plus anything else you couldn't submit with your initial application, to 
 SQUAD and your full name in the subject line. Applications without the video are incomplete and won't be considered.



If you're the real deal, we'd love to hear from you. If you're not sure you meet the bar, this probably isn't the right fit, and that's okay.



This could be the long-term opportunity you've been looking for, to help better your life and your family's life. Our top earners are at $5-$9.50 per hour!! The growth is endless.

title: Managing Producer, Game Advertising (Part Time, Growing to Full Time)
description:
We are a US based creative agency producing performance advertising for mobile and PC game publishers. We concept, write, capture, edit, and deliver the video and static creative that runs their user acquisition campaigns.



We are looking for someone to take three active game accounts off our founder's plate and run them completely. This is a leadership role first and a creative role second. You will own the accounts, direct the people delivering on them, and be the person who d
 what gets made and why.



What you will lead



Three mobile game accounts, each producing video and static creative every month along with hook and format variations. You own the calendar, the quality bar, and the delivery.



The team behind that work. We have an editor, a capture operator, and a social media manager already in place. You will brief them, review what comes back, give notes that actually make the work better, and hold the schedule. We need someone who has done this before and likes doing it. If managing other people feels like a distraction from the real work, this is the wrong role for you.



The creative itself. You are not only assigning work, you are making it. You will study each game, find the angles worth testing, write the scripts and hooks and ad copy yourself, build the capture shot lists, and design static ads. We need someone who can still do the craft at a high level while running the people who do it alongside them.



The relationship with our media buying partner. You will hand off finished creative on spec and on time, take performance feedback, and turn what you learn into what we make next.



What we need



Four or more years producing advertising creative, with at least some of that spent leading other creatives or running accounts. Game, app, or entertainment experience preferred. Performance advertising background matters far more than brand or corporate work.



Real management experience. You have directed editors, designers, or other creatives before. You know how to give a note that lands, how to hold a deadline without being a problem to work with, and how to keep several projects moving at once without dropping anything.



You write well. Scripts, hooks, ad copy, client facing documents. This is the single hardest thing to teach and we screen for it first.



You can build a static ad, not just brief one. Canva, Photoshop, or Figma. You understand composition, hierarchy, and what makes someone stop scrolling on a still image.



Working fluency in an editing and motion environment. Premiere, CapCut, or After Effects. You do not need to be the finishing artist but you need to spot the problem and say exactly what to fix.



Hands on experience with AI video and image generation in finished client work. We use tools in the Higgsfield family along with Veo and ElevenLabs. If your stack is different we will bring you across.



Familiarity with gameplay capture. You should know what a clean plate is, what a marketing camera mode does, and how to write a shot list against a build.



Four hours of daily overlap with US Pacific time.



How this grows



This starts at 20 hours a week at $2,000 to $2,500 per month depending on experience. We have two larger engagements closing this quarter and this role expands to full time as they land, with compensation moving accordingly. We would rather find the right person now at part time hours than rush a full time hire later.



For the first sixty days our founder stays on all client calls so you can focus on the accounts and the team. After that you take over client communication directly.



To apply



Send us four things.



First, describe one ad or campaign you personally concepted and produced. What was the brief, what angle did you choose and why, and what happened.



Second, tell us about a time you led other creatives. How many people, what were you responsible for, and what was hard about it.



Third, walk us through your first thirty days on an account you have never seen before. What do you do, in what order, and why.



Fourth, send links to three pieces of work you directed, including at least one static ad.



Start your message with the word Riftstone so we know you read the full post.

title: Media Buyer/Paid Ads Specialist
description:
Company Info

The Scale Space is a marketing agency that runs full-funnel growth for clients: paid ads, automation, and strategy. Small, fast-moving team based in North Hollywood, CA, operating fully remote. The promise to clients is revenue, not traffic, clicks, or vanity metrics.



Compensation & Logistics

- Base salary: $1200-$2000, based on experience

- Opportunity for performance based bonuses (not guaranteed), tied to the results you drive on your accounts

- Fully remote, work from home, permanently

- Full-time, 8 hours/day with breaks, PST/PDT

- Working hours: 9am to 5pm PST

- Benefits: 15 vacation, 8 sick, 2 personal, 4 bereavement, 6 holidays, 25 maternity/paternity company-paid days

- Sole full-time commitment



Mission

Own paid media for our client book end to end. Build and run the campaigns, write the ads, own the tracking underneath them, and turn the performance data into decisions the team and the client can act on. When a client asks why cost per lead moved, you are the person who already knows and already has the fix in motion.



What This Role Actually Is

Anyone can tell a client that cost per lead went up. We need someone who can say why it went up, what it is costing the client in real revenue, and the specific change that fixes it. That is the whole job.

You will run roughly 8 to 10 brands across med spa, hospitality, real estate, and home services. Meta is our primary platform, Google is growing, and a couple of accounts run wider than that. You will sit in on client meetings alongside the CEO and the Customer Success Manager, and you will be the one answering the technical questions when they come.



Key Responsibilities

1. Run the ads

- Build, launch, and manage campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads

- Own audiences, offers, creative testing, budget pacing, learning phases, fatigue, and wasted spend

- Make the call on what to scale, what to kill, and what to test next, without asking permission for every budget change

- Monitor new launches closely through the first 72 hours

2. Write the ads

- Write ad copy, hooks, and angles for the campaigns you run

- Test copy the way you test everything else: against the number, not against opinion

- Feed the creative team what the data is telling you. Which hooks are holding attention, which formats are fatiguing, what the next round of creative needs to test. You are not writing the creative brief or art directing it, our creative lead and designers own that, but they need your read on performance to make good calls.

3. Own the tracking

- Set up and maintain pixel and CAPI, conversion events, and UTM structure across accounts

- Debug attribution when platform numbers and CRM numbers disagree, and they will disagree

- Connect ad platforms to client CRMs (GoHighLevel / Scale CRM and HubSpot) so spend ties back to booked revenue

- Know the difference between a platform-reported conversion and money in the client's bank account, and care about closing that gap

4. Report and recommend

- Own weekly and monthly performance reporting across your accounts

- Pull from the ad platforms and the CRM, and build the picture of where money is being made and lost

- Every report ends in a recommendation. A report without a "here is what we should do" is half finished.

- Use the 1-3-1: one problem, three possible solutions, one recommendation

5. Face the client

- Join client calls and speak to performance directly: what the numbers say, what changed, what you are doing about it

- Translate media buying into plain language for owners who do not think in ROAS

- Hold your position when the numbers support it, and say so plainly when a client's request will hurt their results

6. Self-QA

- Check your own work. Campaigns are set up correctly before they spend a dollar, and the numbers in a report are right before anyone sees them.

- Catch problems before the client does, fix them, then report what you fixed

-Document how your accounts and reporting work so nothing lives only in your head



Desired Experience & Requirements

- 2+ years managing multiple ad accounts at the same time. Agency side preferred. Running one in-house brand is not the same job.

- Meta Ads: deep, hands-on. You know the platform cold, not just the theory.

- Google Ads: real working knowledge across Search and Performance Max. Strong Meta with solid Google is fine.

- Tracking and attribution: you have set up pixel and CAPI yourself, and you have debugged a tracking problem rather than escalating it.

- Ad copywriting: you write your own ads and you can show us ones that worked.

- Data: comfortable in spreadsheets, able to structure messy data, able to find the story in the numbers. Looker Studio, Supermetrics, or similar is a plus.

- CRM: you can get into a CRM, find the lead and revenue data, and tie it to the ads. GoHighLevel and HubSpot are a plus; one CRM known well means you will learn ours.

- Client-facing: you can hold a performance conversation with a business owner without hiding behind jargon.

- AI-native: you use AI tools daily to move faster, and you know the difference between using AI and passing raw AI output off as your recommendation.

- Sole full-time commitment.



Tools You'll Work In

Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, GoHighLevel / Scale CRM, HubSpot, SegMetrics, Google Sheets, Looker Studio, Claude, Slack, Notion, Loom. We will teach you the ones you do not know if the core skills are there.



What Success Looks Like

1. First 30 days

Audited every ad account and its tracking setup, and flagged what is broken

Took over reporting for your accounts and shipped it on schedule without being chased

Named the top three opportunities and the top three leaks across the book

2. First 60 days

Running optimization independently, with recommendations the team acts on

Writing your own ad copy across accounts

Caught and fixed account or tracking issues before they reached a client

Speaking to your numbers on client calls

3. First 90 days

Owning paid media, copy, tracking, and reporting for the full book with light oversight

Shipped changes that moved real client numbers, and can prove which changes did it

The person everyone asks when they want to know where the money is going



KPIs

Cost per acquisition and qualified lead rate by account; return on ad spend; reporting delivered on time with a recommendation attached; tracking accuracy between platform and CRM; client retention on accounts you run.



Who This Is Not For

- People who can launch campaigns but cannot read the data behind them

- People who send reports without a recommendation attached

- People who need permission for every budget change

- People who escalate a tracking problem instead of solving it

- People who paste AI output through as their own thinking

- People who go quiet when something breaks

- People looking for a quiet remote job to coast in



Core Values (culture fit screen)

- Speed Is King. Momentum over sitting tasks, progress before perfection.

- Extreme Ownership. Treat the business like your own, fill gaps, bring ideas.

- Results Over Excuses. Half done is not done. Output quality over effort.

- Never Stop Growing. Noticeably better every 90 days.

- Clear and Direct Communication. Speak up early, bring solutions with problems.



What We Offer

Base salary with the opportunity for performance based bonuses. Bonuses are not guaranteed. They are earned on the results you drive, because we would rather reward someone for moving real numbers than pay a flat rate for activity.

This is a long-term seat, not a gig. You own paid media for the whole company, and as we grow the function grows under you. We promote from the inside when someone earns it.

Fully remote, permanently. We measure results, not hours logged.



How to Apply

1. Send us your portfolio

2. Tell us about a time the data changed how you were running an account. What did the numbers say, what did you change, and what happened after? Be specific. Bring real examples of campaigns you have run, ad copy you have written, and reporting you have built.





We read every application that shows us how you think. Generic applications do not make it past the first read.

title: Real Estate Media Quality Control (QC) Specialist
description:
Real Estate Media Quality Control (QC) Specialist



About the Position



We are hiring an experienced Real Estate Media Quality Control Specialist to serve as the final checkpoint before properties are delivered to our clients.



This is not an editing position.



Your job is to review the completed work of our editors, identify anything that is incorrect or incomplete, request revisions when needed, and personally deliver the finished property to the client.



Because you will be the person clicking the final Deliver button, attention to detail, judgment, communication, and accountability are extremely important.



If an editor misses something, you are expected to catch it before the client does.



You will be provided with a detailed Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) that outlines exactly what must be checked for every property. You will be expected to follow this SOP consistently and completely for every job.



What You'll Review



You will review completed property packages for:



Real estate photography quality



AI editing errors and artifacts



Virtual staging



Virtual twilight images



Photo order



Floor plans and room labels



Property videos



3D tours



Missing or incorrect deliverables



Client and photographer instructions



You should be able to identify problems such as poorly edited photos, incorrect exposure or color, blurry or duplicate images, photographer reflections, AI-altered architecture, unrealistic virtual staging, incorrect twilight edits, missing deliverables, incorrect photo order, or media from the wrong property.



Before delivery, you must carefully verify that everything is correct and that every item in the QC SOP has been completed.



Communication



Strong communication is essential for this role.



When you find a problem, you must clearly explain:



What is wrong



Where the problem is



What needs to be corrected



You will communicate directly with editors and our internal team, so your written English must be clear, professional, and easy to understand.



You must also know when to ask questions rather than guess.



Final Delivery Responsibility



Once a property passes QC, you will personally deliver it to the client through our media delivery platform.

title: Amazon Sourcing Career Built for 20 Years | Stable, Paid On Time, Remote
description:
TITLE: Amazon Sourcing Career Built for 20 Years | Stable, Paid On Time, Remote



READ THE ENTIRE POST BEFORE YOU APPLY. Important details are spread throughout, including exactly how to apply. If you skim, you'll miss them and your application won't be considered. That's the first test.



Most Amazon sourcing jobs are gigs. They last until an account gets suspended, a seller runs out of money, or a paycheck shows up late. Sourcing Squad HQ was built to be different.



WHY THIS ISN'T A GIG

- We've been operating for 2+ years, and we're planning for 20 or more.

- We source for TWO separate Amazon seller accounts. If one ever runs into trouble, the team keeps working and so does your paycheck.

- We pay every other Monday, on time. We have never missed a payment.

- Ian and Thomas, the owners, are closely involved, fair, and generous toward people who deliver. They're building a company meant to last, and they want people who will grow with it.

- Our top earners make $5-$9.50 per hour, with performance incentives on top of their hourly pay.



WHAT A CAREER HERE LOOKS LIKE

Stage 1, the trial (14 days, $3 USD/hour): We test your real skills. If you meet our expectations and are offered the next phase, you receive a $50 USD bonus at the end of the trial.

Stage 2, settling in (90 days, $3.50-$4.00/hour): You get comfortable with the team and the workflow.

Stage 3, long-term position: A potential pay increase, paid holidays, paid time off, and more.

Throughout: Performance incentives for great work, on top of your hourly pay.



We're telling you the starting rate up front so there are no surprises. We'd rather you d
 now than after you've spent an hour applying.



THE HONEST PART

We are one of the best sourcing teams in the space, and we're selective. We've hired 40 VAs and kept 6. That isn't because we're hard to work for. It's because a lot of applicants overstate their experience, and our trial shows it within the first 3-4 days. If you're a real sourcer, you'll feel at home on a team that works at your level. If you're not, we'll both know quickly.



THE PERSON WE'RE BUILDING WITH

A sourcer at heart. Someone who lives for the next deal, gets a rush from finding a winning lead, and wants a place to do it for years.



WHAT YOU DO

You'll find profitable, approvable Amazon leads using Keepa and SellerAmp and log them in Google Sheets. You'll catch the things that kill deals: gated and restricted brands, Amazon on the listing, price history collapses, variation mismatches, and IP-complaint brands. You'll deliver 10 quality leads per shift, with 8 as the minimum for a full shift.



Every lead has to meet both of these:

- 50% ROI minimum

- $7 profit per unit minimum

That's the baseline, not a stretch goal. If those numbers make you nervous, no hard feelings. This just isn't the job for you.



WHO CAN APPLY

- At least 4 years of hands-on Amazon product sourcing (online arbitrage), finding deals day in and day out

- Working knowledge of Keepa and SellerAmp

- Valid references from past employers that we can contact and verify



Only years spent sourcing products count toward the 4. Managing accounts, private label, wholesale, leading a team, and general "Amazon VA" work don't count. If your background is mostly in those areas, please don't apply.



YOUR SCHEDULE

Choose at least 4 weekdays to work. Weekends are open too. The only fixed requirement is 40 hours per week. Your days are set for the 14-day trial, and after that you can submit your availability week to week.



TIME TRACKING

Every VA on the team is tracked on Hubstaff, which takes a screenshot of your screen every 2 minutes. It keeps the time clock honest for everyone. If you work with integrity, you'll never think about it. If you have bad intentions, please skip this post.



WHAT WE VALUE MOST

Accuracy, honesty, and consistency, including saying "I'm not sure about this lead" when you aren't. We want people looking for a long-term home, not a quick gig.



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip any step are deleted unread)

Begin your message with the word SQUAD, then include:

1. A GOOD resume. We want real thought, real detail, and accurate information, not a quick resume from ChatGPT or Claude. Show us your tools, the categories you've sourced, and your results, and be honest.

2. A 2-3 minute unscripted video (Loom or similar) about your 4+ years of Amazon product sourcing. Cover your tools, your categories, and how many leads you delivered per day at your last job. Also tell us about the best deal you ever found. Real sourcers light up when they tell that story. The video must be
ed to 
 not sent through this platform.

3. The last product you rejected, and exactly why.

4. Two past employers or sellers we can contact for references (names and how to reach them).

5. Your availability for the 14-day trial: which 4+ weekdays you'd work (weekends are open too). After the trial, you can submit availability week to week.



WHERE THE VIDEO GOES

 your video, plus anything else you couldn't include with your initial application, to 
 SQUAD and your full name in the subject line. No video means an incomplete application, and incomplete applications aren't considered.



If you're the real deal, we'd love to hear from you. If you're not sure you meet the bar, this probably isn't the right fit, and that's okay.



This could be the long-term opportunity you've been looking for, to help better your life and your family's life. Our top earners are at $5-$9.50 per hour!! The growth is endless.

MedPro Disposal is the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company, serving 35,000+ healthcare providers across 48 states for the past 15 years. On that foundation, we launched MP1 Solutions to pioneer the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined healthcare compliance for decades. MP1 Solutions extends MedPro Disposal's operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading — with a technology-forward approach that's making this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that, backed by 15 years of MedPro Disposal's operational credibility — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. We're official partners with Google, Yelp, Meta, and Bing. Our stack includes GoHighLevel, AgencyAnalytics, WhatConverts, SearchAtlas, and a growing library of AI-powered tools built by our in-house dev team. We're a small, senior team where your work has a direct impact on real businesses.



THE ROLE:

We're looking for a Google Ads specialist who can own campaign performance end to end. You'll manage paid search, display, and local/maps campaigns for a portfolio of home service clients—from strategy and keyword research through to optimization and results.

This is a hands-on-keyboard role. You won't be sitting on client calls or building reports in spreadsheets. Account managers handle client communication, and our reporting tools handle the dashboards. Your job is to make campaigns perform.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:

- Build, launch, and continuously optimize Google Ads campaigns (search, display, local/maps) for home service clients

- Collaborate with in-house WordPress developers on landing page improvements that support campaign goals

Identify opportunities to scale winning campaigns and flag underperformers early

- Experience: 3+ years managing Google Ads campaigns

- Local focus: Proven results with local or home service verticals

- Analytical mindset: Comfortable digging into data to diagnose issues and spot opportunities

- Tools: Hands-on proficiency with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and Google Ads Editor

- Ad copywriting: You can write concise, benefit-driven ad copy that fits character limits and drives action

- Communication: Fluent written and spoken English

- Work style: Self-directed and reliable—you manage your own time and flag blockers before they become problems





NICE TO HAVE:

- Experience with GoHighLevel, AgencyAnalytics, or WhatConverts

- Familiarity with AI tools for ad copy, keyword research, or workflow automation (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.)

- Google Ads certification

- Experience managing multi-location or franchise campaigns





WHAT WE OFFER:

- Focus on your craft – Dedicated account managers handle all client communication. No client calls, no manual reporting—AgencyAnalytics and WhatConverts do the heavy lifting.

- Dev support – In-house WordPress developers for landing pages, plus automation engineers who can build custom tools for your workflow.

- Full tools stack – GoHighLevel, AgencyAnalytics, WhatConverts, SearchAtlas, Google Ads Editor, ChatGPT, Claude, Canva, and more.

- Compensation – Biweekly pay with performance-based bonuses. Salary grows as your portfolio grows.

- Flexibility – Flexible schedule with a reliable, async-friendly team.

title: GIS Specialist – ArcGIS, QGIS & CARTO
description:

* CARTO

* Spatial analysis and geoprocessing

* Creating professional maps and map layouts

* Working with shapefiles, GeoJSON, KML/KMZ, CSV and other GIS formats

* Data cleaning and quality control

* Creating and managing web maps



Experience with both desktop GIS and online/web mapping environments is important.

* Working with ArcGIS Online

* Converting between spatial data formats

* WebGIS

* Mapbox

### Work Arrangement

Work will be assigned depending on current projects. Some projects may require only a few hours, while others may require more substantial involvement.



Good communication and reliability are very important.



### Compensation



*$3–$5 USD/hour depending on experience and skills.*



Higher rates may be considered for candidates with strong CARTO, WebGIS, SQL/PostGIS, Python, or advanced GIS experience.

5. Your hourly rate in USD.

7. Whether you are comfortable working on an on-demand / project-by-project basis.



*Please include a portfolio or screenshots of previous GIS work if available.*

title: Remote Site Survey Project Coordinator
description:
Position Overview

At Mālama Solar, our success is fueled by well-established, repeatable organizational processes and by the strength of our Project Coordination team. We are looking for a Remote Site Survey Project Coordinator to support our solar projects by reviewing site survey information, solar PV designs, and project documentation to ensure projects are accurate and prepared to move forward through the installation process.

This position requires prior knowledge of solar PV systems with battery storage, strong attention to detail, and the ability to review technical project information and identify potential issues or missing information. The Remote Site Survey Project Coordinator will work closely with internal project coordination, design, operations, and field teams to help ensure projects are properly reviewed and prepared for their next stage.



Key Responsibilities



Site Survey & Project Review

Review site survey information and documentation for completeness and accuracy.

Review site survey photos and/or solar PV installation photos to identify relevant site conditions, equipment, electrical components, roof conditions, and other project details.

Identify missing, incomplete, inconsistent, or potentially inaccurate information that may impact system design, permitting, installation, or other project requirements.

Communicate identified issues or additional information needed to the appropriate internal team members.

Ensure required site survey documentation, photos, designs, and project information are properly organized and maintained within company systems.



Project Coordination

Coordinate project-related activities and tasks to help ensure projects move efficiently through the site survey, design, and pre-installation process.

Track project statuses and update internal systems to accurately reflect progress, milestones, outstanding items, and resolutions.

Coordinate with technicians, project managers, designers, and other team members to obtain necessary project information and documentation.

Maintain organized and accurate records of project activities, applications, photos, designs, and other relevant documentation.

Follow established company processes and timelines while managing multiple projects and priorities.

Provide support to other departments and assist with related tasks as needed to support overall company operations.



Cross-Functional Collaboration

Communicate and coordinate effectively with internal teams, including field technicians, design, project coordination, operations, sales, and customer service.

Clearly communicate missing information, discrepancies, or potential project concerns to the appropriate team members.

Identify recurring issues or trends and communicate them to management to support process improvements.

Work collaboratively with team members to resolve project issues and help prevent delays.

Customer Communication, As Needed

This position is primarily focused on internal project coordination and technical review and is not a heavily customer-facing role. However, occasional customer communication may be required depending on project needs.

When communicating with customers:

Maintain a positive, empathetic, and professional attitude.

Respond promptly and professionally to customer questions or concerns.

Acknowledge and appropriately address customer needs or route them to the appropriate team member.

Explain technical information in a clear, concise, and simple manner when needed.

Include the words PV Ready in your title to be considered. Applications without this will not be considered.



Required Qualifications

Previous experience working with solar PV systems with battery storage.

Experience reviewing or working with solar PV system designs, including designs incorporating battery storage.

Experience with or familiarity reviewing site survey photos and/or solar PV installation photos.

Ability to understand and evaluate technical project information related to residential solar PV and battery installations.

Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify missing information, inconsistencies, or potential project issues.

Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, process-driven environment.

Strong written communication skills and the ability to communicate clearly with internal team members.

Comfortable learning and working within customer relationship management (CRM), project management, design, and other technology platforms.

Problem-solving mindset with the ability to investigate project issues and determine what information or next steps are needed.



Work Environment

Full-time remote position based in the Philippines.

Requires consistent communication and collaboration with Mālama Solar's U.S.-based team.

Must be comfortable working independently in a remote environment while following established processes, deadlines, and quality standards.

Work schedule will be established based on the operational needs of Mālama Solar and required collaboration with the Hawaiʻi-based team.
