title: UGC Content Editor
description:
About the role

I’m a full-time UGC creator and creative strategist producing paid video content for brands and agencies across supplements, skincare, wellness, home goods, pet, food & beverage, apps, and more. I film everything myself — I need an editor who can take my raw footage and turn it into finished, brief-compliant deliverables that go straight to the brand without me rebuilding them.



This content will be for both META ads, as well as organic content. Understanding the nuances of paid ads and organic content is important as well as the ability to adhere to brand requirements.



This is not “make it look cool” editing. Every video is tied to a paid brief with rules attached: required hooks, banned words, mandatory disclosures, exact runtimes, specific product moments that must appear on screen. Your job is to make the footage feel effortless and native to TikTok/Reels while hitting every single requirement in the brief.



If you’re strong, this becomes ongoing, recurring work with steady volume because the more work we can create together (I record, you edit) we both win! I see this continuing to grow and scale throughout the rest of 2026 and beyond.



What you’ll do



 • Edit raw vertical footage into finished UGC deliverables, typically 15–60 seconds in length

 • Read and follow the brand brief closely — angle, hook, runtime, CTA, required callouts, banned language, and any compliance restrictions

 • Review brand-supplied example and reference videos and match the pacing, style, and editing feel

 • Tighten pacing: trim filler words (“um,” “like,” “so”), dead air, false starts, and long pauses without making the delivery sound choppy or robotic

 • Build a strong hook in the first 3 seconds from my footage — often the brief specifies this, sometimes you’ll need to find the best take

 • Cut multiple versions of the same concept when requested (e.g. 15s / 30s / 45s, or 3 different hook variations on one body)

 • Layer in b-roll, product close-ups, unboxing, and screen recordings where the brief calls for it.

 • Add captions/subtitles that are accurate, well-timed, readable on mobile, and styled to match the brand or platform norm

 • Add sound and music only from commercially safe/royalty-free sources — many briefs explicitly ban copyrighted audio

 • Add on-screen text, simple graphics, product/label callouts, and disclosure text (#ad, “Individual results vary,” etc.) when required

 • Basic color correction and audio cleanup so cuts don’t jump between clips

 • Export to spec (resolution, aspect ratio, file type, file naming) and deliver to the correct folder in Google Drive

 • Flag problems early — missing shots, unusable audio, a required element I didn’t film, or anything in the footage that would violate the brief



Requirements

 • Proven experience editing short-form vertical content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, or paid social ads (UGC ad experience strongly preferred over vlog/YouTube editing)

 • Fluent in CapCut, Canva, or a comparable editing tool (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut also fine — CapCut fluency is a big plus)

 • Comfortable working from written briefs and following instructions exactly, including restrictions on what cannot be said or shown

 • Excellent English comprehension — you need to hear filler words, catch a misread line, and know when a take doesn’t land

 • Strong sense of pacing and rhythm for short-form; you know when a cut is a half-second too long

 • Reliable with deadlines. Brand deadlines are firm and revisions are on tight turnarounds

 • Comfortable with Google Drive; ClickUp or similar project tools a plus

 • Able to accept feedback and turn revisions around quickly and without friction

Nice to have

 • Familiarity with UGC platforms like JoinBrands, Billo, Insense, or Amazon shoppable video and their spec/compliance requirements

 • Understanding of FTC disclosure basics and ad compliance (no medical claims, no guarantee language, etc.)

 • Ability to build simple motion text, animated captions, or light graphic overlays

 • Experience editing Amazon and Meta ad creative specifically



How you’ll work with me

 • I deliver raw footage + the brand brief + any reference videos in a shared Drive folder. I will record a loom video explaining in more detail if needed. We can also communicate specifics via WhatsApp.

 • You edit, export to spec, and drop the finished file back in the same folder by the agreed deadline

 • I review and send revision notes if needed — my revision rate with brands is under 10% and I want to keep it there

 • Communication over email or WhatsApp. I’m responsive and I give clear notes,



I am open to looking at an hourly rate and also a per-deliverable rate. It will definitely depend on what we are able to produce in what time and keeping in mind most jobs are simple edits and more rarely will there be complex projects and those can also be handled on a case by case basis as we get into a good flow and routine.



I said roughly 10 hours per week but can be flexible, especially if you’re looking for more work.

title: Wedding Photo Video / Slideshow Editor Needed
description:

Begin with our trip / Sedona

Build into photos from our private wedding

End with one of our strongest photos

Transition naturally into our first dance



I’ll provide all high-resolution photos and the song/music.



When applying, please send me 2–3 examples of your best cinematic or emotional photo/video edits. Wedding experience is a plus, but not required.



This is a one-time project with a quick turnaround.

ORGANIC SOCIAL MEDIA GROWTH & AFFILIATE MARKETING VA



**Part-Time | 6–20 Hours/Week | Paid Trial | Long-Term Opportunity | Remote**



I am hiring an experienced **Organic Social Media Growth & Affiliate Marketing VA** for an established e-commerce/affiliate content business.



## IMPORTANT — I PROVIDE THE CONTENT



**I create and provide the finished product-focused video content.**



You are **NOT** being hired to film or create my original product content.



Your role is to take the content I provide and **strategically repurpose, optimize, distribute, and manage it across
, Instagram, Pinterest, and YouTube Shorts** to generate measurable organic growth, qualified traffic, link clicks, conversions, and affiliate revenue.



I am **not** looking for someone who simply posts the same video everywhere.



You must understand how to adapt existing content for each platform, optimize it for discovery and conversion, analyze performance, and improve the strategy based on measurable results.



## RESPONSIBILITIES



You will:



* Repurpose the **existing product video content I provide**

* Adapt and format provided content appropriately for each platform

* Create platform-specific hooks, captions, titles, descriptions, keywords, hashtags when appropriate, and calls to action

* Apply **Social SEO** to improve organic discovery

* Schedule and publish content consistently

* Develop and execute an **organic social-media growth strategy**

* Optimize Pinterest content for search, discovery, outbound clicks, and long-term traffic

* Monitor engagement and identify growth opportunities

* Identify which products, videos, hooks, formats, posting strategies, and platforms perform best

* Test and improve content presentation based on actual performance data

* Track relevant KPIs, including reach, impressions, views, watch time, engagement, saves, shares, profile activity, link clicks, CTR, traffic, conversions, and affiliate revenue when available

* Provide concise performance reports explaining **what is working, what is not working, and what should be adjusted next**

* Use analytics to continually improve organic reach, qualified traffic, conversions, and revenue



## AFFILIATE COMPLIANCE & FTC REQUIREMENTS



You must understand and follow applicable:



* **FTC endorsement and affiliate-disclosure requirements**

* Affiliate marketing disclosure requirements

* Platform-specific advertising and disclosure policies

* Requirements for clearly and conspicuously disclosing affiliate relationships and other material connections

* Proper placement of disclosures so they are easy for consumers to notice and understand

* Requirements for avoiding misleading claims, unsupported product statements, or deceptive marketing practices

* Content-rights and responsible-use requirements for the media provided to you



You must understand that a required affiliate disclosure should **not be hidden, vague, difficult to notice, or assumed to be covered simply because information appears elsewhere on a profile or website.**



Compliance is part of this position, not an optional responsibility.



## YOU ARE NOT BEING HIRED TO:



* Film original product videos

* Create my original product reviews

* Source products

* Develop my original product-review content

* Replace my existing content-production process



**I create the original content. Your responsibility begins with strategically repurposing, optimizing, distributing, managing, and measuring the performance of the content I provide.**



## PRIMARY OBJECTIVE



This position is **not simply about posting consistently, gaining followers, or collecting likes.**



The objective is:



**Organic Reach → Engagement → Qualified Traffic → Link Clicks → Conversions → Affiliate Revenue**



Follower growth and engagement matter, but the ultimate objective is to build social channels that consistently generate **qualified traffic and measurable business results.**



## EXPERIENCE & SKILLS REQUIRED



I am looking for someone with real, hands-on experience producing **organic social-media growth and measurable results.**



Experience with **e-commerce, affiliate marketing, product-based businesses, or consumer products** is strongly preferred.



You should understand:



*
 and Instagram Reels

* Pinterest strategy

* YouTube Shorts

* Social SEO

* Short-form video optimization

* Strategic repurposing of existing content

* Platform-specific content optimization

* Canva

* CapCut or comparable editing software

* Meta Business Suite

* Content scheduling

* Analytics and KPI tracking

* Organic traffic generation

* Conversion-focused calls to action

* Affiliate marketing

* FTC endorsement and affiliate-disclosure requirements

* Platform-specific advertising/disclosure policies

* Clear and conspicuous affiliate disclosures

* Avoiding misleading or unsupported product claims

* Content rights, permissions, and responsible use of provided media

* Using analytics and performance data to improve future results



You must be able to **work independently, think strategically, bring ideas, identify opportunities, analyze results, and make data-driven adjustments.**



I want someone who can take the content I provide, understand the product and target audience, determine how it should be presented on each platform, measure its performance, and continually improve the strategy.



**This is not a basic posting or data-entry position.**



## HOURS & COMPENSATION



This position begins **part-time with a paid trial period.**



**Hourly rate: $4–$8 USD/hour, based on demonstrated experience, skills, established rate, and verifiable results.**



**Hours: Approximately 6–20 hours per week.**



The number of weekly hours offered will depend on the agreed hourly rate, relevant experience, demonstrated value, performance, availability, and business needs.



**The top of the hourly range is NOT automatic.**



Applicants must provide their **normal hourly rate and requested hourly rate**.



If your requested rate is significantly higher than the hourly rate currently listed on your OnlineJobs.ph profile, you must explain what experience, demonstrated results, or additional value justifies the difference.



There is potential for additional hours and responsibility based on performance and business growth.



**All paid working hours must be tracked through TimeProof.**



## HOW TO APPLY — FOLLOW THESE INSTRUCTIONS EXACTLY



Your application must begin with the secret word:



# **GRACE**



**GRACE must be the FIRST word in your application.**



If GRACE is not the first word, your application will **not** be considered.



Generic, AI-generated, or copy-and-paste responses that do not specifically answer the questions below will not be considered.



I want specific examples of work **YOU personally performed** and results **YOU personally achieved.**



After writing **GRACE**, number your answers **1–13** and answer **EVERY question.**



### 1.



How many years have you personally managed social-media accounts for businesses, brands, e-commerce companies, affiliate businesses, or product-based businesses?



### 2.



Which social-media platforms have you personally managed?



### 3.



Provide links to **2–3 accounts YOU personally managed** and state exactly **how long you managed each account.**



### 4.



For each account, explain exactly what **YOU personally handled**, including any:



* Strategy

* Content repurposing

* Editing

* Hooks/captions

* Posting/scheduling

* Engagement

* Social SEO

* Pinterest strategy

* Analytics/reporting

* Affiliate disclosures

* FTC compliance



### 5.



Provide **1–2 specific examples of measurable organic growth YOU personally produced.**



For each example, provide:



* Starting point

* Ending point

* Time period

* Your specific responsibilities

* Strategy or changes YOU implemented

* Measurable results



Results may include:



* Reach/impressions

* Followers

* Video views/watch time

* Engagement

* Saves/shares

* Profile visits

* Link clicks

* CTR

* Website traffic

* Affiliate traffic

* Leads

* Conversions

* Sales/revenue



### 6.



Provide **analytics screenshots or other evidence supporting your claimed results** whenever available.



If you no longer have access to historical analytics, state that clearly.



**Do not estimate, exaggerate, or invent results.**



### 7.



Provide links to **2–3 specific pieces of social content YOU personally repurposed, edited, optimized, or managed.**



For each example, explain:



* What YOU personally did

* Which platform it was for

* Why you optimized it that way

* How you handled required affiliate/advertising disclosures

* Measurable results, if available



### 8.



Describe your experience with **e-commerce and/or affiliate marketing.**



Have you personally been responsible for increasing **traffic, link clicks, conversions, sales, or affiliate revenue?**



If yes, provide specific examples and measurable results.



Also explain your knowledge and experience with:



* FTC endorsement requirements

* Affiliate disclosures

* Material connections

* Platform-specific disclosure policies

* Clear and conspicuous disclosures

* Avoiding misleading or unsupported product claims



### 9.



Describe your **Pinterest experience specifically.**



Have you personally used Pinterest to generate measurable **outbound traffic or link clicks**?



If yes, provide a specific example and measurable results.



Also explain how you handle affiliate disclosures and platform-policy compliance on Pinterest.



### 10.



Assume you begin working with me tomorrow.



**I already have a library of finished product-focused video content.**



Explain specifically what you would do during your **first two weeks** to build an organic growth and traffic strategy using my existing content.



Include how you would:



* Review and organize the existing content

* Identify target audiences and content opportunities

* Develop a platform-specific repurposing strategy

* Establish a publishing schedule

* Establish disclosure/compliance procedures

* Establish baseline KPIs and reporting

* Test hooks, formats, calls to action, and posting strategies

* Use early performance data to improve the strategy



### 11.



I provide you with one finished **60-second product video.**



Explain how you would repurpose and optimize that same source content differently for:



*

* Instagram

* Pinterest

* YouTube Shorts



I want to see that you understand **platform-specific repurposing**, rather than simply uploading the identical video and caption everywhere.



Also explain **where and how you would handle any required affiliate or advertising disclosure on each platform.**



### 12.



State all three:



* Your **normal hourly rate in USD**

* Your **requested hourly rate for this position**

* Your **current weekly availability**



If your requested rate is significantly higher than the hourly rate currently shown on your OnlineJobs.ph profile, explain **what experience, demonstrated results, or additional value justifies the difference.**



### 13.



Are you comfortable using **TimeProof for ALL paid working hours?**



Please include your **portfolio and relevant work samples.**



I value **reliability, communication, initiative, attention to detail, honesty, strategic thinking, compliance awareness, and measurable results.**



I am looking for someone interested in a **stable, long-term working relationship** who can take the content I already produce and turn it into an effective organic social-media system that increases **reach, qualified traffic, conversions, and affiliate revenue over time.**

title: Senior Full Stack Developer For Payment Systems - Next.js and other technologies
description:

You should be highly experienced in modern JavaScript frameworks, cloud-based deployment workflows, and production-ready engineering practices. We are especially looking for someone with strong Next.js, Docker, and CI/CD pipeline experience, and a proven track record of shipping real applications that users actively use.

Build and maintain modern web applications using Next.js, React, and related technologies

Architect scalable frontend and backend systems

Set up, improve, and manage CI/CD pipelines

Containerize applications and services using Docker

Deploy and manage applications across staging and production environments

Collaborate with product, design, and other developers to deliver polished features

Write clean, testable, maintainable code

Review code, improve engineering standards, and help guide technical decisions

Troubleshoot production issues and optimize performance, reliability, and security

Take ownership of projects from concept to launch

Required Skills

Strong senior-level experience as a full-stack or web developer

Expert-level experience with Next.js and React

Strong knowledge of JavaScript and/or TypeScript

Experience building and launching production-ready web applications

Good understanding of performance optimization, security, and best practices

Ability to work independently in a remote environment

Nice to Have

Applications without live project examples and a video introduction will not be considered. We want to review real work, understand your communication style, and get a sense of how you think about building products.

And answer this question-if you use AI tools for development or QA, how have you optimized them or made them more effective?

title: Booking Agent
description:
Allure Agency is a luxury event staffing agency providing professional event personnel for corporate events, brand activations, hospitality experiences, productions, and other elevated events.



We are seeking a highly organized, dependable, and detail-oriented **Booking Agent** to join our operations team and help ensure every client booking is staffed and executed seamlessly.



Position Overview

The Booking Agent is responsible for coordinating the staffing fulfillment process from the time a booking is received through final staff confirmation and event execution.



This position serves as the operational connection between **Client Relations, Allure Management, HR/Staffing, and event personnel**.



The ideal candidate is comfortable managing multiple bookings, communicating with staff, working under time-sensitive conditions, and resolving staffing challenges quickly and professionally.



Key Responsibilities

Staffing & Booking Coordination

* Receive and review incoming staffing requests

* Review event details, staffing requirements, location, schedule, and client expectations

* Identify qualified personnel based on availability, experience, role requirements, and reliability

* Prepare and share a **staff deck with Allure Management for client review and approval**

* Confirm approved staff assignments and communicate event details

* Ensure all positions are fully staffed within the required timeframe

* Secure standby personnel for emergency situations**, including call-outs, cancellations, and no-call/no-show i



Staff Communication & Coordination

* Communicate booking details, schedules, locations, dress requirements, and event expectations to assigned personnel

* Obtain and document staff confirmations

* Conduct pre-event confirmation and readiness checks

* Monitor staff communication leading up to the event

* Coordinate immediate replacements when staffing changes occur



Scheduling & System Management

* Maintain accurate staffing schedules and booking records

* Update internal staffing systems, Google Sheets, CRM, or scheduling platforms

* Track confirmed staff, pending confirmations, open positions, and standby personnel

* Ensure booking information remains accurate and current



Event-Day Support

* Monitor staffing coverage for assigned events

* Respond promptly to call-outs, no-shows, or last-minute staffing issues

* Activate standby personnel when necessary

* Communicate significant staffing issues to Allure Management

* Help ensure every event maintains appropriate staffing coverage



Quality Control

* Assign personnel who meet Allure Agency's professional and client-specific standards

* Consider staff reliability and performance history when making assignments

* Document recurring attendance or performance issues

* Communicate concerns to HR/Staffing and Management

* Help maintain a dependable, high-quality talent pool



What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate is:

* Highly organized and detail-oriented

* Dependable and accountable

* An excellent communicator

* Comfortable managing multiple priorities simultaneously

* Able to work effectively under pressure

* Strong at follow-up and time-sensitive communication

* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, scheduling systems, and digital communication platforms

* Experienced in staffing, hospitality, events, scheduling, customer service, or operations preferred



Role Expectations

The Booking Agent is expected to take ownership of staffing fulfillment and ensure that no booking is left unattended.

**Accuracy, communication, urgency, and follow-through are essential to success in this position.**



The Booking Agent should consistently work to ensure:

* Bookings are properly reviewed

* Qualified staff are identified

* Staff decks are prepared and submitted for approval

* Assignments are confirmed

* Backup personnel are secured when appropriate

* Staffing changes are addressed quickly

* All booking information is accurately documented



Key Performance Indicators

Performance may be evaluated based on:

* Booking fulfillment rate

* Staff confirmation rate

* Response and turnaround time

* Scheduling accuracy

* Staff attendance and coverage

* Reduction in last-minute staffing gaps

* Effectiveness in managing call-outs and no-shows

* Communication and follow-through

* Overall operational reliability



We are looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates effectively, follows through on commitments, and understands the importance of delivering a consistently professional staffing experience.

title: Experienced IT Project Manager for Payment / Merchant Services Company
description:
Remote / Full-Time

Time Zone: EST 



What the job actually is



You will run the dev board. Every bug, feature, merchant escalation, and compliance item lands there, and you d
 what gets worked next, who takes it, and when it ships. Right now that's split between the founder and whoever is loudest that morning. It needs to be one person.



Day to day that means:



- Triaging incoming work. A merchant reporting "charged but declined" is usually an auth hold, not a bug. A chargeback fee landing in the wrong balance account is a bug and it costs us money. You need to tell those apart within a day or two of starting.

- Writing tickets engineers don't have to rewrite. Repro steps, which merchant, which processor, which environment, what the expected behavior is. If you're guessing, say you're guessing.

- Running releases. We ship to production several times a day by tagging master. Coolify picks up the tag, builds, swaps the container. You'll coordinate what goes in each tag, hold the money-path changes for a live transaction check, and make sure someone actually watched the deploy finish instead of assuming.

- Chasing verification. "Merged" is not done. Done is serving on production and someone looked at it. A lot of our follow-up tickets are "human needs to click through this in a browser." You'll assign those and close them.

- Being the point of contact for the outside review firm we bring in on payments code, and for processor reps at Adyen and Stripe when an integration question needs a human.

- Keeping the PCI paperwork moving. We're PCI DSS v4.0. Quarterly scans, policy docs, network diagrams, evidence for the QSA. Not glamorous, has deadlines.



What you need to know about the engineering side



You are not writing code, but you have to be able to follow what the devs are doing well enough to spot when a ticket is under-scoped or a PR is riskier than it looks. Concretely:



- The app is one Next.js 14 codebase (App Router, TypeScript) with four portals: admin, merchant dashboard, agent, and affiliate. Postgres behind Prisma. You should be able to read a PR description, look at which files changed, and know whether it touches payments, webhooks, or a database migration.

- Dev and prod share a database. Migrations must be additive. If a ticket says "rename a column" or "drop a table," that's a conversation, not a task. We've lost data twice from careless schema commands and it will not happen a third time on your watch.

- We integrate with Adyen (balance platform, splits, rolling reserves, POS terminals, multi-region US/UK/CA), Stripe Connect (newer, five merchants migrated so far, more coming), PayPal, NMI, Dejavoo, and a BTCPay box for crypto. Each has its own webhook shape, its own sandbox quirks, and its own way of failing quietly. You don't need to know the APIs. You need to know which processor a merchant is on before you route their ticket.

- Money is in cents as integers everywhere. Reserves, commissions, chargeback fees, dispute evidence, refunds that the merchant funds but the platform keeps commission on. When an engineer says "the split calculator" or "the liable account," you should know roughly what they mean after your first month.

- We have WooCommerce and Shopify plugins, an Android POS app pushed through MDM, and a virtual terminal. Plugin releases and app builds have their own cadence and their own test gaps.

- Infra is Docker on Hetzner via Coolify. Crons live in Coolify scheduled tasks, not in the repo. Backups are restic with an off-site mirror. If a cron silently stops, the first place to look is Coolify, and you should know that without being told twice.

- The team works heavily with AI coding tools. PRs get generated fast. That means more review load, not less, and it means "the build passed" carries less weight than it used to. You'll be the one asking "did anyone actually open this page."



Who does well here



- Someone who has managed engineers at a fintech, payments company, or ISO/payfac and knows why a $0.30 rounding difference matters.

- Has run a release process where a bad deploy costs real money, and has the instinct to hold a change rather than push it Friday afternoon.

- Direct. We don't need status decks. We need "these three tickets are blocked on Adyen, this one is blocked on you, and this one shipped at 2pm and I checked it."

- OK with a small company. There's no PMO. You are the PMO.



Nice to have



- PCI DSS experience, especially SAQ-D or a QSA audit cycle.

- Prior work with Adyen or Stripe Connect on the platform side, not just as a merchant.

- Has used Jira, Linear, or a homegrown board and has opinions about ticket hygiene.





To Apply:

Send your resume along with a short video intro. Failure to do so may result in your application getting ignored.

title: Amazon Listing & Creative Optimization Lead - Part-Time
description:
Own Amazon listing creative end to end for our pizza-making accessories brand: the research, the direction, the production and the tests. Part-time, remote worldwide, working directly with a founder with 10+ years in e-commerce.



You own the direction and the call on what to test. This role does not manage PPC campaigns.



Apply here: 



Compensation: Up to USD 35/hour, depending on experience, demonstrated results, and level of ownership. 

We are looking for the best fit, not the lowest bidder.



Initial commitment: 10-15 hours per week; exact monthly capacity agreed before the start.

Engagement: Part-time independent contractor. The first 90 days are the initial engagement.

Location: Remote. Worldwide.

Collaboration: Mostly asynchronous, with 1 weekly decision call.

Time zones: You choose your hours. We agree on a recurring window you can keep, plus a slot for the weekly call. We plan in Europe/Warsaw time.

Works directly with: Founder.



________________





The opportunity



Most Amazon listings lose the customer for a single reason. The main image says the wrong thing, the gallery answers the wrong question, or the copy repeats what every competitor writes. Your job is to find that reason and remove it, with evidence.





Atlanti Brands has built and sold e-commerce brands, mostly on Amazon. You work on the brands we are building now: Pizza-making accessories brand for customers in the US, UK, EU and Canada, plus 2 smaller brands. 





You own this loop:





evidence → purchase barrier → creative direction → brief → production → QA → publish → test → decision





The founder owns the product, the positioning and the budget. You focus on one main priority and one smaller task at a time.





You also help choose what we sell next. For product ideas on the founder's shortlist, you review customer and market evidence and recommend what to test.

What you own

* Turn evidence into priorities. Use reviews, search and performance data, competitor research, and customer tests such as PickFu to identify the biggest opportunities across current listings, ad creative, and upcoming launches. Build a clear, capacity-ordered backlog.

* Own the creative direction. D
 the listing SEO approach, message order, and direction for main images, galleries, A+ Content, product videos, video ads, and static ads.

* Make small edits yourself using our tools and AI. Create wireframes and mock-ups, revise copy and layouts, localize existing assets, and generate or refine AI images. Brief specialists when the work requires advanced retouching, photography, 3D, or video production.

* Lead production through publication. Find, brief, and manage freelancers, specialists, and UGC creators. Accept or reject their work against our product facts, claims, and usage rules. Upload approved assets in Seller Central and verify that they appear correctly in each marketplace and placement. You remain accountable for the final result.

* Test, d
, and record. Run A/B tests of listing and ad creative, supported by creative-level ad reporting. Distinguish decision-ready results from early signals, and keep a light, AI-assisted record of what changed, what happened, and what we learned.

What success looks like by Day 90

* Deliver creative packages for 3 new product launches. Lead each package from customer and market research through SEO copy, main image, gallery, A+ Content, product video, ad creative, and final QA. If the third product is not ready, complete the agreed backup project instead.

* Improve our priority listings and ad creative. Use an AI-assisted portfolio audit and focused customer research to identify the biggest conversion gaps and complete the highest-priority improvements.

* Build a scalable video and ad creative library. Develop strong master concepts, reusable footage, and efficient variants, then localize the agreed listing videos and ad creative for priority European marketplaces with a video editor.

* Create a repeatable testing and decision system. Start useful A/B tests when traffic and eligibility allow. Turn completed tests into clear decisions to keep, improve, or stop, and record early signals and blockers when a final result is not yet available.





By Day 90 you should manage day-to-day creative priorities, briefs, specialist feedback, publication and follow-up without daily direction.

How the engagement works

* Capacity. We reserve and pay for about 10-15 hours per week during the first 90 days. We agree on the exact time allocation before the start, together with a recurring working window that fits your time zone. Extra hours are agreed in advance.

* If a blocker is on our side. If something we owe you stops the main task, we still pay the agreed hours. You stay available and complete other ready work. Tell us early when something on our side is holding you up.

* After Day 90. Our goal is a long-term working relationship. After the first 90 days, we review the results and how we work together, then agree on the next scope and capacity in writing.

* Contract and payment. This is an independent contractor engagement. You invoice us monthly in USD.

Why work with us

* Real ownership. Work directly with the founder, learn from 10 years of building e-commerce brands and see your impact across multiple marketplaces.

* Support, not bureaucracy. We give you product facts, templates and AI workflows. We fund approved research and specialists. You get direct feedback and fast decisions.

* Paid reserved capacity. We pay for the capacity we reserve, not only for completed deliverables.

* Room to improve how we work. We expect direct communication. If a part of our process is wrong, say so, propose a better way, and help us implement it.

What you need

* You have owned Amazon listing creative outcomes. You have led Amazon listing creative work from direction through production. You can brief and manage freelancers, give clear feedback, and accept or reject their work against defined standards. SEO-only experience, support work, or producing assets from someone else's brief is not enough.

* You know the Amazon creative craft. You understand listing SEO, conversion copy, main images, galleries, A+ Content, product video, and ad creative.

* You can defend and execute a creative direction. You have strong visual judgment and can explain the evidence behind your decisions. Using Canva, Photoshop, AI image tools, or equivalent software, you can create wireframes and mock-ups and make simple asset edits yourself - such as a new main image variant, copy or layout changes, localized versions, and AI-generated or refined images.

* You use data and AI responsibly. You understand basic commercial math and attribution, and use AI for research, audits, and creative work. You check sources, apply your own judgment, say what the data cannot prove, and record decisions for future use.

* You can work in English. You can write a clear brief and discuss decisions live. Accent and occasional grammar mistakes do not matter.





Useful but not required: experience with PickFu, Intellivy, ProductPinion, or Amazon Manage Your Experiments. Pizza-making experience or a genuine interest in the category is also a plus.

How to apply and what to expect

1. Application. Tell us about your relevant experience and describe 1 relevant project.

Apply here: tally.so/r/PdJKOb

2. Shortlist screen. Selected candidates complete a short, unpaid simulated task. Some candidates are invited to a brief follow-up discussion.

3. Paid finalist case. Finalists complete a 4-hour case for USD 100. We pay the fee regardless of whether an offer is made. Selected candidates then have a 30-minute discussion. We hold a final mutual-fit conversation with the preferred finalist and may, with permission, contact 1 reference if a specific question remains.

title: Operations Coordinator
description:
Operations Coordinator





About the Role 

 

Reports to: Founder 

Our client is an established pool service company that has been operating for approximately two and a half years and currently services around 230 properties on a weekly basis. The company has a team of five full-time employees and is continuing to grow, with plans to add another team member and expand into concrete prefab pool construction. 



We're looking for an Operations Coordinator who can become a reliable extension of the Founder and take ownership of the day-to-day administrative and operational work that keeps the business moving. 



This role is designed to take significant operational work off the Founder's plate. You'll help manage scheduling changes, billing and invoice follow-up, work orders, customer information, supplier coordination, and other recurring tasks that require someone to stay organized and follow through.



As the company expands into construction, the role will also support additional coordination and administrative responsibilities related to projects, permits, subcontractors, and keeping work on track. 



This is not a basic task-based administrative role. We are looking for someone who takes initiative, can work independently after receiving direction, and knows how to identify what needs to happen next without requiring constant hand-holding. When urgent work is under control, this person should be able to look at the backlog and proactively work on important projects or process improvements. 



The right person will also have the opportunity to help build and improve the company's processes. While property information is already stored in the system, you will help document any workflows that need to be revised or updated. This role can help turn training and existing knowledge into SOPs, trackers, and repeatable processes that can be maintained as the company grows. 

 

 

What You’ll Own 

 

Operations & Scheduling 

• Daily Scheduling: Monitor daily routes and make necessary schedule adjustments when changes arise.

• Last-Minute Coordination: Respond quickly to schedule changes, service issues, and other time-sensitive operational needs.  

• Route Support: Assist with maintaining accurate routes and ensuring new customers and service information are properly entered into Skimmer.  

• Operational Follow-Through: Keep track of outstanding items and make sure tasks are followed through to completion.  

• Founder Support: Take operational items off the Founder's plate so he can focus on higher-level business priorities. 

 

 

Skimmer & Work Order Management 

• Skimmer Administration: Become highly proficient in Skimmer and use it as the central system for day-to-day operational coordination.  

• Work Orders: Create and manage work orders based on repair and service needs.  

• Repair Coordination: Coordinate with the repair technician, Blaine, to ensure work orders are properly documented and tracked.  

• Completion Tracking: Confirm that work has been completed and that the appropriate information is documented in the system.  

• Customer Follow-Up: Help communicate updates to customers regarding completed repairs, service issues, and other operational matters.  

• Property Information: Maintain accurate property-specific information within the system. 

 

 

Billing & Invoice Support 

• Monthly Billing: Assist with reviewing automatically generated invoices and identifying discrepancies or missed billing so revenue is not overlooked.  

• Invoice Follow-Up: Track outstanding invoices and follow up as needed.  

• Billing Accuracy: Review billing information carefully and flag issues that require the Founder's attention.  

• Quotes: Assist with preparing, organizing, or following up on quotes as needed.  

  

Note: QuickBooks bookkeeping and reconciliation are handled by an existing bookkeeper and are not a primary responsibility for this role. 

 

 

Vendor & Supplier Coordination 

• Supplier Payments: Help coordinate recurring supplier payments and administrative follow-up.  

• Pricing Checks: Compare supplier pricing and identify opportunities or discrepancies that need attention.  

• Vendor Communication: Follow up with vendors and suppliers to keep operational needs moving.  

• Issue Resolution: Track outstanding vendor-related items and escalate anything requiring the Founder's involvement. 

 

Construction Operations Support 

As our client expands into concrete prefab pool installations, this role will support the administrative and coordination work associated with the new construction side of the business.  

• Project Coordination: Help keep construction-related tasks organized and moving forward.  

• Permit Support: Assist with administrative follow-up related to permits and project requirements.  

• Subcontractor Coordination: Help keep track of subcontractor communication, schedules, and outstanding items.  

• Project Follow-Through: Monitor open items and make sure important tasks do not fall through the cracks. 

 

Process & SOP Development 

• Process Documentation: Help document recurring workflows that are currently handled informally.  

• SOP Creation: Turn training, recorded walkthroughs, and existing knowledge into clear and usable SOPs.  

• Trackers: Create and maintain trackers for recurring operational workflows when appropriate.  

• Process Ownership: Take ownership of processes after learning them and keep documentation updated as the business evolves.  

• Property Knowledge: Learn the operational details associated with the company's properties and use that knowledge to support the team effectively. 

 

Administrative & Business Support 

• Customer Setup: Assist with adding and maintaining customer information in Skimmer.  

• Administrative Tasks: Take ownership of recurring administrative tasks that support the Founder and field team.  

• Backlog Projects: Use downtime productively by working through important-but-not-urgent projects and outstanding items.  

• Social Media Support: Assist with basic social media tasks when operational priorities allow. This is a secondary responsibility rather than a primary focus. 

 

  

Who This Role Is For  

You may be a strong fit if you:  

 

• Have Operations Experience: You have experience coordinating multiple moving parts, staying organized, and following tasks through to completion.  

• Have Property or Field-Service Experience: Experience in pool service, property management, short-term rentals, dispatching, field services, or a similar environment.  

• Understand Last-Minute Changes: You're comfortable working in an environment where schedules change and priorities can shift throughout the day.  

• Are Highly Proactive: You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You look at what is happening, identify what needs attention, and take action.  

• Are Self-Directed: You can receive direction, figure out the next steps, and execute without constant supervision.  

• Have Strong Follow-Through: You don't simply start tasks—you make sure they are completed and properly documented.  

• Are Organized: You can keep track of schedules, invoices, work orders, vendors, customers, and multiple open items without losing track of details.  

• Are Comfortable with Technology: You can learn software quickly and are comfortable working across multiple systems.  

• Communicate Clearly: You have strong written and spoken English and can communicate professionally with customers, vendors, and team members.  

• Have Good Judgment: You know what you can handle independently and when something needs to be brought to the Founder.  

• Think Ahead: You naturally look for what could become a problem and address it before it becomes urgent.  

• Take Ownership: You treat the responsibilities you're given as things you own, rather than simply completing isolated tasks.  

• Use Downtime Productively: When the immediate workload is under control, you can identify backlog projects or process improvements that would add value. 

 

 

Requirements 

• Prior experience in the pool service industry, or a comparable dispatch/field-service/property-management role requiring real-time schedule coordination 

• Comfortable handling last-minute changes and reprioritizing on the fly 

• Self-starter — able to identify what needs attention and act on it with minimal hand-holding 

• Strong written communication for client-facing follow-up 

 



Preferred Qualifications  

• Experience coordinating schedules for field-service teams or multiple properties.  

• Experience with Skimmer or similar field-service/property management software.  

• Experience managing work orders, repairs, maintenance requests, or service tickets.  

• Experience with customer or client follow-up related to service work.  

• Experience coordinating vendors, suppliers, subcontractors, or field technicians.  

• Experience with billing, invoice review, quotes, or accounts receivable follow-up.  

• Experience documenting processes and creating SOPs or operational trackers.  

• Experience supporting construction or project coordination is a plus.  

• Basic social media experience is a plus. 

 

 

Compensation & Schedule 

• Hourly Rate: $6–$11/hr, depending on experience and level of responsibility.  

• Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday. Coverage should align primarily with the company's peak operating hours of 7:00 AM–4:00 PM U.S. Central Time, when the majority of the company's day-to-day operations and cleaning activity are taking place.  

• Start Date: As soon as possible. 

• Long-Term Opportunity: This is intended to be a full-time, ongoing position supporting the company's continued growth and expansion into construction.

title: Finance & Accounting Manager
description:
Finance & Accounting Manager — U.S. Company



Remote | Full-Time | Philippines

Salary: $TBD



Clean Slate Consulting is looking for an experienced Finance & Accounting Manager to take ownership of our day-to-day accounting, financial reporting, planning, and U.S. tax preparation.



This is not a basic bookkeeping or general VA position. We are looking for someone who can keep our financial records accurate while also helping management understand the numbers and make better financial decisions.



Key Responsibilities



* Manage full-cycle bookkeeping using QuickBooks Online

* Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, merchant processors, and billing platforms

* Maintain accurate categorization of revenue and expenses

* Track A/R, failed payments, refunds, chargebacks, reserves, payroll, and commissions

* Complete month-end close and maintain clean, tax-ready books

* Prepare monthly P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow Statement

* Build and maintain budgets, cash-flow forecasts, and revenue/expense forecasts

* Prepare Budget vs. Actual reporting and investigate variances

* Track financial KPIs including profitability, payroll %, CAC, LTV, collection performance, and marketing ROI

* Analyze department spending and profitability

* Create financial models for hiring, expansion, and other management decisions

* Prepare weekly and monthly financial reports for management

* Assist with U.S. federal/state tax preparation and estimated taxes

* Assist with 1099s and other applicable U.S. tax/compliance requirements

* Coordinate with outside CPA/EA when necessary

* Identify financial discrepancies, risks, unnecessary expenses, and opportunities to improve profitability

* Help build and maintain the company’s Finance KPI Dashboard



What We’re Looking For



* 3–5+ years of accounting/finance experience supporting U.S. businesses

* Strong QuickBooks Online experience

* Strong understanding of full-cycle accounting and month-end close

* Experience preparing P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow Statements

* Experience with budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis

* Strong Excel and/or Google Sheets skills

* Experience with U.S. business tax preparation

* Familiarity with 1099 reporting and U.S. tax compliance

* Strong reconciliation and problem-solving skills

* Ability to analyze financial data and explain it clearly to management

* High attention to detail and confidentiality

* Strong written and spoken English



Preferred Qualifications



* Philippine CPA

* QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification

* Experience with U.S. service or subscription-based businesses

* Experience with recurring billing and payment processors

* Experience preparing or supporting 1120, 1120S, and/or 1065 returns

* FP&A or management accounting experience

* Experience building financial dashboards and management reports



What Success Looks Like



We don’t just want someone who can tell us what happened financially.



We want someone who can help management understand:



Why did revenue or profit change?

Where are we overspending?

Are we ahead or behind budget?

What will our cash position look like next month?

Can we afford to hire additional employees?

How much additional revenue would a new investment need to generate to break even?

What financial risks or opportunities should management be paying attention to?



The right person will eventually become the company’s go-to person for reliable financial information and analysis.



Position Details



Position: Finance & Accounting Manager

Employment: Full-Time

Schedule: U.S. business hours / schedule to be discussed

Location: Remote — Philippines

Salary: $TBD based on experience and qualifications



This role will work closely with company leadership and will have access to confidential financial information. Integrity, accuracy, discretion, and accountability are essential.



To Apply



Please submit:



1. Resume/CV

2. Years of experience supporting U.S. companies

3. QuickBooks Online experience

4. U.S. tax preparation experience, including which returns you have worked with

5. Experience with budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis

6. CPA/QuickBooks certifications, if applicable

7. Expected monthly salary

8. A short explanation of how you would help a growing U.S. company improve its financial reporting and decision-making

title: Controller
description:
We are seeking an experienced Controller to lead and oversee the company’s accounting and financial operations. This role requires a hands-on finance leader who can manage the full accounting cycle while providing management with clear visibility into cash flow, profitability, margins, inventory, and overall financial performance.



The ideal candidate will have strong experience in distribution or wholesale, particularly with inventory accounting, COGS management, equipment sales, and margin analysis. Experience working with a U.S.-based company and understanding U.S. GAAP is required.



Because the company has recently undergone an acquisition, the Controller will also play an important role in post-acquisition financial integration, including improving reporting processes, supporting system integration, and developing reliable financial reporting for the new ownership structure.



Key Responsibilities



Accounting & Financial Operations



* Manage the company’s full-cycle accounting operations, including:



  * General Ledger

  * Accounts Payable

  * Accounts Receivable

  * Payroll

  * Bank and account reconciliations

  * Month-end and year-end close

* Maintain accurate and timely financial records in accordance with U.S. GAAP.

* Prepare and review financial statements, including:



  * Balance Sheet

  * Profit & Loss Statement

  * Cash Flow Statement

  * Supporting schedules

* Establish and maintain strong internal controls and accounting procedures.

* Coordinate with external CPAs, auditors, tax professionals, and other financial partners.

* Ensure accounting deadlines, reporting requirements, and compliance obligations are consistently met.



Cash Flow & Financial Management



* Own the company’s cash flow management and forecasting process.

* Develop short-term and long-term cash flow forecasts.

* Monitor incoming customer payments and outgoing vendor, payroll, tax, and operating obligations.

* Identify potential cash flow issues and proactively communicate them to leadership.

* Provide recommendations to improve working capital and cash availability.

* Analyze financial performance and provide management with actionable recommendations.



Inventory, COGS & Distribution Accounting



* Oversee accounting for inventory, including:



  * Inventory costing

  * Valuation

  * Cycle counts

  * Adjustments

  * Shrinkage

* Monitor and analyze Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) and gross margins.

* Review equipment sales margins and identify profitability trends.

* Analyze inventory purchases, vendor costs, freight, and other costs affecting product margins.

* Work with operations and sales teams to ensure inventory and project costs are accurately captured.

* Develop reporting that provides visibility into profitability by product, customer, project, or business segment.



Post-Acquisition Integration



* Support the financial integration of the company following the recent acquisition.

* Assist with the integration of accounting processes, systems, financial records, and reporting requirements.

* Help establish consistent accounting policies and procedures under the new ownership structure.

* Support potential ERP or accounting-system migration and implementation.

* Develop and maintain accurate reporting for ownership and executive leadership.

* Prepare or support monthly management and board-level financial reporting packages.

* Establish KPIs and dashboards that provide ownership with clear visibility into financial performance.

* Ensure financial data from multiple entities or business units can be consolidated accurately when required.



Financial Analysis & Strategic Support



* Provide leadership with financial analysis to support business decisions.

* Analyze revenue, expenses, gross margins, operating costs, working capital, and profitability.

* Develop budgets, forecasts, and financial models.

* Identify cost-saving opportunities and areas for improving profitability.

* Evaluate the financial impact of major purchases, vendor agreements, projects, and business initiatives.

* Partner with leadership to establish financial targets and monitor performance against them.



Industry & Compliance Responsibilities



* Apply accounting knowledge relevant to medical equipment and distribution businesses.

* Understand the financial impact of OEM/vendor relationships, rebates, discounts, and partner agreements.

* Understand the accounting differences between capital equipment and consumable products.

* Maintain awareness of applicable sales-tax considerations related to medical equipment.

* Support compliance requirements applicable to the company’s healthcare-adjacent business relationships.

* Maintain appropriate documentation for financial transactions and vendor/customer relationships.



Qualifications



Required Experience



* 5–8+ years of accounting or finance experience.

* 2–3+ years of experience in a Controller, Assistant Controller, or Senior Accounting Manager role.

* Strong background in distribution, wholesale, or equipment-based businesses.

* Demonstrated experience managing full-cycle accounting.

* Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP.

* Experience with inventory accounting, COGS, and gross-margin analysis.

* Experience with cash flow forecasting and financial planning.

* Experience preparing and analyzing financial statements.

* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills and financial modeling capabilities.

* Experience with accounting/ERP systems such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage, or similar platforms.

* Excellent written and spoken English.



Preferred Experience



* Medical device, medical equipment, healthcare, or healthcare-adjacent industry experience.

* Experience with post-acquisition integration.

* Experience working under a private equity, holding company, or investor-owned structure.

* Experience with multi-entity accounting and consolidation.

* Experience implementing or migrating ERP/accounting systems.

* Experience preparing investor, board, or PE-style reporting packages.

* Familiarity with vendor rebates and OEM partner agreements.

* Experience analyzing profitability for capital equipment sales.



Remote Work Requirements



* Previous experience working remotely with a U.S.-based team.

* Ability to maintain meaningful working-hour overlap with the U.S. Eastern Time Zone.

* Strong communication skills when working with executives, vendors, customers, OEM partners, and internal teams.

* Highly organized, self-directed, and capable of managing deadlines independently.

* Comfortable working with cloud-based accounting, communication, and business systems.



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is more than a bookkeeper or financial reporting specialist. We are looking for a **hands-on Controller** who can understand the entire financial picture of the business and help leadership make better decisions.



This person should be able to clearly answer:



* How much cash do we have available?

* What cash is expected to come in and when?

* What payments and obligations are coming due?

* Which products, projects, and customers are most profitable?

* Where are margins being lost?

* How much capital is tied up in inventory?

* What is driving changes in COGS and gross margin?

* How is the business performing against budget and forecast?

* What financial risks should leadership be aware of?

* What actions can the company take to improve cash flow and profitability?



Key Success Measures



Success in this role will be measured by:



* Accurate and timely monthly financial close.

* Reliable financial statements and management reporting.

* Improved cash flow visibility and forecasting accuracy.

* Strong inventory and COGS controls.

* Accurate gross-margin and profitability reporting.

* Timely identification of financial risks and opportunities.

* Successful integration of accounting processes following the acquisition.

* Effective reporting to executive leadership and new ownership.

* Improved financial controls, processes, and operational efficiency.



How to Apply:



Please send the following to: 



Updated Resume/CV

Cover Letter explaining why your accounting and finance experience, particularly in full-cycle accounting, inventory, COGS, financial reporting, and cash flow management, makes you a strong fit for this Controller role.

Loom Video – Plus Point!



Candidates who submit a short Loom video explaining their relevant accounting and finance experience, leadership background, experience working with U.S.-based companies, and why they believe they are a strong fit for the Controller position will receive additional consideration.



Important:

Applications must be sent directly to 
 include the word “ONYX” somewhere in your application to demonstrate that you have read the entire job description and are not simply submitting a resume without reviewing the requirements.

title: Content Strategist
description:
Looking for a Content Strategist Who Can Run Multiple Accounts



We are looking for a Content Strategist, someone who can take a brand and hand back a full week of finished content, posted. Planning, clipping, graphics, posting, all of it.



THE ROLE:



We run content for several brands at once. You own all posting.



End to end: the content plan, the clipper accounts, the clips, the graphics, the captions, the posting schedule, and the quality bar before anything goes live.





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:



- Strong skills running social accounts at volume for more than one brand at the same time

- You can set up clipper accounts from scratch, warm them, name them, grow them, and keep them out of trouble

- You can work with our AI Bot builders to take one long form video and pull 5 to 15 short form, viral cuts out of it with real hooks, burned in captions, and platform native formatting

- You use AI as the production method

- Expert prompting

- You can make graphics that look like the brand, either by design training or by AI 

- You keep brands separate. One client's voice, story, proof, and offers never touch another client's account

- Professional and reliable. This is not a "just getting started" role



BIG BONUS POINTS IF:



- You can edit too: clean cuts, text pop ups, motion, fonts, the polished pro stuff

- You have run faceless or theme pages and know how to grow one from zero

- You have built a repeatable system, not just one off winners

- You understand hooks, pacing, and retention on short form

- You have run content that performed and can show the numbers



If you have that on top of everything else, you are exactly who we want.



HOW TO APPLY:



Do not send a resume full of job titles. We want to see the accounts and the work.



Send:



1. Links to three accounts you personally ran, with the numbers you started with and the numbers you ended with

2. Five clips you cut yourself, plus the long form video they came from

3. Three graphics you made with AI, plus the prompts you used





ROOM TO GROW:

title: Pinterest Manager for Established Culture & Events Website
description:
What this role is (and isn't)

This is a traffic job, not a "make pretty pins" job. Our website earns money from display advertising, so the only number that really matters is clicks from Pinterest to 
. 

Impressions and saves are nice, but outbound clicks are the goal.



What you'll do



Create fresh pins from our existing library of blog posts, articles, videos, and calendar listings. You won't need to write new articles; the content is already there.



Make several pin variations per article (different images, headlines, and angles) and test what drives clicks.



Write keyword-rich pin titles and descriptions and organize boards around what people actually search for on Pinterest.



Create pins that promote our free
 newsletter (secondary goal).



Clean up and restructure existing boards where needed.



Send a short monthly report: outbound clicks, top pins, and what you're trying next.



What we're looking for



Proven experience driving outbound traffic from Pinterest to an informational, blog, or content website (not only ecommerce or product pins).



Strong Canva skills (or similar tools).



Understanding of Pinterest SEO, fresh pins, and how the algorithm treats new vs. repinned content.



Experience with a scheduler such as Tailwind or Pinterest's native scheduler.



Reliability. We've tried this before with people who started strong and then disappeared. We need consistency more than anything.



About our content

You don't need to know powwow or Native culture going in, but you must handle it respectfully. When you're unsure about a photo, term, or tradition, ask; don't guess. Please do not use AI-generated images of Native people, regalia, or ceremonies. Only use photos we provide or approve. Our community notices, and it matters to us.



To show us you've read this whole listing, include the word JINGLE at the start of your application.



Hours and pay

Ongoing and long-term, about 3-5 hours per week, set and consistent. If traffic increases, hours can increase.  Paid hourly. Please quote your hourly rate.



To apply, answer these questions:



Name one or two Pinterest accounts you've managed that drove traffic to a website. What kind of site was it, and roughly how many monthly outbound clicks did you get?

Please share a screenshot from Pinterest Analytics showing outbound clicks for an account you managed.

Describe a pin or strategy that clearly increased outbound clicks. What did you change, and what happened?

Our account has been dormant but still gets some traffic. What would you do in your first 30 days?

How many pins per week do you think is realistic and effective for your hours?

Have you ever used Pinterest to grow an
 list? If so, how?

What is your hourly rate, and how many hours per week can you commit?

Include links to 3–5 pins you've designed.

title: Facilities Manager
description:
Facility Manager (Remote)





We are seeking an experienced Facility Manager with a strong background in project management to oversee the daily operations, maintenance, and strategic development of our facilities. The ideal candidate will combine hands-on U.S. facility management expertise with proven project management skills to plan, execute, and deliver facility-related projects on time and within budget.





Note: Candidates without prior facility management experience in the United States will not be considered for interview.

Facility Operations

title: Shopify Product Page Builder — Ongoing Work
description:
We’re looking for someone reliable and efficient to help us build high-quality product pages on Shopify.

This is not a one-off project. We are constantly launching new products, usually in batches, and we’re looking for someone who can become part of our ongoing workflow and take on consistent work with us in the future.



What the Role Involves:

We have a complete SOP that walks you through exactly how we build each product page.

For every product, we will provide you with:

All relevant product/context files

A pre-made Shopify theme/page structure

A detailed SOP

The exact ChatGPT prompts to use for each section of the page



The workflow is very streamlined.

You will generally upload the provided product context into ChatGPT, follow our prompts for each section, review the output, make any necessary improvements, and then add the final copy into the Shopify page using the pre-made theme we provide.

A large portion of the process is already automated, so much of the work involves efficiently using ChatGPT, reviewing its output with good judgement, and putting everything together correctly inside Shopify.



Once familiar with our workflow, each product page should usually take around 1–1.5 hours to complete.





What We’re Looking For

The main skills we require are:

Shopify experience — you should be comfortable editing and building product pages inside Shopify.

Good copywriting judgement — you do not need to write everything from scratch, but you need to understand good copy well enough to judge ChatGPT's output, improve it where necessary, and re-prompt when the output is not strong enough.

Strong ChatGPT / AI workflow skills — you should be comfortable following prompts, providing context to ChatGPT, and getting high-quality outputs efficiently.

Efficiency — once you understand the workflow, you should be able to complete each product page within approximately 1–1.5 hours without sacrificing quality.

Attention to detail — pages should be properly formatted, polished, consistent, and ready to launch.

Reliability — because we launch products regularly and often in batches, we need someone who can consistently take on ongoing work.





Ongoing Opportunity

We are specifically looking for someone interested in a long-term working relationship, rather than somebody looking for a single project.

If you perform well, there will be ongoing Shopify product page work available as we continue launching new products.





How to Apply

If you're interested and believe you fit the criteria above, please send through:

A brief introduction about your experience

Examples of Shopify stores or product pages you have worked on previously

For each example you provide, please tell us:

The website/product page URL

Exactly which parts of the page you personally worked on

Whether you worked on the Shopify page build, copy, design, images, theme customisation, apps, or other areas

Which Shopify theme/page builder/apps were used

Any relevant experience with copywriting and/or using ChatGPT for ecommerce work





Looking forward to hearing from you!

title: US Tax Documentation Coordinator
description:
Client Document Collection

Missing Document Follow Up

File Organization

Signature Follow-Up

Workflow Status Tracking

Invoicing

Working with a team of 6 people

During tax season you will work 6-7 days per week after tax season about 20 hours per week





We are a professional tax preparation, bookkeeping, and accounting services firm serving individuals and businesses. Our firm is committed to providing accurate, efficient, and personalized service while maintaining the highest level of confidentiality and professionalism.



We are seeking a highly organized, dependable, and detail-oriented **Tax Document Coordinator** to join our team. This position plays a critical role in managing the flow of client documents and ensuring tax files are complete, properly organized, and ready for our tax preparation team.



This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys organization, administrative work, client communication, and working in a fast-paced professional office environment.



## Position Summary



The Tax Document Coordinator is responsible for receiving, reviewing, organizing, tracking, and maintaining client tax documents throughout the tax preparation process.



The coordinator will work closely with tax preparers and administrative staff to ensure client files move efficiently from initial document intake through preparation, review, signature, filing, and completion.



This position requires exceptional attention to detail. The successful candidate must be comfortable handling sensitive financial information, managing multiple deadlines, and communicating professionally with clients.



## Primary Responsibilities



**Tax Document Intake & Organization**



* Receive client tax documents through our secure client portal, electronic submissions, mail, and in-person drop-offs will be scanned by the US admin for you to handle.

* Scan, download, upload, rename, classify, and organize documents according to firm procedures.

* Accurately assign documents to the appropriate client and tax year.

* Recognize and organize common tax documents, including W-2s, 1099s, 1098s, K-1s, brokerage statements, Social Security statements, pension and retirement documents, rental property information, and business income and expense records.

* Maintain accurate and organized electronic and physical client files.

* Review files for obvious missing or incomplete documentation before submitting them to the tax preparation team.



**Client File Management & Tracking**



* Maintain accurate status information for each tax return throughout the preparation process.

* Track files that are awaiting documents, ready for preparation, under preparation, awaiting client information, ready for review, awaiting signatures, or completed.

* Prepare organized client files for assignment to tax preparers.

* Compare current-year documentation with available checklists, questionnaires, and prior-year information when appropriate.

* Identify missing documents and administrative information requiring client follow-up.

* Monitor approaching tax filing deadlines and communicate priority items to management and tax preparers.

* Assist with extension-season and filing-deadline tracking.



**Client Communication**



* Communicate professionally with clients by
, telephone, and approved firm communication systems.

* Request missing tax documents and incomplete information.

* Follow up with clients regarding outstanding documents, questionnaires, signatures, invoices, and other administrative requirements.

* Assist clients with basic instructions for securely submitting documents through the firm's client portal.

* Provide appropriate administrative updates regarding the status of client files.

* Maintain professional, courteous, and confidential communication at all times.

* Refer technical tax questions and requests for tax advice to the appropriate tax professional.



**Tax Return Completion & Administrative Processing**



* Assist with preparing completed tax returns for secure client delivery and electronic signature.

* Track required signatures, authorizations, and outstanding administrative items.

* Confirm that firm procedures regarding payment and signatures have been completed before returns move to electronic filing.

* Maintain electronic filing acknowledgments and completion records.

* Organize and archive completed client files according to firm procedures.

* Assist the tax preparation team with administrative projects during peak filing periods.



## Required Qualifications



* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

* Strong organizational and time-management skills.

* Ability to manage a high volume of documents and multiple client files simultaneously.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Professional and courteous client-service skills.

* Ability to maintain strict confidentiality when handling taxpayer and financial information.

* Comfortable working with computers,
, PDF documents, scanners, spreadsheets, and web-based software.

* Ability to follow established procedures and detailed instructions.

* Ability to work independently while also functioning effectively as part of a team.

* Dependable, punctual, and able to meet deadlines.

* Ability to remain organized and professional during high-volume periods.



## Preferred Qualifications



* Previous administrative experience in a tax preparation, accounting, bookkeeping, financial services, legal, or professional services office.

* Familiarity with common individual and business tax documents.

* Previous experience working with client portals or document-management systems.

* Experience handling confidential financial records.

* Basic understanding of tax preparation workflow is preferred but not required.



Training may be provided to the right candidate who demonstrates strong organizational skills, attention to detail, professionalism, and the ability to learn quickly.



## Important Scope of Position



The Tax Document Coordinator is an administrative and document-management position. Unless separately qualified and specifically authorized by the firm, this position does **not** provide tax advice to clients or make determinations regarding tax treatment.



Questions concerning deductions, credits, taxability, filing positions, tax planning, or other technical tax matters must be referred to a tax preparer or other authorized professional.



## Work Environment



This position operates in a professional, deadline-driven tax and accounting environment. January through April is our busiest period, and employees should expect a significantly higher volume of client documents, communications, and deadlines during tax season.



The successful candidate must be able to prioritize assignments, shift between multiple client files, and maintain accuracy even when working under time-sensitive conditions.



## Ideal Candidate



Our ideal candidate is someone who takes pride in keeping information organized and accurate. You notice when something is missing, mislabeled, duplicated, or placed in the wrong client file.



You understand that small administrative errors can create significant delays during tax season, and you are comfortable taking responsibility for ensuring files are complete and properly organized before they reach the tax preparer.



You are professional when communicating with clients, comfortable following up when information is missing, and understand the importance of protecting confidential financial information.



## What Success Looks Like in This Role



Success means that client files are organized, properly labeled, accurately tracked, and ready for tax preparation with minimal additional administrative work required from the tax preparer.



The Tax Document Coordinator helps keep the entire tax preparation process moving efficiently so that our tax professionals can focus on preparing and reviewing accurate tax returns while clients receive timely and professional service.





**To Apply**



Please submit your resume along with a brief description of your administrative, accounting, tax, bookkeeping, or document-management experience. Applicants should also include their general availability during tax season.
