title: Remote HR Operations Specialist – U.S. Home Health Care
description:
Recruitment, Onboarding & Compliance



Company: Penn Home Health Care

Work Arrangement: Remote / Work From Home

Location: Philippines-based remote position

Schedule: 30 hours per week | Must be able to work scheduled U.S. Eastern Time hours

Department:  Human Resources / Operations / Compliance

Reports To:  Administrator / Operations Management or Authorized Designee



About the Position



Penn Home Health Care is seeking an experienced, highly organized Remote Human Resources Operations Specialist to support the day-to-day HR operations of our U.S.-based home health and home care organization.



This is a hands-on operational HR position responsible for helping manage the employee lifecycle from recruitment and applicant screening through onboarding, personnel-file completion, orientation and training coordination, workforce compliance, credential tracking, and ongoing employee documentation.



The successful candidate must be comfortable managing multiple applicants and employees simultaneously, following detailed Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), maintaining accurate and audit-ready records, identifying missing or expired requirements, communicating professionally with candidates and employees, and escalating issues appropriately.



This is not an entry-level virtual assistant position.  We are looking for someone with relevant professional experience who can take ownership of assigned HR workflows, maintain organized records, consistently follow established processes, and follow tasks through to completion.



 Key Responsibilities



Recruitment & Applicant Management



The HR Operations Specialist will manage and support the recruitment pipeline for positions such as caregivers/direct care workers, HHAs, CNAs, LPNs, RNs, therapists, administrative staff, operations staff, and other workforce positions.



Responsibilities include:



* Monitor incoming résumés and employment applications.

* Create and maintain accurate applicant records.

* Review and screen résumés against position requirements.

* Identify candidates who should proceed, be placed on hold, be considered for another position, or be referred for further review.

* Send employment applications and position-specific screening questionnaires.

* Follow up with applicants regarding incomplete applications or missing information.

* Review completed applications and pre-screening information.

* Schedule interviews with qualified candidates.

* Prepare applicant information before interviews.

* Conduct initial HR/recruitment interviews when authorized.

* Document interview findings objectively.

* Assess experience, availability, qualifications, communication skills, and apparent position fit.

* Update candidate status throughout the recruitment process.

* Communicate authorized interview, hold, decline, and next-step decisions professionally.

* Maintain follow-up on stalled or aging applicants.

* Prepare qualified candidates for management or final interviews when required.

* Transfer Approved-to-Hire candidates into the onboarding process.

* Maintain complete and audit-ready recruitment documentation.



Employee Onboarding & Personnel File Management



Once a candidate has been Approved to Hire, the HR Operations Specialist will coordinate the administrative onboarding process.



Responsibilities include:



* Receive and review Approved-to-Hire handoffs.

* Confirm employee position, program, classification, compensation information, and onboarding status.

* Establish and maintain the employee's official personnel file.

* Ensure required recruitment documents are transferred into the personnel record.

* Initiate electronic onboarding.

* Assign applicable forms, acknowledgments, disclosures, attestations, and other onboarding requirements.

* Track completion of onboarding requirements.

* Follow up with employees regarding missing or incomplete documentation.

* Review completed forms rather than simply confirming that they were submitted.

* Identify discrepancies, disclosures, exceptions, or missing information.

* Obtain supporting documentation when needed.

* Coordinate credential, license, certification, clearance, and other applicable verification.

* Maintain onboarding and compliance trackers.

* Coordinate applicable HHAeXchange or other workforce-system setup.

* Conduct or assist with pre-orientation personnel-file audits.

* Confirm that applicable requirements are complete before moving an employee to the next authorized stage.

* Coordinate final pre-assignment documentation review.

* Maintain clear documentation of outstanding deficiencies.

* Escalate questionable, unusual, or non-routine issues to management, Compliance, or clinical leadership as appropriate.



This position does not independently authorize an employee for assignment unless specifically delegated that authority by Penn Home Health Care.



Orientation, Training & Competency Administration



This position will provide administrative coordination of employee orientation and training.



Responsibilities include:



* Confirm that employees are approved for orientation before scheduling or assigning training.

* Identify the appropriate training package based on position, program, and duties.

* Assign required orientation and training modules.

* Track training completion.

* Review training completion records and supporting evidence.

* Coordinate quizzes, knowledge assessments, and other required testing.

* Monitor incomplete or failed training.

* Coordinate retraining when required.

* Maintain accurate training documentation and personnel-file evidence.

* Coordinate role-specific, system-specific, and assignment-specific training.

* Track annual training and competency requirements.

* Coordinate with supervisors, management, and qualified clinical staff when competency evaluation is required.



Training completion does not independently establish professional or clinical competency when evaluation by a qualified individual is required.



Workforce Compliance & Credential Tracking



The HR Operations Specialist will support HR operations after employees have been cleared for assignment.



Responsibilities include:



* Maintain employee compliance trackers.

* Monitor professional license and certification expiration dates.

* Monitor applicable CPR, TB, background clearance, and other workforce requirements.

* Send renewal and expiration reminders.

* Follow up on outstanding renewal documentation.

* Coordinate annual training and competency requirements.

* Assist with applicable exclusion-screening processes.

* Track incomplete or overdue compliance requirements.

* Identify employees who may require assignment restriction because of expired or missing requirements and escalate appropriately.

* Document reinstatement requirements and completed compliance corrections.

* Maintain confidential HR and personnel records.

* Assist with separation and employee-file closure documentation.

* Escalate adverse, inconsistent, expired, or questionable compliance results.



 Attendance & Employee Operations Support



Depending on assignment and authorization, the HR Operations Specialist may also assist with:



* Employee attendance tracking.

* Call-out documentation.

* Availability changes.

* Schedule-related employee communication.

* Missed or late shift follow-up.

* Employee communication requiring HR follow-up.

* Attendance and performance documentation.

* Coordinating corrective or remedial training.

* Maintaining applicable operational documentation.

* Escalating recurring attendance or performance concerns.

* Supporting continuity of patient/participant services by promptly communicating staffing-related employee issues.



Required Qualifications



We are looking for candidates who meet most or all of the following:



* At least 2 years of experience in Human Resources, recruitment, onboarding, credentialing, workforce operations, or a closely related administrative role.

* Experience supporting a U.S.-based company is strongly preferred.

* Healthcare, home care, home health, staffing, medical, or other regulated-industry experience is strongly preferred.

* Experience managing applicants from résumé screening through interview and onboarding.

* Experience maintaining employee personnel files and compliance documentation.

* Strong ability to track multiple employees, applicants, deadlines, expirations, and outstanding requirements simultaneously.

* Strong attention to detail and ability to identify missing, incomplete, inconsistent, or expired documentation.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Professional phone,
, and virtual-interview communication skills.

* Strong organizational and follow-up skills.

* Ability to follow detailed SOPs and established workflows consistently.

* Ability to recognize when an issue must be escalated rather than making an unauthorized decision.

* Comfortable working with confidential employee and healthcare-related information.

* Strong Microsoft Office / Microsoft 365 skills, particularly Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams, and electronic file management.

* Experience using an HRIS, applicant tracking system, scheduling platform, credentialing system, or similar software.

* Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet connection, and a professional remote-work environment.

* Ability to work **30 hours per week during the assigned U.S. Eastern Time schedule.



Preferred Qualifications



Candidates will receive stronger consideration if they have experience with:



* U.S. Home Health or Home Care HR operations.

* Pennsylvania home care/home health workforce requirements.

* Viventium.

* HHAeXchange.

* Axxess.

* LearnWorlds or another Learning Management System (LMS).

* Applicant Tracking Systems or HRIS platforms.

* Electronic onboarding systems.

* Caregiver recruitment.

* RN/LPN/HHA/CNA/DCW recruitment.

* Professional license verification.

* Background-clearance tracking.

* Credentialing and personnel-file auditing.

* TB/health requirement tracking.

* Employee compliance monitoring.

* Training and competency tracking.

* Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365.

* Audit-ready personnel-file management.



Skills We Are Looking For



The ideal person is:



* Highly organized.

* Detail-oriented.

* Persistent with follow-up.

* Comfortable working independently.

* Process-driven.

* Able to prioritize urgent versus routine work.

* Professional when communicating with candidates and employees.

* Comfortable handling difficult or incomplete applicant situations.

* Able to maintain confidentiality.

* Able to document facts objectively.

* Comfortable working from checklists, trackers, SOPs, and deadlines.

* Proactive in identifying problems before they become compliance issues.

* Able to manage a high-volume applicant and employee pipeline without losing track of required actions.



Important Role Boundaries



This position supports the Administrator, Operations, HR, Compliance, and Clinical Leadership but does not independently make decisions outside delegated authority.



The HR Operations Specialist must know when to:



STOP → DOCUMENT → VERIFY → ESCALATE



Issues involving significant employment decisions, legal concerns, unusual clearance findings, clinical competency, exceptions, termination decisions, or other high-risk matters must be escalated to the appropriate authorized leader.



Clinical competency determinations remain with appropriately qualified clinical personnel where required.



Ideal Candidate



You may be a strong fit if you have previously worked as a:



Home Health HR Coordinator, Healthcare Recruiter, HR Operations Specialist, Onboarding Specialist, Credentialing Specialist, Compliance Coordinator, Home Care Staffing Coordinator, Healthcare Virtual Assistant, or HR Generalist with direct responsibility for recruitment and employee records.



We are especially interested in applicants who understand that successful healthcare HR is not simply about hiring quickly. It requires maintaining an accurate, documented process throughout the employee lifecycle:



Applicant → Screening → Interview → Approved to Hire → Onboarding → Personnel File Review → Orientation/Training → Final Clearance → Ongoing Compliance**



How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your updated résumé/CV.

2. A brief description of your experience with U.S. healthcare, home health, home care, recruitment, onboarding, or HR operations.

3. The HR, ATS, LMS, or healthcare systems you have personally used.

4. Your experience handling employee credentials, licenses, background requirements, personnel files, or compliance tracking.

5. Your current availability and confirmation that you can work  30 hours per week during U.S. Eastern Time hours.

6. Your expected hourly rate in USD.



Please apply only if you have relevant professional experience. This role requires someone who can work independently after learning Penn Home Health Care's specific SOPs and workflows.

- Escalations: the tickets nobody else should be d

description:

title: Customer Service & Order Management Specialist
description:
About Grizzly Mine

Grizzly Mine is a California-inspired apparel brand currently in its pre-launch stage. We are building a distinctive brand world rooted in California history, mining culture and original artwork, beginning with apparel and related products.

We are looking for people who are excited by the opportunity to help build a company, not simply step into a finished system. This role will begin part-time, with the expectation that it can grow into a full-time position as order volume and customer activity increase.



The Role

We are looking for a dependable, thoughtful Customer Service & Order Management Specialist who can help us finish building the customer-service and order-management side of the business and then operate it day to day. This is a combined role by design: in the beginning, customer communication and order management need to work closely together, especially when an order requires investigation, correction or coordination with a production partner.

The right person will be comfortable working in a startup environment, learning systems, documenting what works and helping improve processes over time. We are looking for a long-term team member.



Initial Priorities

• Help complete the implementation and configuration of Gorgias for customer service.

• Review our customer-service workflows and help establish practical rules, templates, tags, routing and escalation procedures.

• Help evaluate and select an order-management solution that works well with Shopify and our print-on-demand / production-partner model.

• Assist with implementation, testing and documentation of the selected order-management workflow.

• Learn how orders move from Shopify through production and fulfillment so customer questions and order exceptions can be handled accurately.

• Help create a simple, searchable operating knowledge base for recurring customer-service and order-management situations.



Ongoing Responsibilities

• Manage customer inquiries through Gorgias with clear, professional and helpful communication.

• Monitor orders and identify exceptions, delays, address issues, production problems and other situations requiring follow-up.

• Coordinate with internal team members and production / fulfillment partners when an order requires intervention.

• Handle order changes, cancellations, returns, refunds and replacements according to established policies and system capabilities.

• Maintain accurate notes and customer/order history so issues can be understood and resolved efficiently.

• Escalate unusual, high-impact or policy-sensitive situations when appropriate rather than guessing.

• Identify recurring customer questions or operational problems and recommend improvements to the process.

• Keep procedures and knowledge-base information current as products, policies and systems evolve.



What We Are Looking For

• Strong written English and the ability to communicate with customers in a calm, professional and natural way.

• Excellent attention to detail, follow-through and organization.

• Good judgment: able to solve routine problems independently while recognizing when something should be escalated.

• Comfort working with e-commerce systems and learning new software.

• A process-oriented mindset and willingness to document procedures as they are developed.

• Reliability and ownership. We need someone who follows an issue through rather than simply passing it along.

• Interest in joining a small team and growing with the company over time.



Experience That Would Be Especially Helpful

• Shopify experience.

• Gorgias experience, including setup or administration.

• E-commerce customer-service experience.

• Order management, fulfillment or operations experience.

• Experience working with print-on-demand, dropshipping or outside production / fulfillment partners.

• Experience helping implement a new customer-service or order-management system.



You do not need to check every box. We care about relevant experience, judgment, communication and the ability to learn and take ownership.



How We Work

Grizzly Mine is being built by a small, collaborative team. We value people who communicate well, ask questions, contribute ideas and care about the quality of the work. Because we are pre-launch, some processes are still being designed. That is part of the opportunity: the person joining us will help shape how customer service and order management operate from the beginning.

We also believe customer service is broader than one department. Everyone on the team should care about the customer's experience. This role will be the day-to-day owner of that experience after an order is placed and an important source of feedback as we improve the business.



Schedule & Long-Term Opportunity

This is a remote, part-time position to start. We expect the role to grow as Grizzly Mine launches and customer/order volume increases, with the potential to become a full-time position. We are specifically looking for someone interested in a long-term team role and the opportunity to grow in responsibility as the company develops.

THE ROLE:

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

- You work from a real person's likeness, not just stock avatars or fully synthetic characters

- You document what worked so clip 50 is faster than clip 5

- Professional and reliable. This is not a "just getting started" role



BIG BONUS POINTS IF:



- You can edit too: clean cuts, text pop ups, motion, fonts, the polished pro stuff

- You have built a repeatable system, not just one off winners

- You understand hooks, pacing, and retention on short form

- You have run AI content that performed and can show the numbers



If you have that on top of everything else, you are exactly who we want.



HOW TO APPLY:



Do not send random AI content. We want to see the real person and the AI clone that holds up as a REAL person on camera.



Send:



1. Your best realistic AI clone or avatar work, polished

2. 3 or more clips of the SAME face so we can see consistency across generations

3. Your tool stack and how you would approach a daily volume build

4. A quick note on your experience and your rates



ROOM TO GROW:



This starts project based and scales into an ongoing role as output ramps. The right person grows into owning the full production pipeline and briefing the editors under them.



NEWER, BUT GOT THE SKILLS?



No client work yet but you make realistic AI content and can prove consistency? Make a sample and send it in. Skill speaks louder than a resume.



Excited to find the right person. Send your best.

title: Labor Compliance Specialist/Auditor
description:
Position Overview



Veracity Compliance, Inc. is seeking a highly analytical, detail-oriented, and organized Labor Compliance Specialist / Auditor to support the review, auditing, and administration of labor compliance requirements for public works, federally funded, and other regulated construction projects. The ideal candidate must be able to follow instructions carefully, adhere to established workflows and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), maintain accurate and orderly documentation, and consistently complete detailed processes without skipping required steps.



This is not strictly an administrative compliance position. We are specifically seeking a candidate with a strong auditing and accounting background who is comfortable reviewing payroll records, reconciling financial information, identifying discrepancies, documenting findings, and conducting detailed compliance reviews.



The ideal candidate understands how financial records connect and has experience in auditing, accounting, Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), payroll, or financial reconciliation. Prior labor compliance or construction experience is highly preferred but may not be required for an exceptional accounting/audit candidate who can learn regulatory requirements quickly.



A CPA, CPA candidate, or candidate with formal accounting/auditing credentials is strongly preferred.



Key Responsibilities:



Labor Compliance & Auditing



Conduct detailed audits of contractor and subcontractor labor compliance documentation.

Review Certified Payroll Reports (CPRs) for accuracy, completeness, and compliance.

Compare payroll records against supporting documentation to identify inconsistencies or potential violations.

Audit employee classifications, wage rates, fringe benefits, hours worked, overtime, deductions, and payroll calculations.

Identify underpayments, overpayments, missing documentation, discrepancies, and other compliance deficiencies.

Review payroll registers, timecards, proof of payment, canceled checks, direct-deposit records, invoices, and other supporting financial documentation.

Calculate potential wage restitution and document the basis for audit findings.

Maintain detailed audit trails and supporting documentation.

Prepare clear audit findings, deficiency notices, and compliance correspondence.

Follow up with contractors and subcontractors regarding outstanding deficiencies and corrective actions.

Assist with internal and external compliance audits and investigations.

Accounting & Financial Review

Perform detailed reconciliations between payroll, accounting records, supporting documentation, and compliance submissions.

Review AP and AR documentation when relevant to compliance verification.

Trace transactions and payments through supporting accounting records.

Identify mathematical errors, duplicate transactions, inconsistencies, missing payments, and unsupported amounts.

Analyze spreadsheets and large volumes of financial information with a high degree of accuracy.

Verify calculations independently rather than relying solely on information provided by contractors.

Maintain organized records capable of supporting an audit, investigation, or agency review.

Public Works & Prevailing Wage Compliance



Depending on experience and assigned projects, responsibilities may include:



California prevailing wage compliance

Davis-Bacon / Davis-Bacon Related Acts

Certified payroll auditing

DIR requirements and eCPR

WH-347 payroll review

Prevailing wage determinations

Fringe benefit verification

Worker classification review

Overtime requirements

Apprenticeship requirements

DAS 140 and DAS 142 documentation

Apprenticeship ratios

Restitution calculations

Contractor and subcontractor compliance

Agency and client audit preparation

Labor compliance tracking systems and reporting



Training may be provided on specific labor compliance regulations and systems for candidates with exceptional accounting and auditing qualifications.



REQUIRED Qualifications



Candidates must have professional experience in auditing, accounting, or financial review, including experience with Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), payroll, reconciliations, or similar accounting functions.

title: Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist (Cold Calling + Content + Outreach)
description:
Position: Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist (Cold Calling + Content + Outreach)



Company Overview:

We are a Los Angeles–based electrical distributor and wholesaler established in 2004. We supply contractors, developers, and builders with materials for residential, commercial, and industrial projects.



Our product lines include:

• Electrical materials (wire, panels, switchgear, breakers, switchboards)

• Lighting systems

• HVAC systems (including VRF)

• Air purifiers

• Kitchen appliances

• Water heaters

• Solar panels and battery systems

• EV chargers and energy solutions (ESS)



We are an authorized distributor for major brands including Siemens and other leading manufacturers. We focus on supplying full project packages with strong pricing and fast turnaround.



Position Overview:

We are looking for someone who knows how to market and generate business without being told what to do.



Your main goal is simple:

Bring in more customers and more projects.



This role includes:

• Lead generation

• Cold calling

• Marketing (content + outreach)



Key Responsibilities:



• Find and target:



Developers

General contractors

Builders

Homeowners with active projects

Construction job sites



• Generate leads using:



Google (search, maps)

LinkedIn

Construction/project databases

Permit and job tracking tools



• Perform daily cold calling to:



Contractors

Developers

Construction companies



• If assigned a product (example: fire alarm systems, HVAC, solar, etc.), you must:



Understand who needs it

Know where to find them

Reach out and pitch confidently



• Create marketing content:



Instagram posts

Short-form videos (Reels/TikTok style)

Flyers and promotional materials



• Come up with your own ideas for:



Lead generation

Marketing strategies

Outreach methods



• Track leads, calls, and progress



Mandatory Requirements:



• Must work 15 hours per week (5 hours/day, 3 days/week)

• Must align with Los Angeles (PST) business hours

• Must have experience in:



Cold calling

Lead generation

Marketing



• Must:



Know how to find contractors, developers, and job sites

Be able to market without constant direction

Work independently and take initiative



• Industry experience is a plus, but if not, you must be willing to learn quickly



Communication Requirements:



• Must speak clear, fluent English (no strong accent)

• Must be confident and professional on calls

• Must be persuasive and direct



Compensation:



• $3.25/hour

• 15 hours per week (5 hours/day, 3 days/week)

• Opportunity to increase hours based on performance



Important Notes:



• This is a long-term role

• Performance is based on results (leads + projects generated)

• You are expected to think, act, and execute without being told every step

• Being able to make flyers and marketing content is a plus and will be considered with priority



Application Requirement:

To be considered, include:



3 types of clients you would target for our business

Platforms/tools you would use to find them

A short cold call script
